cards.name: "Watch this!"
cards.text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing. As an additional cost to commit "Watch this!" to a skill test, spend up to 3 resources.
If you succeed by 1 or more, gain twice that many resources.
cards.flavor: Show-off.

cards.name: A Sudden Fall
cards.text: Fight (COMBAT). You get +2 COMBAT for this attack. If the targeted enemy is exhausted, this attack deals +1 damage.
cards.flavor: What an unfortunate "accident."

cards.name: A Sudden Fall
cards.text: Fight (AGILITY). Add your COMBAT to your AGILITY for this test. If the targeted enemy is exhausted, this attack deals +2 damage.
cards.flavor: What an unfortunate "accident."

cards.name: André Patel
cards.text:
REACTION After you succeed at a skill test by 2 or more during your turn: You may take an additional action this turn. (Limit once per round.)
ELDER SIGN effect: +2. Gain 1 resource.

[Back]

cards.stats: WIL 2 INT 3 COM 2 AGI 5 / Health 7 / Sanity 8

cards.text:

cards.text: Investigate (INTELLECT). You get +2 INTELLECT for this investigation. If you discover the last clue at your location, you may move to a connecting location.
cards.flavor:

cards.text: Investigate (AGILITY). Add your INTELLECT to your AGILITY for this test. After this test resolves, you may move to a connecting location.
cards.flavor:
"Better luck next time, love."
- R. S.

cards.name: Easy Street
cards.text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing. Max 1 committed per skill test.
Easy Street gains WILD for every 3 resources you have (to a maximum of WILD WILD WILD).

cards.name: Extravagant Ring
cards.text:
Uses (3 renown).
REACTION When you would succeed at a skill test, spend 1 renown and exhaust Extravagant Ring: You get +2 skill value for this test.
cards.flavor: Lina always wanted the attention.

cards.name: Fame
cards.text:
Uses (4 renown). If there is no renown on Fame, discard it.
ACTION If there is an enemy at your location, spend 1 renown: Parley. Gain 2 resources.

cards.name: Know the Exit
cards.text:
André Patel deck only.
While this card is committed to an attack or an evasion, it gains WILD WILD.

cards.name: Know the Line
cards.text:
André Patel deck only.
While this card is committed to a skill test on a scenario card, it gains WILD WILD.

cards.name: Know the Scene
cards.text:
André Patel deck only.
While this card is committed to an investigation or parley, it gains WILD WILD.

cards.name: Lockpicks
cards.text: ACTION Exhaust Lockpicks: Investigate. Add your AGILITY value to your skill value for this investigation. If you do not succeed by at least 2, discard Lockpicks.

cards.name: Lockpicks
cards.text:
Uses (3 supplies). If Lockpicks has no supplies, discard it.
ACTION Exhaust Lockpicks: Investigate. Add your AGILITY value to your skill value for this investigation. If you do not succeed by at least 2, remove 1 supply from Lockpicks.

cards.name: Marcus Sengstacke
cards.text:
You gain 1 additional resource during the upkeep phase.
Forced - After you fail a skill test: Deal 1 horror to Marcus Sengstacke.
cards.flavor: "I am certain this city will know of your accomplishments."

cards.name: Out the Door
cards.text: After Out the Door is committed to a skill test, the performing investigator gains 2 resources. If this skill test fails, that investigator loses 2 resources.

cards.name: Out the Door
cards.text: After Out the Door is committed to a skill test, the performing investigator gains 4 resources. If this skill test fails, that investigator loses 4 resources.

cards.name: Pay Your Dues
cards.text: Parley. Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location with X remaining health. That enemy disengages from each investigator and gains aloof until the end of the round. Discover 1 clue at your location.

cards.name: Polished Cane
cards.text: ACTION: Fight (COMBAT). Add your AGILITY to your COMBAT for this attack. If this attack succeeds by 2 or more against a non-[[Elite]] enemy, you may exhaust Polished Cane to automatically evade that enemy.

cards.name: Quick Exit
cards.text: Evade (AGILITY). You get +2 AGILITY for this evasion. If you succeed by 2 or more and the evaded enemy is non-[[Elite]], that enemy does not ready during the next upkeep phase.

cards.name: Quick Exit
cards.text: Evade (AGILITY). Add your WILLPOWER to your AGILITY for this test. If you succeed and the evaded enemy is non-[[Elite]], that enemy does not ready during the next upkeep phase.

cards.name: Right Under Their Noses
cards.text:
Fast. Play after you successfully evade an enemy.
Discover 1 clue at your location (if you succeeded by 2 or more, you may discover 1 clue at a connecting location, instead).

cards.name: Right Under Their Noses
cards.text:
Fast. Play after you successfully evade an enemy.
Discover 1 clue at your location (if you succeeded by 2 or more, you may discover 1 clue at a connecting location, as well).

cards.name: Silver Tongue
cards.text:
Starting. (You may begin the game with 1 copy of a starting card in your opening hand.)
FAST Spend 1 resource: You get +1 INTELLECT for this skill test (+2 INTELLECT instead if this is an evasion or parley).
FAST Spend 1 resource: You get +1 AGILITY for this skill test (+2 AGILITY instead if this is an evasion or parley).

cards.name: The Black Fan
cards.text:
Exceptional.
While you have...
- ...10+ resources, you get +1 health and +1 sanity.
- ...15+ resources, you may take one additional action during your turn.
- ...20+ resources, you get +1 to each of your skills.

cards.name: The Grapevine
cards.text:
Uses (3 rumors). If there are no rumors on The Grapevine, discard it.
ACTION Spend 1 rumor and exhaust The Grapevine: Parley. Choose an enemy at a revealed location up to 2 connections away. Move (one location at a time) along the shortest path to that enemy's location and engage it.

cards.name: The Grapevine
cards.text:
Uses (3 rumors). If there are no rumors on The Grapevine, discard it.
ACTION Spend 1 rumor and exhaust The Grapevine: Parley. Choose an enemy at a revealed location up to 3 connections away. Move (one location at a time) along the shortest path to that enemy's location and engage it. Draw 1 card.

cards.name: The Red Clock
cards.text:
Exceptional. Uses (0 charges).
Forced - After your turn begins: You may take all charges here, as resources. Place 1 charge here. If it has exactly...
- 1 charge, you get +4 skill value for your next skill test.
- 2 charges, you may move up to 3 times.
- 3 charges, you may take 2 additional actions this turn.

cards.name: Unaware
cards.text:
Revelation - Put Unaware into play in your threat area.
Forced - The first time you fail a skill test during your turn: Draw the top card of the encounter deck. If that card is an enemy, discard Unaware.

cards.name: Weight of the World
cards.text:
Revelation - Put Weight of the World into play in your threat area.
Forced - When you fail a skill test while Weight of the World is in play, take 1 horror and shuffle it back into your deck.
cards.flavor: All eyes are on you.

cards.name: Well Connected
cards.text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
FAST Exhaust Well Connected: You get +1 skill value for this skill test for every 4 resources you have.
FAST Spend 2 resources: Ready Well Connected. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Father Mateo
cards.text:
FAST During your turn: Seal a BLESS token on an investigator at your location with no BLESS token sealed on them. (Limit once per round.)
REACTION When an investigator would reveal a chaos token: Resolve the BLESS token sealed on them instead. Release that token.
ELDER SIGN effect: +1. Resolve Father Mateo's FAST ability, ignoring its limit.

[Back]
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards (MYSTIC) level 0-3, [[Blessed]] cards level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 5 other cards with "seal" level 0-5.

cards.stats: WIL 4 INT 3 COM 2 AGI 3 / Health 6 / Sanity 8

cards.name: Serpents of Yig
cards.text:
Advanced. Prey - Father Mateo only. Hunter.
Revelation - Search the chaos bag and all play areas for the ELDER SIGN token and each BLESS token and seal them on Serpents of Yig.

cards.name: The Codex of Ages
cards.text:
Father Mateo deck only. Advanced. Seal (ELDER SIGN or up to 3 BLESS).
You get +1 to each of your skills while there is a token sealed here.

Advanced. Revelation - Put Hospital Debts into play in your threat area.

cards.name: On the Lam
cards.text:
"Skids" O'Toole deck only. Advanced.
Fast. Play during any FAST window.
Until the end of the round, non-[[Elite]] enemies cannot attack you. At the end of the round, you may disengage from each engaged enemy and move up to 2 locations away.

cards.name: "I'll see you in hell!"
cards.text: Each non-[[Elite]] enemy engaged with you is defeated. You are defeated and suffer 1 physical trauma. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
cards.flavor: He flicked open the lighter and made his peace.

cards.name: .45 Automatic
cards.text:
Uses (4 ammo).
ACTION Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 COMBAT for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. Ignore the retaliate keyword for this attack.

cards.name: Archaic Glyphs
cards.text:
Researched. Uses (3 charges).
ACTION Spend 1 charge: Investigate. For every 2 points you succeed by, discover 1 additional clue at your location.

cards.name: Archaic Glyphs
cards.text:
Researched. Uses (3 charges).
ACTION Spend 1 charge: Investigate. If you succeed, you may automatically evade an engaged enemy. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

cards.name: Cheap Shot
cards.text: Fight. Add your AGILITY value to your skill value for this attack. If you succeed by 2 or more, automatically evade the attacked enemy.
cards.flavor: "Aim for the eyes," they told me.

cards.name: Logical Reasoning
cards.text:
Play only if you have at least 1 clue.
Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator either heals 2 horror or discards a [[Terror]] card from his or her threat area.
cards.flavor:
"I am the wisest man alive, for I know one thing, and that is that I know nothing."
- Plato, The Republic

cards.name: Madame Labranche

FAST If you have no resources, exhaust Madame Labranche: Gain 1 resource.

cards.name: Pickpocketing
cards.text:
Fast.

cards.name: Quantum Flux
cards.text: Shuffle your discard pile into your deck and draw 1 card. Remove Quantum Flux from the game.

cards.name: Recharge
cards.text: Choose a [[Spell]] or [[Relic]] asset controlled by an investigator at your location and reveal a random chaos token from the chaos bag. If you reveal a SKULL, CULTIST, TABLET, ELDER THING, or AUTO FAIL symbol, discard the chosen asset. Otherwise, add 3 charges to the chosen asset.

cards.name: Snare Trap

Attach to your location. Limit 1 per location.
Forced - After a non-[[Elite]] enemy enters attached location: Exhaust that enemy, disengage it from all investigators, and attach Snare Trap to it.
Forced - When attached enemy would ready: Instead, discard Snare Trap.

cards.name: Agnes Baker
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play a [[Spell]] event, you may take 1 damage. If you do, reduce the cost to play that event by 2, and you may shuffle that event back into your deck instead of discarding it.
ELDER SIGN effect: +1. You may heal 1 damage.

cards.stats: WIL 5 INT 2 COM 2 AGI 3 / Health 8 / Sanity 6
cards.flavor:
"The magic is in my blood.
Coursing through my veins.
Pumping through my heart."

cards.name: Dark Memory
cards.text:
Advanced.
Place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance.
Forced - If Dark Memory is in your hand at the end of your turn, reveal it and take 2 horror.

cards.name: Heirloom of Hyperborea
cards.text:
Agnes Baker deck only. Advanced.
Only damage and/or horror from player card effects can be assigned to Heirloom of Hyperborea.
REACTION After you play a [[Spell]] card: Draw 1 card.

cards.name: "I've had worse…"
cards.text:
Fast. Play when you are dealt damage and/or horror.
Cancel up to 2 damage and/or horror just dealt to you. Then, gain that many resources.

cards.name: "You owe me one!"
cards.text: Look at another investigator's hand. You may play a non-weakness card in that investigator's hand, under your control. If you do, you and that investigator each draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "Yeah, yeah, sure. That's what you said the last 3 times."

cards.name: Blood-Rite
cards.text:
Bonded (Occult Lexicon).
Draw 2 cards. Discard up to 2 cards from your hand. For each card thusly discarded, you may either gain 1 resource, or spend 1 resource to deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

cards.name: Double, Double
cards.text:
Exceptional.
REACTION After you play an event, exhaust Double, Double: Play that event again as if it were in your hand.
cards.flavor:
Harpier cries, "'Tis time, 'tis time."
- William Shakespeare, Macbeth

cards.name: Eucatastrophe
cards.text:
Fast. Play when you reveal a chaos token that would reduce your skill value to 0 during a skill test (including the AUTO FAIL token).
Cancel that token and treat it as an ELDER SIGN token, instead.

cards.name: Glimpse the Unthinkable
cards.text: Shuffle any number of non-weakness cards from your hand into your deck. Draw cards until you reach your maximum hand-size. Remove Glimpse the Unthinkable from the game.
cards.flavor: Ignorance is a bliss you cannot afford.

cards.name: Hallowed Mirror
cards.text:
Limit 1 per deck.
Forced - After Hallowed Mirror enter play: Search your bonded cards for 3 copies of Soothing Melody. Add 1 to your hand and shuffle the other 2 into your deck. When Hallowed Mirror leaves play, find each of those copies of Soothing Melody (even if they are out of play) and set them aside, out of play.

cards.name: Lure
cards.text:
Attach to your location or to a connecting location.
During the enemy phase, each enemy that moves does so along the shortest path toward the attached location, instead of to where it would normally move.
 Forced - While attached, at the end of the round: Discard Lure.

cards.name: Occult Lexicon
cards.text:
Limit 1 per deck.

cards.name: Sixth Sense
cards.text: ACTION: Investigate. Investigate using WILLPOWER instead of INTELLECT. You get +2 WILLPOWER for this investigation. If a SKULL, CULTIST, TABLET, or ELDER THING symbol is revealed during this test, you may choose a revealed location up to 2 connections away from your current location; you are now investigating as if you were at the chosen location in addition to your location (you may use either shroud value).

cards.name: Soothing Melody
cards.text:
Bonded (Hallowed Mirror).
Heal 2 damage or 2 horror (or any combination thereof) from among investigators and/or [[Ally]] assets at your location. Draw 1 card.
cards.flavor:
...Et leur chanson se mêle au clair de lune,
Au calme clair de lune triste et beau...
- Paul Verlaine, "Clair de Lune"

cards.name: Wither
cards.text: ACTION: Fight. This attack uses WILLPOWER instead of COMBAT. You get +2 WILLPOWER for this attack. If a SKULL, CULTIST, TABLET, or ELDER THING symbol is revealed during this attack, the attacked enemy gets -1 fight, -1 health, and -1 evade for the remainder of the turn (to a minimum of 1).

sets.name: The Blob That Ate Everything ELSE!

cards.name: Ravenous
cards.text:
Subject 5U-21 deck only. Permanent.
Each time you devour a card, place it facedown beneath Ravenous. You get +1 to each of your skills for each card beneath Ravenous (max +5).
Forced - If there are 5 or more cards beneath Ravenous: Flip it over.

cards.name: Ravenous
cards.text:
Subject 5U-21 deck only. Permanent.
Each time you devour a card, set it aside, out of play. You get +1 to each of your skills for each card beneath Ravenous (max +5).
Forced - At the end of your turn: Devour a non-story card beneath Ravenous or controlled by an investigator at your location. If there is nothing beneath Ravenous, flip it over.

cards.name: Reality Acid
cards.text: Revelation - If Ravenous (Controlled Hunger) is face up, flip it over. You devour a random aspect of reality. Reveal a random chaos token from the chaos bag and consult Reality Acid reference card to determine what you devoured.

cards.name: Reality Acid
cards.text:
Subject 5U-21 Devours...
(If the chaos token revealed is not listed, or if the listed aspect cannot be devoured, reveal a new chaos token and consult the list again.)
- ELDER SIGN: ...a non-[[Elite]] enemy or treachery, at your location and worth no victory points.
- +1: ...the top card of each investigator's discard pile.
- 0: ...the top card of each investigator's deck.
- -1: ...1 card at random from your hand.
- -2: ...a non-story, non-weakness asset controlled by an investigator at your location.
- -3: ...a player card attached to your location, or attached to an encounter card at your location.
- -4: ...the top 2 cards of each investigator's deck.
- -5: ...-3 cards of your choice from your hand.

cards.name: Reality Acid
cards.text:
- -6: ...all events from each investigator's hand.
- -7: ...a non-story, non-weakness asset from each investigator's play area.
- -8: ...a non-weakness siganture card in any player's deck, hand, discard pile, or play area.
- SKULL: ...1 card beneath Ravenous, at random.
- CULTIST: ...each card committed to each skill test at your location (after the test ends), until the end of the next investigation phase.
- TABLET: ...each event played by investigators at your location, until the end of the next investigation phase.
- ELDER THING: ...the player card at your location with the most evidence, supplies, ammo, charges, or secrets on it.
- AUTO FAIL: Reveal 3 more chaos tokens and resolve each of those devour effects.

cards.name: Regurgitation
cards.text:
Subject 5U-21 deck only.
Fast. Play only during your turn.
If Ravenous (Uncontrolled Hunger) is face up, flip it over. Choose and return up to 3 cards you devoured (beneath Ravenous or set-aside) to their owners' hands. For each card returned in this way, heal 1 damage or 1 horror.

cards.name: Subject 5U-21
cards.text:
You begin the game with Ravenous (Controlled Hunger) in play.
During each upkeep phase, draw 1 additional card and devour a non-weakness player card in your hand.
FAST: Devour a non-story card controlled by an investigator at your location. (Limit once per round.)
ELDER SIGN effect: +2. After this test ends, you may add a devoured card to its owner's hand.

[Back]
Deck Size: 50.
Deckbuilding Options: Neutral cards level 0-5, cards from any class level 0.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Ravenous, 3 copies of Regurgitation, 3 copies of Reality Acid, 2 random basic weaknesses.
Deckbuilding Restrictions: No permanents except story and signature permanents.
Additional Requirements: Your deck must include at least 7 cards from each class (GUARDIAN, SEEKER, ROGUE, MYSTIC, and SURVIVOR).
Additional Upgrade Options: After each scenario ends, separate each card you devoured (beneath Ravenous and set-aside) by class. Before the next scenario in this campaign, you may spend experience to purchase or upgrade 1 or more cards of any level from the class with the most devoured cards (if there is a tie, choose one).

FAST Add 1 doom to Blood Pact: You get +3 COMBAT for this skill test. (Limit once per test.)

Draw 3 cards.

cards.name: Scrapper

Permanent.

FAST Spend 1 resource: You get +1 AGILITY for this skill test.

cards.name: Streetwise
cards.text:
Permanent.

FAST Spend 2 resources: You get +3 AGILITY for this skill test.

cards.text:
You get +1 WILLPOWER, +1 INTELLECT, and -2 sanity.
REACTION When you would be defeated by horror, discard St. Hubert's Key: Immediately heal 2 horror.

Permanent. Exceptional.

cards.name: Suggestion

cards.text: Reveal the top 5 cards of your deck (8 cards instead if you control 2 or more clues). Draw 3 of them and place the rest of those cards on the top and/or bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Will of the Cosmos
cards.text: Place 1 doom on a player card you control. Then, discover 1 clue at your location and 1 clue at another revealed location.
cards.flavor: In the cosmos, all are one. In the void, all is none.

cards.name: Winchester Model 12
cards.text:
Uses (3 ammo).
ACTION Spend 1 ammo: Fight (COMBAT). You get +3 COMBAT for this attack. If you succeed, this attack deals +1 damage for each point you succeed by (to a maximum of +4). If you fail and would deal damage to another investigator, this attack deals 1 damage for each point you fail by (to a maximum of 5 damage).

cards.name: Wounded
cards.text:
Revelation - Put Wounded into play in your threat area.
Forced - The first time you move each turn: Take 1 damage.
ACTIONACTION: Discard Wounded.

cards.name: "Eat lead!"
cards.text:
Fast. Play when you activate the Fight ability on a [[Firearm]] asset.
You may spend X additional ammo tokens from that asset. When you reveal chaos tokens for this attack, reveal X additional chaos tokens. Choose one to resolve and ignore the rest.

cards.name: Armor of Ardennes
cards.text: REACTION When damage is assigned to Armor of Ardennes, exhaust Armor of Ardennes: Cancel 1 of that damage.

cards.name: Charon's Obol
cards.text:
Permanent. Exceptional.
When earning experience during the resolution of a scenario, if you were not defeated during that scenario, you earn 2 additional experience. If you were defeated during that scenario, you are killed.

cards.name: Cheat Death
cards.text:
Fast. Play when you would be defeated.
Disengage from each enemy engaged with you, discard all cards in your threat area, heal 2 horror and 2 damage, and move to any revealed location with no enemies. If it is your turn, end your turn. Remove Cheat Death from the game.

cards.name: Eidetic Memory
cards.text: Play Eidetic Memory as an exact copy of an [[Insight]] event in any investigator's discard pile (including its resource cost). Remove that event from the game. Remove Eidetic Memory from the game instead of discarding it.

cards.name: Infighting
cards.text:
Fast. Play after the enemy phase begins.
Cancel all attacks made by non-[[Elite]] enemies against you this phase.

cards.name: Key of Ys
cards.text:
You get +1 to each of your skills for each horror on Key of Ys.
Forced - When any amount of horror would be placed on you: Place 1 of that horror on Key of Ys.
Forced - When Key of Ys leaves play: Discard the top 10 cards of your deck.

cards.name: Lupara
cards.text:
Uses (2 ammo).
Playing Lupara does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
ACTION Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +1 COMBAT and deal +1 damage for this attack. If Lupara entered play this turn, you get an additional +1 COMBAT and deal an additional +1 damage for this attack.

cards.name: Newspaper
cards.text:
You get +2 INTELLECT while investigating if you have no clues.
REACTION When you would discover 1 or more clues at your location, if you have no clues: Discover an additional clue at your location.
cards.flavor: There's nothing in the headlines about the horrors you've witnessed. But the obituaries section is disturbingly long.

cards.name: No Stone Unturned
cards.text:
Fast. Play during any FAST player window.
Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator searches his or her deck for a card, draws it, and shuffles his or her deck.

cards.name: Seal of the Elder Sign
cards.text:
Do not reveal chaos tokens from the chaos bag for this test. Treat the chaos token revealed for this test as an ELDER SIGN.
When this test ends, remove Seal of the Elder Sign from the game.

cards.name: Time Warp
cards.text:
Fast. Play immediately after an investigator at your location finishes resolving an action during his or her turn.
Undo that action (return the game state to exactly the way it was before that action was performed, except for the playing of Time Warp and its costs).

cards.name: Abyssal Tome
cards.text: ACTION Exhaust Abyssal Tome: Fight. You may use either INTELLECT or WILLPOWER for this attack, instead of COMBAT. When you initiate this attack, you may place 1 doom on Abyssal Tome (to a maximum of 3). You get +1 skill value and deal +1 damage for this attack for each doom on Abyssal Tome.

cards.name: Blood Pact
cards.text:
FAST Add 1 doom to Blood Pact: You get +2 WILLPOWER for this skill test. (Limit once per test.)
FAST Add 1 doom to Blood Pact: You get +2 COMBAT for this skill test. (Limit once per test.)

cards.name: Butterfly Effect
cards.text:
Fast. Play when a chaos token with a symbol is revealed during a skill test at your location (before resolving its effects).
You or the performing investigator may either commit a card to this skill test, or return a card they committed to this test to their hand.

cards.name: Gaze of Ouraxsh
cards.text: Reveal 7 random chaos tokens from the chaos bag. Deal a total of 1 damage plus 1 additional damage for each CURSE or AUTO FAIL token revealed, divided as you choose among enemies at your location. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

cards.name: Keen Eye
cards.text:
FAST Spend 2 resources: You get +1 INTELLECT until the end of the phase.
FAST Spend 2 resources: You get +1 COMBAT until the end of the phase.

cards.name: Manipulate Destiny
cards.text:
Reveal tokens from the chaos bag until you reveal a CURSE, AUTO FAIL, BLESS, or ELDER SIGN token. If you revealed...
- ...a CURSE or AUTO FAIL token, deal 2 damage to an enemy at your location.
- ...a BLESS or ELDER SIGN token, heal 2 damage from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location.
This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

cards.name: Priest of Two Faiths
cards.text:
REACTION After Priest of Two Faiths enters play: Add 3 BLESS tokens to the chaos bag.
Forced - At the end of the upkeep phase: You must either add 1 CURSE token to the chaos bag or discard Priest of Two Faiths.

cards.name: Radiant Smite
cards.text: Fight. You may use WILLPOWER instead of COMBAT for this attack. When you initiate this attack, search the chaos bag for up to 3 BLESS tokens, and seal them here. For each BLESS token sealed on Radiant Smite, you get +1 skill value and deal +1 damage for this attack. If this attack defeats the attacked enemy, return the sealed tokens to the token pool. Otherwise, release them.

cards.name: The Truth Beckons
cards.text:
Play only if you are not engaged with an enemy.
Move. Choose an unrevealed location. Move (one location at a time) along the shortest path toward that location, until you enter that location. End this effect if you reveal a location, if an enemy engages you, or if your movement is blocked.

cards.name: Third Time's a Charm
cards.text:
Fast. Play when a skill test at your location begins.
Twice during this test, when an investigator reveals a chaos token, they may cancel it, return it to the chaos bag, and reveal a new chaos token.

cards.name: Under Surveillance
cards.text:
Attach to your location. Limit 1 per location.
Forced - After a non-[[Elite]] enemy enters attached location, discard Under Surveillance: Automatically evade that enemy and discover 1 clue at attached location. That enemy does not ready during the next upkeep phase.

cards.name: Gloria Goldberg
cards.text:
You choose the investigator order during the mythos phase.
REACTION When you look at 1 or more cards from the encounter deck: Look at 1 additional card and choose 1 non-[[Elite]] card among them. Either discard it, put it on top of the encounter deck, or place it facedown beneath Gloria Goldberg (max 3 cards beneath her).
ELDER SIGN effect: +1. Look at the top card of the encounter deck.

[Back]
Deck Size: 30.
Secondary Class Choice: At deck creation, choose Guardian (GUARDIAN), Seeker (SEEKER), or Rogue (ROGUE).
Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards (MYSTIC) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 10 level 0-1 events and/or skills of your chosen secondary class.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): 3 copies of Psychic Sensitivity, 3 copies of Prophecy of the End (shuffled into the encounter deck), 1 random basic weakness.
cards.stats: WIL 5 INT 4 COM 2 AGI 1 / Health 5 / Sanity 9

cards.name: Liber Omnium Finium
cards.text:
Gloria Goldberg deck only. Replacement.
Revelation - Draw a random non-weakness encounter card from beneath Gloria Goldberg. That card gains peril, its effects cannot be canceled, and you get -2 to all skills while resolving its effects. If that card is an enemy, it immediately attacks you. If no card is drawn by this effect, shuffle this card back into your deck.

cards.name: Ruth Westmacott
cards.text:
Gloria Goldberg deck only. Replacement.
REACTION When an investigator fights, attempts to evade, or initiates a skill test on an encounter card, discard an encounter card that shares a [[Trait]] with that encounter card from beneath Gloria Goldberg: Reduce the difficulty of this skill test by 2.

cards.name: .35 Winchester
cards.text:
Uses (5 ammo).
ACTION Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 COMBAT for this attack. If a +1, 0, or ELDER SIGN chaos token is revealed during this attack, this attack deals +2 damage.

cards.name: Burglary
cards.text: ACTION Exhaust Burglary: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, gain 2 resources, +1 additional resource for each point you succeed by (to a maximum of +3 resources).

cards.name: Extensive Research
cards.text:
Reduce the cost to play Extensive Research by 1 for each other card in your hand.
Discover 2 clues at your location.
cards.flavor:
"Nothing in here, either. How many do we have left?"
"... See the wall behind you?"

cards.name: Lucid Dreaming
cards.text: Choose a card in your play area or reveal a card in your hand. Search your deck for another copy of that card and draw it. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: "... all life is only a set of pictures in the brain, among which there is no difference betwixt those born of real things and those born of inward dreamings..." - H. P. Lovecraft, "The Silver Key"

cards.name: Moonstone
cards.text:
You get +1 WILLPOWER and +1 AGILITY.
You cannot play or commit Moonstone from your hand.
REACTION After you discard Moonstone from your hand: Play it (paying its cost).

cards.name: Practice Makes Perfect
cards.text:
Fast. Play during a skill test at your location.
Search the top 9 cards of your deck for a [[Practiced]] skill and commit it to this skill test, if able. Shuffle the remaining cards back into your deck. After this test ends, if it was successful, add that skill to your hand instead of discarding it.

cards.name: Safeguard
cards.text: REACTION During another investigator's turn, exhaust Safeguard: For the remainder of that investigator's turn, as they move from your location to a connecting location, you may move to that location as well.
cards.flavor:
Keep an eye out for any trouble, she told me.
I rolled my eyes. There was always trouble.

cards.name: Sharp Vision
cards.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
While Sharp Vision is committed during a basic investigate action, it gains INTELLECT INTELLECT and the text: "If this test is successful by 2 or more, discover 1 additional clue at this location."

cards.name: Spectral Razor
cards.text: Fight. Add your WILLPOWER value to your skill value for this attack. Immediately before this attack, you may engage the attacked enemy. This attack deals +1 damage (+2 damage instead if the enemy is non-[[Elite]]).

cards.name: Three Aces
cards.text:
Myriad.
If you commit 3 copies of Three Aces to a skill test, that test automatically succeeds (do not reveal chaos tokens from the chaos bag). Then draw 3 cards and gain 3 resources (max once per test).

cards.name: Word of Command
cards.text: Name a [[Spell]] card. Search your deck for 1 copy of the named card and draw it. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor:
Light for the saving of our eyes.
Heat for the saving of our skin.
A spark for the saving of our souls.

cards.name: "Ashcan" Pete
cards.text:
You begin the game with Duke in play.
FAST Discard a card from your hand: Ready an asset you control. (Limit once per round.)
ELDER SIGN effect: +2. Ready Duke.

[Back]
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards (SURVIVOR) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to five other level 0 cards from any other class.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Duke, Wracked by Nightmares, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.stats: WIL 4 INT 2 COM 2 AGI 3 / Health 6 / Sanity 5
cards.flavor: "C'mere, boy. We got work to do."

cards.name: Bait and Switch
cards.text: Evade. If you succeed, if the enemy is non-[[Elite]], evade the enemy and move it to a connecting location.

cards.name: Bind Monster
cards.text:
Evade. This evasion attempt uses WILLPOWER instead of AGILITY. If you succeed and the enemy is non‑[[Elite]], evade it and attach Bind Monster to it.
REACTION When attached enemy would ready: Test WILLPOWER (3). If you succeed, attached enemy does not ready. If you fail, discard Bind Monster.

cards.name: Blackjack
cards.text: ACTION: Fight. You get +1 COMBAT for this attack. If you perform this attack against an enemy engaged with another investigator and you fail, you deal no damage.

cards.name: Chronophobia
cards.text:
Revelation - Place Chronophobia into play in your threat area.
Forced - At the end of your turn: Take 1 direct horror.
ACTIONACTION: Discard Chronophobia.

cards.name: Clarity of Mind
cards.text:
Uses (3 charges).
ACTION Spend 1 charge: Heal 1 horror from an investigator at your location.
cards.flavor: From the unreal lead me to the realFrom the darkness lead me to the lightFrom the dead lead me to the immortal

cards.name: Double or Nothing
cards.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
Double the difficulty of this skill test. If this skill test is successful, resolve the effects of the successful test twice.

cards.name: Duke
cards.text:
"Ashcan" Pete deck only.
ACTION Exhaust Duke: Fight. You attack with a base COMBAT skill of 4. This attack deals +1 damage.
ACTION Exhaust Duke: Investigate. You investigate with a base INTELLECT skill of 4. You may move to a connecting location immediately before investigating with this effect.

cards.name: Final Rhapsody
cards.text: Revelation - Reveal 5 chaos tokens from the chaos bag. For each SKULL and AUTO FAIL token revealed, take 1 damage and 1 horror.
cards.flavor: When the dead start talking about what scares them, that's when it's time to listen.

cards.name: Fire Axe
cards.text:
ACTION: Fight. If you have no resources in your resource pool, this attack deals +1 damage.
FAST During an attack using Fire Axe, spend 1 resource: You get +2 COMBAT for this skill test. (Limit three times per attack.)

cards.name: Hired Muscle
cards.text:
You get +1 COMBAT.
Forced - At the end of the upkeep phase: You must either pay 1 resource or discard Hired Muscle.

cards.name: Indebted
cards.text:
Permanent.
You start each game with 2 fewer resources.
cards.flavor: One man's loan is another man's treasure.

cards.name: Internal Injury
cards.text:
Revelation - Place Internal Injury into play in your threat area.
Forced - At the end of your turn: Take 1 direct damage.
ACTIONACTION: Discard Internal Injury.

cards.name: Jenny Barnes
cards.text:
You collect 1 additional resource during each upkeep phase.
ELDER SIGN effect: +1 for each resource you have.

[Back]
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards (ROGUE) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to five other level 0 cards from any other class.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Jenny's Twin .45s, Searching for Izzie, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.stats: WIL 3 INT 3 COM 3 AGI 3 / Health 8 / Sanity 7
cards.flavor: "No more 'Miss Barnes' from you. My friends call me Jenny."

cards.name: Jenny's Twin .45s
cards.text:
Jenny Barnes deck only. Uses (X ammo).
ACTION Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 COMBAT for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage.
cards.flavor: "...Say, are those Mr. Donohue's guns?" Jenny held a pistol over her shoulder and struck a pose. "I think they suit me better than him. Don't you agree?"

cards.name: Jim Culver
cards.text:
Treat the modifier on SKULL tokens you reveal as "0."
Anytime you reveal a ELDER SIGN token, you may choose to instead treat it as a SKULL token.
ELDER SIGN effect: +1.

[Back]
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards (MYSTIC) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to five other level 0 cards from any other class.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Jim's Trumpet, Final Rhapsody, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.stats: WIL 4 INT 3 COM 3 AGI 2 / Health 7 / Sanity 8
cards.flavor: "No, not quiet at all. Dead folks get downright rambunctious when I play my horn."

cards.name: Jim's Trumpet
cards.text:
Jim Culver deck only.
REACTION When a SKULL token is revealed during a skill test, exhaust Jim's Trumpet: Heal 1 horror from an investigator at your location or a connecting location.
cards.flavor: Daddy used to say, "Jazz is a lot like liquor, it makes everything go down a little smoother." Daddy used to say a lot of stupid things.

cards.name: Kukri
cards.text: ACTION: Fight. You get +1 COMBAT for this attack. If you succeed, you may spend 1 additional action to deal +1 damage for this attack.

cards.name: Liquid Courage
cards.text:
Uses (4 supplies).
ACTION Spend 1 supply: Choose an investigator at your location to heal 1 horror. Then, that investigator tests WILLPOWER (2). If the test succeeds, he or she heals 1 additional horror. If the test fails, he or she discards 1 card at random from his or her hand.

cards.name: Peter Sylvestre
cards.text:
You get +1 AGILITY.
REACTION After your turn ends: Heal 1 horror from Peter Sylvestre.
cards.flavor: The broad-shouldered young man exudes the sort of confidence one only finds in youth.

cards.name: Peter Sylvestre
cards.text:
You get +1 AGILITY and +1 WILLPOWER.
REACTION After your turn ends: Heal 1 horror from Peter Sylvestre.
cards.flavor: The broad-shouldered young man exudes the sort of confidence one only finds in youth.

cards.name: Rex Murphy
cards.text:
REACTION After you succeed at a skill test by 2 or more while investigating: Discover 1 clue at your location.
ELDER SIGN effect: +2. You may instead choose to automatically fail this skill test to draw 3 cards.

[Back]
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards (SEEKER) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to five other level 0 cards from any other class.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Search for the Truth, Rex's Curse, 1 random basic weakness.
Deckbuilding Restrictions: No [[Fortune]] cards.
cards.stats: WIL 3 INT 4 COM 2 AGI 3 / Health 6 / Sanity 9
cards.flavor: "This time, nothing will stop me from getting at the truth!"

cards.name: Rex's Curse
cards.text:
Revelation - Put Rex's Curse into play in your threat area.
Forced - When you would succeed at a skill test: Return the revealed chaos token to the bag and reveal a new chaos token. If this effect causes you to fail the test, shuffle Rex's Curse into your deck. (Limit once per test.)

cards.name: Rite of Seeking
cards.text:
Uses (3 charges).
ACTION Spend 1 charge: Investigate. Investigate using WILLPOWER instead of INTELLECT. If you succeed, discover 1 additional clue at this location. If a SKULL, CULTIST, TABLET, ELDER THING, or AUTO FAIL symbol is revealed during this test, after this test resolves lose all remaining actions and immediately end your turn.

cards.name: Ritual Candles
cards.text: REACTION After a SKULL, CULTIST, TABLET, or ELDER THING symbol is revealed during a test you are performing: You get +1 skill value for this test.
cards.flavor: The wax tapers give off an eerie glow, and the flames move as if they are alive.

cards.name: Search for the Truth
cards.text:
Rex Murphy deck only.
Draw X cards, where X is the number of clues on Rex Murphy (to a maximum of 5).
cards.flavor: When things went his way, which wasn't often these days, Rex was a good reporter, with a nose for a story and an eye for detail... Graham McNeill, Ghouls of the Miskatonic,

cards.name: Searching for Izzie
cards.text:
Revelation - Attach Searching for Izzie to the location farthest from you.
ACTIONACTION: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, discard Searching for Izzie.
Forced - When the game ends, if Searching for Izzie is in play: Jenny Barnes suffers 1 mental trauma.

cards.name: Seeking Answers
cards.text: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering a clue at your location, discover a clue at a connecting location.
cards.flavor: Some people need to know the truth at any cost. Some truths can cut like knives.

cards.name: Shortcut
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Choose an investigator at your location. Move that investigator to a connecting location.
cards.flavor: You know this town like the back of your hand.

cards.name: Smite the Wicked
cards.text:
Revelation - Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded. Attach Smite the Wicked to that enemy and spawn it at the location farthest from you.
Forced - When the game ends, if attached enemy is in play: Zoey Samaras suffers 1 mental trauma.

cards.name: Strange Solution
cards.text: ACTION Test INTELLECT (4). If you succeed, discard Strange Solution and draw 2 cards. Record in your Campaign Log that "you have identified the solution."
cards.flavor: By all accounts, it should not even exist.

cards.name: Taunt
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Engage any number of enemies at your location.
cards.flavor: You steel your nerves and shout into the darkness. "Come and get me!"

cards.name: Taunt
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Engage any number of enemies at your location. Draw 1 card for each enemy engaged in this way.
cards.flavor: You steel your nerves and shout into the darkness. "Come and get me!"

cards.name: Teamwork
cards.text: Investigators at your location may give or trade any number of [[Item]] assets, [[Ally]] assets, or resources among one another.
cards.flavor: It's dangerous to go alone.

cards.name: Think on Your Feet
cards.text:
Fast. Play when an enemy would spawn at your location.
Immediately move to a connecting location. (The enemy still spawns at your previous location.)

cards.name: Wracked by Nightmares
cards.text:
Revelation - Exhaust all assets you control and put Wracked by Nightmares into play in your threat area.
Assets you control cannot ready.
ACTIONACTION: Discard Wracked by Nightmares.

cards.name: Zoey Samaras
cards.text:
REACTION After you become engaged with an enemy: Gain 1 resource.
ELDER SIGN effect: +1. If this skill test is successful during an attack, that attack deals +1 damage.

[Back]
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards (GUARDIAN) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to five other level 0 cards from any other class.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Zoey's Cross, Smite the Wicked, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.stats: WIL 4 INT 2 COM 4 AGI 2 / Health 9 / Sanity 6
cards.flavor: "God has spoken. I will do His work without hesitation."

cards.name: Zoey's Cross
cards.text:
Zoey Samaras deck only.
REACTION After an enemy becomes engaged with you, exhaust Zoey's Cross and spend 1 resource: Deal 1 damage to that enemy.

cards.name: Leading Lady (Enchantress)
cards.text:
Lola Hayes deck only. Replacement.
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Play a card from your hand, regardless of your current role (paying its cost). If that card was a Mystic (MYSTIC) card, you may either draw 1 card or remove 1 doom from a player card at your location.
cards.flavor: "The trick is to only show them what you want them to see."

cards.name: Leading Lady (Femme Fatale)
cards.text:
Lola Hayes deck only. Replacement.
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Play a card from your hand, regardless of your current role (paying its cost). If that card was a Rogue (ROGUE) card, you may either draw 1 card or immediately take an evade action.
cards.flavor: "Trust me, honey, I'm lead material."

cards.name: Leading Lady (Final Girl)
cards.text:
Lola Hayes deck only. Replacement.
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Play a card from your hand, regardless of your current role (paying its cost). If that card was a Survivor (SURVIVOR) card, you may either draw 1 card or heal 1 damage/horror.
cards.flavor: "Come on, Lola, just make it to the final bow."

cards.name: Leading Lady (Heroine)
cards.text:
Lola Hayes deck only. Replacement.
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Play a card from your hand, regardless of your current role (paying its cost). If that card was a Guardian (GUARDIAN) card, you may either draw 1 card or immediately take a fight action.
cards.flavor: "I'm done waiting in the wings."

cards.name: Leading Lady (Mentor)
cards.text:
Lola Hayes deck only. Replacement.
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Play a card from your hand, regardless of your current role (paying its cost). If that card was a Seeker (SEEKER) card, you may either draw 1 card or immediately take an investigate action.
cards.flavor: "I've learned a thing or two on stage."

cards.name: Lola Hayes
cards.text:
You begin the game in the Neutral role.
You can only play or commit Neutral cards or cards of your current role.
Forced - When your turn begins: Switch your role (GUARDIAN, SEEKER, ROGUE, MYSTIC, SURVIVOR, or Neutral).
ELDER SIGN effect: +2. You may switch roles.

[Back]
Deck size: 40.
Class Choices: At deck creation, choose 2 classes (GUARDIAN, SEEKER, ROGUE, MYSTIC, or SURVIVOR).
Deckbuilding Options: Neutral cards level 0-5, cards from your chosen classes level 0-4, cards from other classes level 0-1.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): 2 copies of Improvisation, 2 copies of Crisis of Identity, 1 random basic weakness.
Additional Requirements: Your deck must include at least 6 cards from each class (GUARDIAN, SEEKER, ROGUE, MYSTIC, and SURVIVOR).
cards.stats: WIL 3 INT 3 COM 3 AGI 3 / Health 6 / Sanity 6

cards.name: Samuel Blake
cards.text:
Lola Hayes deck only. Replacement. Peril. Hidden.
While Samuel Blake is in your hand, you cannot switch roles or play cards belonging to another role.
While Samuel Blake is in play, as an additional cost for you to switch your role, you must take 1 horror.

sets.name: Edge of the Earth Investigator Expansion

cards.name: "Get behind me!"
cards.text:
Fast. Play during any FAST window.
Until the end of the phase, whenever an enemy would attack another investigator at your location, it attacks you instead, then engages you. Cancel 1 horror dealt by each attack made in this way.

cards.name: "Hit me!"
cards.text:
Fast. Play after you reveal a chaos token during a skill test.
Reveal an additional chaos token, switching its "-" to a "+". If that chaos token is a SKULL token, you automatically fail.

cards.name: 21 or Bust
cards.text:
One at a time, reveal random tokens from the chaos bag until you choose to stop. Treat each SKULL, CULTIST, TABLET, or ELDER THING as a 5; the AUTO FAIL as a 10; and the ELDER SIGN as either a 1 or an 11. If the combined value of those tokens (ignoring +/-) is...
- ...18 or less, gain 4 resources.
- ...19, gain 5 resources.
- ...20, gain 6 resources.
- ...21, gain 9 resources.

cards.name: Antiquary
cards.text:
Uses (2 resources). Replenish these resources at the start of each round.
Resources on Antiquary may be spent to pay for [[Favor]], [[Relic]] or [[Ritual]] cards.
FAST During a skill test on a [[Favor]], [[Relic]] or [[Ritual]] card, spend 1 resource from Antiquary: You get +1 skill value for this test.

cards.name: Archive of Conduits
cards.text:
Limit 1 per deck. As an additional cost to play this asset, place 1 resource on 4 different locations, as leylines.
REACTION After you successfully investigate a location with a leyline, exhaust this asset: Move that leyline onto this asset. Then, if there are 4 leylines on it, discard it, take its leylines as resources, and record in your Campaign Log that "you have identified the gateway."

cards.name: Archive of Conduits
cards.text:
Researched. Uses (4 leylines). Limit 1 per deck.
FAST: Move 1 leyline from this asset to a non-[[Elite]] enemy.
ACTION: Choose an investigator, and an enemy with a leyline at a revealed location. That investigator moves to that location. You may remove the leyline to deal 1 damage to that enemy.

REACTION After you succeed at a skill test by 2 or more, exhaust Precious Memento: Heal 1 damage from it.

cards.name: Professor William Webb

Uses (3 secrets).
REACTION When you successfully investigate, exhaust Professor William Webb and spend 1 secret: Instead of discovering a clue at your location, either choose an [[Item]] card in your discard pile and add it to your hand, or discover a clue at a connecting location.

cards.name: Prophesiae Profana
cards.text:
While you are not at the locus, you get +1 INTELLECT, +1 AGILITY, and you may ignore attacks of opportunity.
REACTION After Prophesiae Profana enters play: Choose a revealed location. That location is "the locus" until Prophesiae Profana leaves play.
ACTION: Move any investigator to the locus.

cards.name: Prophetic
cards.text:
Uses (2 resources). Replenish these resources at the start of each round.

FAST During a skill test on a [[Fortune]], [[Spell]], or [[Spirit]] card, spend 1 resource from Prophetic: You get +1 skill value for this test.

cards.name: Protecting the Anirniq
cards.text:
Fast. Play after an [[Ally]] asset at your location is discarded by a card effect or is defeated.
Either return that asset to its owner's hand, or its owner draws 3 cards.
cards.flavor:
All living things have breath.
Be careful they do not curse you with theirs.

cards.name: Protective Gear
cards.text: REACTION When you draw a [[Hazard]] treachery, deal 1 damage and 1 horror to Protective Gear: Cancel that card's revelation effect.
cards.flavor: After what you've seen, you intend to sleep in it.

cards.name: Quickdraw Holster
cards.text:
FAST: Choose a [[Firearm]] asset taking up only 1 hand slot in your play area. Attach it to Quickdraw Holster, or switch it with the attached asset. The attached asset takes up no hand slots. (Limit 1 attached asset.)
FAST Exhaust Quickdraw Holster: Perform a fight action on the attached asset without paying its ACTION cost.

cards.name: Rod of Animalism
cards.text:
You have 2 additional ally slots, which can only be used to hold [[Creature]] assets.
REACTION When you play a [[Creature]] asset during your turn: Reduce that asset's cost by 1.

cards.name: Savant
cards.text: Savant gains WILD icons equal to your lowest skill other than the skill being tested.
cards.flavor: Fifty percent luck, a hundred percent skill.

cards.name: Schoffner's Catalogue
cards.text:
Uses (5 secrets). If Schoffner's Catalogue has no secrets, discard it.
You may spend secrets on Schoffner's Catalogue as resources to pay for [[Item]] assets played by any investigator at your location.

cards.name: Scientific Theory
cards.text:
Fast. Limit 1 [[Composure]] in play.
You get +1 INTELLECT and +1 COMBAT.
Non-direct damage/horror must be assigned to Scientific Theory before it can be assigned to your investigator card.
FAST Spend 1 resource: You get +1 INTELLECT or +1 COMBAT for this skill test.

cards.name: Scout Ahead
cards.text: Move. Move up to 3 times. Enemies do not engage you during this movement.
cards.flavor: "... a viewless aura repelled me and bade me retreat from antique and sinister secrets that no man should see, and no man else had ever dared to see." - H. P. Lovecraft, "The Nameless City"

cards.name: Short Supply
cards.text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per deck. Purchase at deck creation.
Forced - When your first turn of the game begins: Discard the top 10 cards of your deck.
cards.flavor: You can only pray that it's enough.

cards.name: Shrewd Dealings
cards.text:
Bob Jenkins deck only.
Reduce the cost of each [[Item]] asset you play by 1.
REACTION When you play an [[Item]] asset: Play it under the control of any investigator at your location.
cards.flavor: "You say the 'end of the world.' I hear 'business opportunity.'"

cards.name: Sled Dog
cards.text:
You may include up to 4 copies of Sled Dog in your deck. Up to 2 Sled Dog cards take up a single ally slot.
ACTION Exhaust X Sled Dogs: Move. Move X times.
ACTION Exhaust X Sled Dogs: Fight. You get +X COMBAT for this attack. Instead of its standard damage, this attack deals X damage.

cards.name: Sledgehammer
cards.text:
ACTION: Fight. You get -1 COMBAT and deal +1 damage for this attack.
ACTIONACTION: Fight. You get +2 COMBAT and deal +2 damage for this attack.
cards.flavor: Twenty pounds of steel vengeance.

cards.name: Sledgehammer
cards.text:
ACTION: Fight. You get +1 COMBAT and deal +1 damage for this attack.
ACTIONACTIONACTION: Fight. You get +5 COMBAT and deal +5 damage for this attack.
cards.flavor: Twenty-five pounds of steel vengeance.

cards.name: Sleuth
cards.text:

FAST During a skill test on a [[Charm]], [[Tactic]], or [[Tome]] card, spend 1 resource from Sleuth: You get +1 skill value for this test.

cards.name: Snipe
cards.text: During the next fight action you perform this turn using a [[Ranged]] or [[Firearm]] asset, treat each SKULL, CULTIST, TABLET, ELDER THING, or AUTO FAIL token you reveal as a "0" token. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

cards.name: Strength in Numbers
cards.text: Strength in Numbers gains a WILD icon for each different class among cards you control.
cards.flavor: "Watch my back, will ya? In fact, watch my front, too."

cards.name: Stupor
cards.text:
Revelation - Put Stupor into play in your threat area.
Stupor can be healed as if it were a single point of horror on you (if it is healed, discard it).
Forced - After you take a parley, draw, or investigate action: You cannot take any of those types of actions for the remainder of the turn.

cards.name: Survey the Area
cards.text: While Survey the Area is in your hand or committed to a skill test, it gains INTELLECT icons equal to your AGILITY, and AGILITY icons equal to your INTELLECT.
cards.flavor: They won't believe you if you don't capture it on film. Hell, they probably still won't believe you.

cards.name: Sweeping Kick
cards.text: Fight. Add your AGILITY to your skill value for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. If you succeed, automatically evade the attacked enemy.
cards.flavor: "Very good, Li. Now, again."

cards.name: Talisman of Protection
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Play Talisman of Protection under the control of any investigator at your location.
REACTION When you assign damage and/or horror that would defeat you, discard Talisman of Protection: Cancel up to 2 of that damage and/or horror.

cards.name: The Harbinger
cards.text:
Revelation - Place this card on top of your deck.
While The Harbinger is revealed and on top of your deck, cards in your deck cannot be searched, drawn, or manipulated in any way except by the below ability.
ACTIONACTION: Discard The Harbinger. This ability may be activated while The Harbinger is on top of your deck, as if it were in your threat area.

cards.name: The Red Clock
cards.text:
Exceptional. Uses (0 charges).
Forced - After your turn begins: Either place 1 charge here, or take all charges here, as resources. Then, if it has exactly...
- 1 charge, you get +3 skill value for your next skill test.
- 2 charges, you may move up to 2 times.
- 3 charges, you may take an additional action this turn.

cards.name: Toe to Toe
cards.text: Fight. This attack deals +1 damage and is automatically successful. As an additional cost to perform this attack, the chosen enemy makes an attack against you.
cards.flavor: Sometimes, the only way out is through.

cards.name: True Magick
cards.text:
Uses (1 charge). Replenish this charge at the start of each round.
You may resolve abilities on [[Spell]] assets in your hand by revealing them from your hand. Treat True Magick as if it were the revealed asset (to pay its costs, spend charges, perfom its effect, etc).

cards.name: Trusty Bullwhip
cards.text:
Fast. Monterey Jack deck only.
ACTION: Fight. This attack uses AGILITY instead of COMBAT. If this attack succeeds, you may exhaust Trusty Bullwhip to either automatically evade the attacked enemy or deal +1 damage for this attack.

cards.name: Underworld Support
cards.text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per deck. Purchase at deck creation.
Your deck cannot include more than 1 copy of each non-weakness, non-signature card (by title).
Reduce your deck size by 5.

cards.name: Unearth the Ancients
cards.text: Investigate. Choose up to 2 SEEKER assets in your hand. The difficulty of this skill test is equal to the combined cost of the chosen assets. If you succeed, put the chosen assets into play, one at a time. For each [[Relic]] asset put into play by this ability, draw 1 card.

cards.name: Unscrupulous Loan
cards.text:
Limit 1 per investigator. Cannot leave play.
REACTION After you play Unscrupulous Loan: Gain 10 resources.
Forced - When the game ends or you are eliminated, if you have fewer than 10 resources in your resource pool: Exile Unscrupulous Loan.

cards.name: Untimely Transaction
cards.text: Reveal an [[Item]] asset in your hand. Another investigator at your location may play that asset as if it were in their hand. If they do, draw 1 card and gain resources equal to that asset's printed cost.
cards.flavor: "Really? You're going to haggle with me now?"

cards.name: Winds of Power
cards.text:
Place 2 charges on an asset you control.
REACTION After you draw Winds of Power during your turn: Play it.
cards.flavor: May Oya's breath guide us all.

cards.name: Written in the Stars
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Discard the top card of your deck. If that card is a weakness, shuffle it back into your deck. Otherwise, for the remainder of your turn, while that card is in your discard pile, commit it to each eligible skill test you perform.

cards.name: Anatomical Diagrams
cards.text:
Fast. Play during any investigator's turn. Play only if you have 5 or more remaining sanity.
Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location. Until the end of the active investigator's turn, that enemy gets -2 fight and -2 evade.
cards.flavor: They are just animals like any other. Or so we thought.

cards.text:

FAST Spend 1 resource: You get +1 AGILITY for this skill test.

cards.text:

cards.text:

Engage that enemy and resolve its attack against you instead. Then, deal it 1 damage.

cards.name: Knuckleduster
cards.text: ACTION: Fight. This attack deals +1 damage. The attacked enemy gains retaliate for this attack.
cards.flavor:

just the way Naomi liked it.

cards.name: Enchanted Blade
cards.text:
Uses (3 charges).
ACTION: Fight. You get +2 COMBAT for this attack. If you succeed, you may spend 1 charge to empower the blade, dealing +1 damage for this attack. If the blade is empowered and this attack defeats an enemy, draw 1 card and heal 1 horror.

cards.text:

ACTION: Fight. You get +2 COMBAT for this attack. As an additional cost to use this ability, you may spend up to 2 charges to empower the blade (for each charge spent in this way, you get +1 COMBAT and deal +1 damage for this attack).

cards.name: Grisly Totem
cards.text: REACTION After you commit a card to a skill test, exhaust Grisly Totem: That card gains another instance of one of its skill icons of your choice. If that skill test is successful, the performing investigator draws 1 card.
cards.flavor:
We should have thrown it back immediately.
But how could we have known?

cards.flavor:
We should have thrown it back immediately.
But how could we have known?

cards.text:
Uses (3 secrets).

You may add 1 of those cards to its owner's hand. Place the rest of those cards on either the top or bottom of their deck, in any order.

cards.name: Tennessee Sour Mash
cards.text:
Fast. Uses (2 supplies).

cards.text:

ACTION Discard Tennessee Sour Mash: Fight. You get +3 COMBAT for this attack. If this attack succeeds against a non-[[Elite]] enemy, automatically evade it.

cards.name: The Council's Coffer
cards.text:
Uses (1 PER INVESTIGATOR locks). If there are no locks on The Council's Coffer, each investigator searches his or her deck or discard pile for any card and immediately plays it at no cost. Exile The Council's Coffer. (Max once per campaign.)
ACTIONACTION: Test any skill (5). If you succeed, remove 1 lock. Any investigator at your location may activate this ability.
Card design by The Council at Arkham Nights 2017.

sets.name: The Feast of Hemlock Vale Investigator Expansion

cards.name: "Devil"
cards.text:
Forced - When your turn begins: Move 1 damage from your investigator to "Devil".
Forced - When "Devil" is defeated: Deal 2 damage to each enemy and investigator at your location.
cards.flavor: I will guide thy hand.

cards.name: "I'll Pay You Back!"
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Choose another investigator at your location. Move all resources from that investigator's resource pool to your resource pool. At the end of the round, move all resources from your resource pool to that investigator's resource pool.

cards.text: Fight. Choose a [[Tome]] asset you control. You get +X COMBAT for this attack, where X is that asset's printed cost. If you succeed, you may either automatically evade the attacked enemy, or after the attack ends, you may resolve an ACTION or FAST ability on the chosen asset (ignoring its ACTION cost, if any).
cards.flavor: "Kid, you... you took that a lot more literally than I expected you to."

cards.name: "Where's Pa?"
cards.text:
Revelation - Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded. Attach "Where's Pa?" to that enemy and spawn it at a connecting location, if able.
Attached enemy gains elusive.
Forced - At the end of the round: Hank Samson takes 1 direct horror.

cards.name: Absolution
cards.text:
Reveal 3 random tokens from the chaos bag, along with X additional tokens.
For each non-symbol token revealed, add 1 BLESS token to the chaos bag. For each BLESS token revealed, heal 1 horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location.

cards.name: Abyssal Rot
cards.text:
Bonded (Rod of Carnamagos).
Attached enemy cannot attack.
Forced - When attached enemy leaves play: Set Abyssal Rot aside, out of play.

cards.name: Accursed
cards.text: When you commit Accursed to a skill test, add up to 3 CURSE tokens to the chaos bag. During this skill test, treat the modifier of each CURSE token revealed as 0.
cards.flavor: Not all who wander are lost.

cards.name: Ad Hoc
cards.text:
Wilson Richards deck only.
Attach Ad Hoc to a [[Tool]] or [[Weapon]] asset you control.
REACTION After resolving an ACTION ability on attached asset, exhaust Ad Hoc and discard a [[Tool]] or [[Weapon]] asset from your hand: Resolve an ACTION ability on the discarded asset, ignoring all costs.
cards.flavor: "This is one heckuva job."

cards.name: Aember Rot
cards.text:
Bonded (Rod of Carnamagos).
Forced - When attached enemy is defeated: Gain resources equal to its printed health (to a maximum of 5).
Forced - When attached enemy leaves play: Set Aember Rot aside, out of play.

cards.name: Aetheric Current
cards.text:
Bonded (Flux Stabilizer). Play only if Flux Stabilizer is on its (Active) side.
Fight. Move all clues on assets you control to Kate Winthrop. For this attack, you may use INTELLECT instead of COMBAT. If you succeed and the attacked enemy is non-[[Elite]], you may exhaust it and move it to any location. Draw 1 card. Flip Flux Stabilizer (keeping all tokens and attachments).

cards.name: Aetheric Current
cards.text:
Bonded (Flux Stabilizer). Play only if Flux Stabilizer is on its (Active) side.
Evade. Move all clues on assets you control to Kate Winthrop. For this evasion attempt, you may use INTELLECT instead of AGILITY. If you succeed and the target of this evasion is non-[[Elite]], shuffle it into the encounter deck. Draw 1 card. Flip Flux Stabilizer (keeping all tokens and attachments).

cards.name: Alessandra Zorzi
cards.text:
You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used to parley.
ELDER SIGN effect: +2. If you succeed, choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location or at a revealed connecting location. Automatically evade that enemy.

[Back]
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards (ROGUE) level 0-5, cards with "parley" level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): 3 copies of Beguile, Zamacona, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.stats: WIL 3 INT 4 COM 2 AGI 4 / Health 7 / Sanity 7
cards.flavor: "I love a good party."

cards.name: Ancestral Token
cards.text: REACTION After you defeat an enemy, exhaust Ancestral Token: Add BLESS tokens to the chaos bag equal to that enemy's printed health (max 5).
cards.flavor: Never forget those who came before.

cards.name: Antediluvian Hymn
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play Antediluvian Hymn, spend an action.
Reveal the top 5 cards of the encounter deck. For each card revealed, you may add 1 CURSE token to the chaos bag to place that card on the bottom of the encounter deck. Return the rest to the top of the encounter deck in any order.

cards.name: Back Injury
cards.text:
Revelation - You must either put Back Injury into play in your threat area, or take 1 damage and shuffle it into your deck. It cannot leave play except by the ACTIONACTION ability below.
You get -1 health.
ACTIONACTION: Discard Back Injury.

cards.name: Bank Job
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play Bank Job, spend an action.
Investigators at your location gain a total of 8 resources, distributed as you wish.
cards.flavor:
"No names, Skids."
"Sorry, Finn."

cards.name: Beguile
cards.text:
Alessandra Zorzi deck only. Fast. Play only during your turn.
Attach Beguile to a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location.
ACTION: Parley. Either move attached enemy to a revealed connecting location, or perform a basic investigate or evade action at its location. If you fail a skill test while resolving this ability, discard Beguile. You may activate this ability from any location.

cards.name: Bewitching
cards.text:
Permanent. Exceptional.
REACTION Before you draw your opening hand: Search your deck for up to 3 different [[Trick]] cards, and attach them facedown to Bewitching. Shuffle your deck.
REACTION When you engage an enemy, exhaust Bewitching: Either draw 1 attached card, or search the top 9 cards of your deck for a copy of an attached card, draw it, and shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Bianca "Die Katz"
cards.text:
Limit 1 per deck. Uses (10 resources).
ACTION Exhaust Bianca "Die Katz": Parley. Move X resources from Bianca "Die Katz" to your resource pool. X cannot be more than 5. Test AGILITY (X). If you fail, remember "you owe Bianca X resources." Then, search your bonded cards for the Bianca "Die Katz" enemy and spawn her at your location. Remove this card from the game.

cards.name: Bianca "Die Katz"
cards.text:
Bonded (Bianca "Die Katz"). Hunter.
Prey - Bearer only.
ACTION If "you owe Bianca X resources," spend X resources: Parley. Add Bianca "Die Katz" to the victory display.
Forced - When Bianca "Die Katz" leaves play (except by the above ability): Shuffle her into your deck.

cards.name: Bide Your Time
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play Bide Your Time, spend an action.
During your next turn, you may take two additional actions.
cards.flavor: It's half past midnight, and you're starting to wonder if the whole thing's a ruse.

cards.name: Blackmail File
cards.text: ACTION Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location: Parley. Test WILLPOWER (X), where X is that enemy's printed health value. If you succeed, that enemy disengages from each investigator and gains aloof until the end of the round.

cards.name: Blade of Yoth
cards.text:
Bonded (Eyes of Valusia).
ACTION Spend 1-3 charges: Fight. For this attack, you may use WILLPOWER instead of COMBAT. You get +2 skill value and deal +1 damage for each charge spent as part of this action's cost.
FAST: Search your bonded cards for Eyes of Valusia and swap it with Blade of Yoth, discarding all charges.

cards.name: Blessed Blade
cards.text: ACTION: Fight. You get +2 COMBAT for this attack. If this attack is successful, it deals +1 damage. Return each BLESS token revealed during this attack to the chaos bag. Before revealing chaos token(s) for this attack, you may exhaust Blessed Blade to add 2 BLESS tokens to the chaos bag.

cards.name: Book of Living Myths
cards.text:
Kōhaku Narukami deck only.
REACTION When a chaos token would be revealed at your location, exhaust Book of Living Myths: Search the chaos bag for a BLESS or CURSE token, whichever there are more of (in case of a tie, you choose), and resolve it instead.

cards.name: British Bull Dog
cards.text:
Uses (3 ammo).

REACTION After you fail a skill test while parleying with an enemy: Put British Bull Dog into play from your hand.

cards.name: British Bull Dog
cards.text:
Uses (3 ammo).

REACTION After you fail a skill test while parleying with an enemy: Put British Bull Dog into play from your hand.

cards.name: Broken Diadem
cards.text:
Limit 1 per deck. Limit 1 [[Mask]] per investigator.

Then, if there are 3 offerings on this card, search your bonded cards for Twilight Diadem and swap it with this card, moving all offerings from this card to Twilight Diadem.

cards.name: Call the Beyond
cards.text:

Choose an asset you control with "uses (charges)" or "uses (secrets)". Replenish all of that asset's charges or secrets. Then, you may resolve an ACTION or FAST ability on that asset without paying its ACTION cost, if any.

- ...fail by exactly 2, discard Chemistry Set.
- ...succeed by exactly 0, gain 2 resources.
- ...succeed by exactly 2, draw 1 card.
- ...succeed by exactly 4, discover 1 additional clue at your location.

cards.name: Cleaning Kit

cards.flavor:
"It cleans! It fixes! It picks, plucks, shines, and swishes!"
-Schoffner's Catalogue, Winter 1924 ed.

cards.text:

REACTION When a supply is spent from Cleaning Kit, exhaust it: The performing investigator gets +2 skill value for this test.

cards.name: Confound
cards.text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location. Test INTELLECT (X), where X is the chosen enemy's evade value. If you succeed, discover 2 clues at your location. Then, if the chosen enemy is non-[[Elite]], automatically evade it. It does not ready during the next upkeep phase.
cards.flavor: "It'll never work, Herbert."

cards.name: Control Variable
cards.text:
Fast. Play after an investigator reveals a CURSE token during a skill test at your location.
Discover 1 clue at your location.
cards.flavor:
"There was a solution which he injected into the veins of dead things, and if they were fresh enough they responded in strange ways."
-H.P. Lovecraft, Herbert West - Reanimator

cards.name: Dark Horse
cards.text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per deck.
During the upkeep phase, you may choose to not gain resources.
While you have no resources in your resource pool, you get +1 WILLPOWER, +1 INTELLECT, +1 COMBAT, and +1 AGILITY.

cards.name: Dawn Star
cards.text:
Fast. Play after revealing chaos tokens during a skill test at your location.
Ignore the modifiers of each CURSE token revealed during this test. For each CURSE token ignored, deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.
cards.flavor: Only the strongest spirit can sunder the dark.

cards.name: Diabolical Luck
cards.text: When you reveal a CURSE token during a skill test you are performing, you may commit Diabolical Luck to that skill test from your hand. If you do, Diabolical Luck gains WILDWILDWILD.
cards.flavor: "Shoggoths. Why did it have to be shoggoths?"

cards.name: Dirty Deeds
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play Dirty Deeds, spend an action.
Search your deck for an [[Illicit]] asset and play it, paying its cost. Then, you may resolve an ACTION or FAST ability on that asset, ignoring all costs (including its ACTION cost, if any). Playing this card does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

cards.name: Dr. Charles West III
cards.text:
You have 1 additional hand slot, which can only be used to hold a [[Tool]] asset.
REACTION After you successfully investigate by exactly 1 or 3, exhaust Dr. Charles West III: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.

cards.name: Drain Essence
cards.text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location and test WILLPOWER (X), where X is the chosen enemy's fight value. If you succeed, move 1 damage from your investigator to the chosen enemy (up to 2 damage instead if the chosen enemy is non-[[Elite]]).
cards.flavor: What was yours is now mine.

cards.name: Elaborate Distraction
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play Elaborate Distraction, spend an action. Playing Elaborate Distraction does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
For each enemy at your location and at each connecting location (choose one):
- Automatically evade that enemy if it is non-[[Elite]].
- Deal 1 damage to that enemy.

cards.name: Eldritch Tongue
cards.text:
Uses (4 charges).
You may play events with "parley" from your discard pile as if they were in your hand. As an additional cost to play an event this way, spend 1 charge from Eldritch Tongue. After that event resolves, remove it from the game.

cards.name: Esoteric Method
cards.text: After this skill test ends, add 1 CURSE token to the chaos bag for each point the performing investigator either succeeded or failed by.
cards.flavor: Rumor has it the university's last phrenology professor enjoyed an unnaturally long tenure.

cards.name: Ethereal Form
cards.text: Evade. Add your WILLPOWER value to your skill value for this evasion attempt. If you succeed, disengage from each other enemy engaged with you, and for the remainder of the round, you are ethereal (enemies cannot engage or be engaged with you, and you cannot attack or deal damage to enemies). If a symbol was revealed during this evasion attempt, return Ethereal Form to your hand at the end of your turn.

cards.name: Ethereal Weaving
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play Ethereal Weaving, spend an action.
Reveal up to 3 different [[Spell]] events from your hand. One at a time, play each revealed event, reducing its cost by 1. While resolving each of these events, you get +2 skill value.

cards.name: Evanescent Ascension
cards.text:
Bonded (Miracle Wish). If Evanescent Ascension has no wishes, set it aside, out of play.
REACTION When an investigator at your location would fail a skill test, spend 1 wish and exhaust Evanescent Ascension: Resolve that investigator's ELDER SIGN effect (in addition to all other tokens revealed during this test).

cards.name: Eyes of Valusia
cards.text:
ACTION: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location. Until the end of the round, each investigator gets +1 skill value while fighting, evading, or parleying with the chosen enemy. Place 1 resource on Eyes of Valusia, as a charge.
FAST: Search your bonded cards for Blade of Yoth and swap it with Eyes of Valusia, moving all charges from Eyes of Valusia to Blade of Yoth.

cards.name: Failed Experiment
cards.text: Revelation - Test WILLPOWER (3). This test gets +1 difficulty for each asset you control with a clue on it. For each point you fail by, you must either take 1 horror or place 1 of your clues on your location.
cards.flavor: "I've made a huge mistake."

cards.name: Fake Credentials
cards.text: ACTION Choose an enemy at your location and exhaust Fake Credentials: Parley. Test INTELLECT (1). This test gets +1 difficulty for each suspicion on Fake Credentials. If you succeed, discover 1 clue at your location and place 1 resource on Fake Credentials, as suspicion. If you fail, you must either discard Fake Credentials, or the chosen enemy attacks you.

cards.name: Fake Credentials
cards.text: ACTION Choose an enemy at your location: Parley. Test INTELLECT(0). This test gets +1 difficulty for each suspicion on Fake Credentials. If you succeed, discover 1 clue at your location or a connecting location. If you did not succeed by 2 or more, place 1 resource on Fake Credentials, as suspicion. If you fail, return Fake Credentials to your hand.

cards.name: False Surrender
cards.text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location and play a [[Weapon]] asset from your hand, reducing its cost by 1. You may then take a fight action with that weapon against the chosen enemy, using AGILITY instead of the skill indicated.
cards.flavor: "You'd have made a pretty good cowboy."

cards.name: Fine Tuning
cards.text:
Attach to a [[Tool]] or [[Science]] asset you control. Limit 1 per asset.
REACTION After attached asset exhausts, exhaust Fine Tuning: Ready attached asset.
cards.flavor: "I assure you there's nothing to fear!"

cards.name: Fire Axe
cards.text:
Fast.
ACTION: Fight. If you have no resources in your resource pool, this attack deals +1 damage.
FAST During an attack using Fire Axe, spend 1 resource: You get +2 COMBAT for this skill test. (Limit three times per attack.)

cards.name: Flurry of Blows
cards.text:
Play only if you control a [[Melee]] asset. As an additional cost to play Flurry of Blows, spend an action.
Fight. Choose a [[Melee]] asset you control and take an immediate fight action with that asset (without paying its ACTION cost). You may repeat this effect up to three times. After the final attack resolves, if it is your turn, end your turn.

cards.name: Flux Stabilizer
cards.text:
Permanent. Kate Winthrop deck only.
Forced - After a clue is placed on Flux Stabilizer: Search your bonded cards or discard pile for 1 copy of Aetheric Current and shuffle it into your deck. Flip Flux Stabilizer (keeping all tokens and attachments).

cards.name: Flux Stabilizer
cards.text:
Permanent. Kate Winthrop deck only.
REACTION When you place a clue on an asset you control: Get +2 skill value for your next skill test this phase.
cards.flavor: Is this the same energy harnessed by Nikola Tesla?

cards.name: Fox Mask
cards.text:
Limit 1 [[Mask]] per investigator.
Uses (2 offerings). Replenish 1 of these offerings after you move out of a location with an enemy.
FAST Spend 1 offering: You get +2 INTELLECT or +2 AGILITY for this skill test. (Limit once per test.)

cards.name: Gabriel Carillo
cards.text:
You get +1 INTELLECT.
REACTION At the start of your turn, add 1 CURSE token to the chaos bag: Draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "Helping you is easier than teaching my students geometry."

cards.name: Grift
cards.text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location and test AGILITY (0). For each point you succeed by, gain 1 resource (to a maximum of 6). If you fail, that enemy attacks you.
cards.flavor:
"Look! A dumb bird!"
"I don't see a bird."
"I do."

cards.name: Guided by Faith
cards.text: Investigate. You may use WILLPOWER instead of INTELLECT for this investigation. Before revealing chaos tokens for this test, add 2 BLESS tokens to the chaos bag. If a BLESS or ELDER SIGN token is revealed during this skill test, discover 1 additional clue at your location.

cards.name: Hand-Eye Coordination
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Resolve an ACTION ability on a [[Tool]] or [[Weapon]] asset you control without paying its ACTION cost.
cards.flavor: Keep your eyes on the target.

cards.name: Hank Samson
cards.text:
You may be assigned damage/horror dealt to [[Ally]] assets or other investigators at your location.
REACTION When you would be defeated by damage and/or horror: Instead, heal all of your damage and horror and swap this card with its bonded [[Resolute]] version, either side faceup.
ELDER SIGN effect: +1.

[Back]
Deck Size: 35.
Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards (SURVIVOR) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 10 other [[Innate]] and/or [[Spirit]] cards level 0-2.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Stouthearted, "Where's Pa?", 1 random basic weakness.
cards.stats: WIL 3 INT 1 COM 5 AGI 3 / Health 5 / Sanity 5

cards.name: Hank Samson
cards.text:
Bonded (Hank Samson).
You cannot be healed. You may be assigned damage/horror dealt to [[Ally]] assets or other investigators at your location.
