REACTION When 1 or more horror is placed on you: Draw 1 card.
ELDER SIGN effect: +1. Move 1 horror from Hank Samson to an asset you control.
cards.stats: WIL 3 INT 3 COM 4 AGI 4 / Health 4 / Sanity 6

cards.name: Hank Samson
cards.text:
Bonded (Hank Samson).
You cannot be healed. You may be assigned damage/horror dealt to [[Ally]] assets or other investigators at your location.
REACTION When 1 or more damage is placed on you: Gain 2 resources.
ELDER SIGN effect: +1. Move 1 damage from Hank Samson to an asset you control.
cards.stats: WIL 4 INT 1 COM 6 AGI 3 / Health 6 / Sanity 4

cards.name: Hasty Repairs
cards.text:
Revelation - Put Hasty Repairs into play in your threat area.
While triggering abilities on assets you control, set your base skill value to 0.
ACTIONACTION: Discard Hasty Repairs.

cards.name: Hatchet
cards.text:
ACTION: Fight. Add your AGILITY to your skill value for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. If this attack defeats an enemy, discard Hatchet. Otherwise, lose control of Hatchet and attach it to the attacked enemy. Attached enemy gains:
"REACTION When attached enemy is defeated: Take control of Hatchet. Any investigator at Hatchet's location may trigger this ability."

cards.name: Hold Up
cards.text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location and an [[Item]] asset in your hand. Perform a fight action against the chosen enemy. If you succeed, instead of dealing damage, play the chosen asset, reducing its cost by each point you succeeded by.
cards.flavor: "H-hands where I can see 'em!"

cards.name: Hunting Jacket
cards.text:
FAST Exhaust Hunting Jacket: Choose 1 non-weakness card in your hand and attach it facedown to Hunting Jacket (max 3 cards attached). Then, gain 1 resource for each attached card.
REACTION When Hunting Jacket is defeated: Draw each attached card.

cards.name: Katana
cards.text:
ACTION: Fight. You get +2 COMBAT for this test. If you succeed by exactly 2, you may exhaust Katana to deal +2 damage for this attack.
FASTExhaust Katana: Fight. Use AGILITY instead of COMBAT for this attack.

cards.name: Kate Winthrop
cards.text:
You begin the game with Flux Stabilizer (Inactive) side faceup.
FAST: Move 1 clue from Kate Winthrop to a [[Science]] or [[Tool]] asset you control with no clues on it.
Forced - When an asset you control with a clue on it leaves play: Place its clue on your location.
ELDER SIGN effect: +0. You may move 1 clue from an asset you control back to Kate Winthrop.

[Back]
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards (SEEKER) level 0-5, [[Science]] cards level 0-4, [[Insight]] cards level 0-1, Neutral cards level 0-5.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Flux Stabilizer, Failed Experiment, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.stats: WIL 2 INT 4 COM 2 AGI 4 / Health 6 / Sanity 8

cards.name: Keep Faith
cards.text:
Fast. Play during any FAST window.
Add 4 BLESS tokens to the chaos bag.
cards.flavor: Those who walk in faith need not fear the dark.

cards.name: Keeper of the Key
cards.text:
Bonded (Seal of the Elders).
REACTION When a BLESS token is revealed during a skill test at your location: Deal 1 horror to Keeper of the Key and discover 1 clue at your location or a connecting location.
Forced - When Keeper of the Key would leave play: Set it aside, out of play.

cards.name: Kōhaku Narukami
cards.text:
REACTION At the start of your turn: Either add 1 BLESS token or 1 CURSE token to the chaos bag, whichever there are fewer of (in case of a tie, you choose), or remove 2 BLESS tokens and 2 CURSE tokens from the chaos bag to take an additional action this turn.
ELDER SIGN effect: +2. Add 1 BLESS and 1 CURSE token to the chaos bag.

[Back]
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: [[Blessed]] cards level 0-5, [[Cursed]] cards level 0-5, [[Occult]] cards level 0, Mystic cards (MYSTIC) level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Book of Living Myths, Weeping Yurei, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.stats: WIL 4 INT 4 COM 3 AGI 1 / Health 6 / Sanity 8
cards.flavor: "Why not greet the unknown with wonder rather than fear?"

cards.name: Lightfooted
cards.text: If this skill test is successful during an evasion attempt, you may automatically evade another enemy at your location.
cards.flavor:
"I never ran from anything like that devil tonight, though. Hope I never have to again."
-Rita Young, Investigators of Arkham Horror

cards.name: Long Shot
cards.text:
You may commit Long Shot to a fight or evasion test against an enemy at your location or a connecting location.
If this test is successful, deal 1 damage to that enemy.

cards.name: Maimed Hand
cards.text:
Revelation - You must either put Maimed Hand into play in your threat area, or take 1 damage and shuffle it into your deck. It cannot leave play except by the ACTIONACTION ability below.
You get -1 health.
ACTIONACTION: Discard Maimed Hand.

cards.name: Mariner's Compass
cards.text:
ACTION Exhaust Mariner's Compass: Investigate. If you fail, ready Mariner's Compass. If you succeed and have no resources in your resource pool, discover 1 additional clue at your location.
FAST During an investigation using Mariner's Compass, spend 1 resource: You get +1 INTELLECT for this skill test. (Limit three times per investigation.)

cards.name: Matchbox
cards.text:
Uses (3 supplies). If Matchbox has no supplies, discard it.
FAST During any investigator's turn, exhaust Matchbox and spend 1 supply: Your location gets -1 shroud until the end of this turn.

cards.name: Mesmeric Influence
cards.text: While this card is committed to a skill test, the performing investigator may ignore all keyword or location effects that would trigger during this test.
cards.flavor: The dreaming mind is as deep as any sea.

cards.name: Microscope
cards.text:
REACTION After an enemy at your location is successfully evaded or defeated, exhaust Microscope: Place 1 resource on Microscope, as evidence.
ACTIONACTION: Investigate. You get +1 INTELLECT for this investigation for each evidence on Microscope (max +3 INTELLECT). If you succeed, you may spend up to 2 evidence to discover that many additional clues at your location.

cards.name: Microscope
cards.text:
REACTION After an enemy at your location is successfully evaded or defeated: Place 1 resource on Microscope, as evidence.
ACTIONACTION: Investigate. You get +2 INTELLECT for this investigation for each evidence on Microscope (max +6 INTELLECT). If you succeed, you may spend up to 3 evidence to discover that many additional clues at your location.

cards.name: Miracle Wish
cards.text:
Fast. Play after 1 or more BLESS tokens are revealed during a skill test at your location.
Search your bonded cards for Evanescent Ascension and put it into play. Place up to X resources on it, as wishes (to a maximum of the number of BLESS tokens revealed). Remove Miracle Wish from the game.

cards.name: Mouse Mask
cards.text:
Limit 1 [[Mask]] per investigator.
Uses (2 offerings). Replenish 1 of these offerings after you reveal a location or put a new location into play.
FAST Spend 1 offering: You get +2 WILLPOWER or +2 INTELLECT for this skill test. (Limit once per test.)

cards.name: Occult Reliquary
cards.text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per deck.
You have 1 additional hand, accessory, or arcane slot, which can only be used to hold a [[Blessed]] or [[Cursed]] asset.
cards.flavor: "The price is but a pittance for what you will gain."

cards.name: Ofuda
cards.text:
Uses (1 charge). Replenish this charge the first time a BLESS token is revealed at your location each round.
FAST Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location and spend 1 charge: That enemy loses the alert, aloof, elusive, and retaliate keywords until the end of the round.

cards.name: Olive McBride
cards.text: REACTION When you would reveal a chaos token, exhaust Olive McBride: Reveal 4 chaos tokens instead of 1. Choose 2 of those tokens to resolve, and ignore the rest.
cards.flavor: You must invest yourself in every spell. Sometimes literally.

cards.name: Pelt Shipment
cards.text:
While Pelt Shipment is in your hand, your maximum hand size is reduced by 3.
REACTION When the game ends or you resign, if Pelt Shipment is in your hand: Reduce the experience cost of the next new card you purchase before the next scenario by 1.

cards.name: Persistence
cards.text: You may commit Persistence to a skill test from your discard pile. If you do, shuffle it into your deck after this test ends.
cards.flavor: "Anyone but a stolid farmer would have fainted or gone mad..." - H.P. Lovecraft, The Colour Out of Space

cards.name: Pitchfork
cards.text:
ACTION: Fight. You get +1 COMBAT and deal +2 damage for this attack. If this attack is successful, lose control of Pitchfork and attach it to your location. Attached location gains:
"ACTION: Take control of Pitchfork. Any investigator at Pitchfork's location may trigger this ability."

cards.name: Prismatic Spectacles
cards.text: ACTION Add 1 CURSE token to the chaos bag: Investigate. You get +2 skill value for this investigation. If a CURSE token is revealed during this investigation, you may exhaust Prismatic Spectacles to discover 1 additional clue at your location.

cards.name: Providential
cards.text: If this skill test is successful, add 1 BLESS token to the chaos bag for each damage or horror on you (whichever is less).
cards.flavor: Courage is your best defense against whatever horrors lurk beyond.

cards.name: Purified
cards.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
You may commit Purified to any type of test.
If this test is successful, for each point you succeeded by (to a maximum of 5), add 1 BLESS token or remove 1 CURSE token from the chaos bag.

cards.name: Pushed to the Limit
cards.text: Choose a [[Weapon]] or [[Tool]] asset in your discard pile. Resolve an ACTION ability on that asset, ignoring all costs (including its ACTION cost). After this effect resolves, shuffle the chosen asset into your deck. Playing this card does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

cards.name: Putrescent Rot
cards.text:
Bonded (Rod of Carnamagos).
Attached enemy gets -1 fight and -1 evade.
Forced - When attached enemy leaves play: Set Putrescent Rot aside, out of play.

cards.name: Ravenous Myconid
cards.text:
Limit 1 per deck.
ACTION: Search your bonded cards for Uncanny Growth and add it to your hand.
ACTION If Ravenous Myconid has 3 or more growth on it: Move each growth to your resource pool, as resources. Record in your Campaign Log that "you have classified a new species."

cards.name: Ravenous Myconid
cards.text:
Researched. Limit 1 per deck.
FAST: Search your bonded cards for Uncanny Growth and add it to your hand. (Limit once per round.)
REACTION When an investigator draws a non-weakness treachery card, if their locations shroud is equal to or less than Ravenous Myconid's growth: Cancel that treachery's effects and discard it. Remove all growth from Ravenous Myconid.

cards.name: Ravenous Myconid
cards.text:
Researched. Limit 1 per deck.
FAST: Search your bonded cards for Uncanny Growth and add it to your hand. (Limit once per round.)
FAST Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location with equal or fewer remaining health than the amount of growth on Ravenous Myconid: Defeat that enemy. Remove all growth from Ravenous Myconid.

cards.name: Ravenous Myconid
cards.text:
Researched. Limit 1 per deck.
FAST: Search your bonded cards for Uncanny Growth and add it to your hand. (Limit once per round.)
FAST Remove all growth from Ravenous Myconid: Either heal that much damage/horror from Ravenous Myconid, or move that much damage/horror from investigators or [[Ally]] assets at your location to Ravenous Myconid.

cards.name: Read the Signs
cards.text: Investigate. Add your WILLPOWER value to your skill value for this investigation. You may ignore any effect or keyword on your location which would trigger during this investigation. If you succeed, discover 1 additional clue at this location. If a symbol was revealed during this investigation, return Read the Signs to your hand at the end of your turn.

cards.name: Rod of Carnamagos
cards.text:
Limit 1 per deck.
FAST Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at any location and exhaust Rod of Carnamagos: Reveal 5 random chaos tokens from the chaos bag. If a CURSE token is revealed, search your bonded cards for a random [[Rot]] event and attach it to that enemy.

cards.name: Rod of Carnamagos
cards.text: FAST Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at any location and exhaust Rod of Carnamagos: Reveal 5 random chaos tokens from the chaos bag. For each CURSE token revealed, you may search your bonded cards for a [[Rot]] event and attach it to that enemy.

cards.name: Scarlet Rot
cards.text:
Bonded (Rod of Carnamagos).
Forced - At the end of the round: Attached enemy takes 1 damage.
Forced - When attached enemy leaves play: Set Scarlet Rot aside, out of play.

cards.name: Scrimshaw Charm
cards.text: ACTION Add 1-3 CURSE tokens to the chaos bag and exhaust Scrimshaw Charm: Gain 1 resource. For each token added, gain 1 additional resource.
cards.flavor: "Let faith oust fact; let fancy oust memory; I look deep down and do believe." - Herman Melville, Moby-Dick

cards.name: Seal of the Elders
cards.text:
Fast. Play after a skill test at your location ends in which at least 2 CURSE tokens or 2 BLESS tokens were revealed.
If 2 CURSE tokens were revealed, search your bonded cards for 1 copy of Servant of Brass and put it into play. If 2 BLESS tokens were revealed, search your bonded cards for Keeper of the Key and put it into play. If 2 CURSE tokens and 2 BLESS tokens were revealed, do both instead. Remove Seal of the Elders from the game.

cards.name: Second Wind
cards.text:
Play only as your first action.
Heal 2 damage (3 damage instead if you drew a treachery this round). Draw 1 card.

cards.name: Servant of Brass
cards.text:
Bonded (Seal of the Elders).
REACTION When a CURSE token is revealed during a skill test at your location: Deal 1 damage to Servant of Brass and 2 damage to an enemy at your location or a connecting location.
Forced - When Servant of Brass would leave play: Set it aside, out of play.

cards.name: Snitch
cards.text:
Fast. Play after you succeed at a skill test while parleying.
Discover 2 total clues from among your location and connecting locations.
cards.flavor: "I shouldn't be telling you this, but since you seem trustworthy..."

cards.name: Sparrow Mask
cards.text:
Limit 1 [[Mask]] per investigator.
Uses (2 offerings). Replenish 1 of these offerings after you take 1 or more damage and/or horror.
FAST Spend 1 offering: You get +2 WILLPOWER or +2 AGILITY for this skill test. (Limit once per test.)

cards.name: Speak to the Dead
cards.text:
Uses (6 offerings).
ACTION Spend any number of offerings: Parley. Choose a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] event in your discard pile and reveal tokens from the chaos bag equal to the number of offerings spent. If at least 1 SKULL or CURSE token was revealed, return the chosen event to your hand.

cards.name: Spectral Razor
cards.text: Fight. Add your WILLPOWER value to your skill value for this attack. Immediately before this attack, you may engage the attacked enemy. This attack deals +1 damage (+2 damage instead if the enemy is non-[[Elite]]). If a symbol was revealed during this attack, return Spectral Razor to your hand at the end of your turn.

cards.name: Stall for Time
cards.text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location. Test WILLPOWER (X), where X is the chosen enemy's fight or evade value, whichever is lower. If you succeed, exhaust the chosen enemy (but do not disengage from it). If it is non-[[Elite]], it does not ready during the next upkeep phase. If you fail, return Stall for Time to your hand.

cards.name: Steady-Handed
cards.text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
REACTION When you would succeed at a skill test, exhaust Steady-Handed: You either succeed by 1 more or 1 less. If you succeeded by exactly 2, heal 1 horror.
cards.flavor: A nick can be the difference between life and death.

cards.name: Stir the Pot
cards.text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location and test INTELLECT (X), where X is the chosen enemy's combined damage/horror values. If you succeed, deal X damage to each enemy at your location. After this effect resolves, you may disengage from each enemy and move to a connecting location.
cards.flavor: "...and I heard he called you stupid too!"

cards.name: Stir the Pot
cards.text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location and test INTELLECT (X), where X is the chosen enemy's combined damage and horror values. If you succeed, deal 2 damage to each enemy at your location. If you succeed by 2 or more, after this effect resolves you may disengage from each enemy and move to a connecting location.
cards.flavor: "He did say something about your hair..."

cards.name: Stouthearted
cards.text:
Hank Samson deck only.
Fast. Play when you engage a non-[[Elite]] enemy.
Move up to 2 damage and/or horror from Hank Samson to that enemy, as damage.
cards.flavor: Everyone is a hero to someone.

cards.name: Strong-Armed
cards.text: While Strong-Armed is committed to an attack using a [[Melee]] or [[Ranged]] asset, this attack deals +1 damage. After revealing chaos token(s) for this skill test, you may take 1 damage to cancel that chaos token, return it to the chaos bag, and reveal a new one. (You may do this any number of times.)

cards.name: Survival Technique
cards.text:
FAST Choose a card you own that is attached to your location and exhaust Survival Technique: Add that card to your hand.
FAST During a skill test on a location or on a treachery attached to your location, exhaust Survival Technique: You get +2 skill value for this test.

cards.name: Task Force
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play Task Force, spend an action. One at a time, in any order, choose an investigator at your location to...
- ...resolve an ACTION ability on an asset they control without paying its ACTION cost.
- ...move to a connecting location.
- ...discover 1 clue at their location.

cards.name: Testing Sprint
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play Testing Sprint, spend an action.
Investigate. One at a time, investigate your location and each connecting location once each in ascending order of shroud, until you either fail to investigate or successfully investigate each eligible location.

cards.name: The Key of Solomon
cards.text:
FAST If there are more BLESS than CURSE tokens in the chaos bag, remove 1 BLESS token from the chaos bag and exhaust The Key of Solomon: Heal up to 2 damage and/or horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location.
FAST If there are more CURSE than BLESS tokens in the chaos bag, remove 1 CURSE token from the chaos bag and exhaust The Key of Solomon: Gain 2 resources.

cards.name: The Silver Moth
cards.text:
Revelation - You must either put The Silver Moth into play in your threat area, or take 1 horror and shuffle it into your deck. It cannot leave play except by the ACTIONACTION ability below.
You get -1 sanity.
ACTIONACTION: Discard The Silver Moth.

cards.name: Thorough Inquiry
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play Thorough Inquiry, spend an action.
Investigators at your location draw a combined total of 5 cards (you decide how many cards each investigator draws).
cards.flavor: The truth is often hidden in plain sight.

cards.name: Tinker
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Attach Tinker to a [[Tool]] asset in your play area. Limit 1 per asset.
Attached asset takes up 1 fewer hand or accessory slot.
cards.flavor: "You still call that a wrench?!"

cards.name: Token of Faith
cards.text: REACTION After a skill test ends in which 1 or more CURSE or AUTO FAIL tokens were revealed, exhaust Token of Faith: Add that many BLESS tokens to the chaos bag. If this skill test failed, after resolving all effects from the failed test, the performing investigator may attempt that test again. (Max once per test.)

cards.name: Transmogrify
cards.text:
Evade. You may use INTELLECT instead of AGILITY for this evasion attempt. If you succeed and the enemy is non-[[Elite]], attach Transmogrify to it.
Attached enemy gains: "Massive. Cannot move.
REACTION After you evade this enemy: Discover 1 clue at its location. (Limit once per round.)"
cards.flavor: "I said 'blow it up,' not 'blow it up!"

cards.name: Twilight Diadem
cards.text:
Bonded (Broken Diadem). Limit 1 [[Mask]] per investigator.
REACTION When you reveal either a BLESS or CURSE token during a skill test, spend 1 offering and exhaust this card: Treat the revealed token as an ELDER SIGN token instead, returning it to the chaos bag. Then, if this card has no offerings, search your bonded cards for Broken Diadem and swap it with this card.

cards.name: Uncanny Growth
cards.text:
Bonded (Ravenous Myconid).
Investigate. After this test resolves, place 1 resource on Ravenous Myconid, as growth, for each point you succeed by. Set Uncanny Growth aside, out of play. If you fail, return Uncanny Growth to your hand.

cards.name: Vamp
cards.text:
Parley. Choose an enemy at your location and test any skill (3). If you succeed and you tested...
- ...WILLPOWER, remove 1 doom from that enemy.
- ...INTELLECT, discover 1 clue at your location.
- ...AGILITY, automatically evade that enemy. If it is non-[[Elite]], move it to a connecting location.
- ...COMBAT, deal 2 damage to that enemy.

cards.name: Vamp
cards.text:
Parley. Choose an enemy at your location and any number of skills. One at a time, in any order, test each chosen skill (2). For each test you succeeded, if it was...
- ...WILLPOWER, remove 1 doom from that enemy.
- ...INTELLECT, discover 1 clue at that enemy's location.
- ...AGILITY, automatically evade that enemy. Move it to a connecting location if it is non-[[Elite]].
- ...COMBAT, deal 2 damage to that enemy.

cards.name: Virescent Rot
cards.text:
Bonded (Rod of Carnamagos).
Attached enemy cannot move.
Forced - When attached enemy leaves play: Set Virescent Rot aside, out of play.

cards.name: Vow of Drzytelech
cards.text:
Revelation - You must either put Vow of Drzytelech into play in your threat area, or take 1 horror and shuffle it into your deck. It cannot leave play except by the ACTIONACTION ability below.
You get -1 sanity.
ACTIONACTION: Discard Vow of Drzytelech.

cards.name: Weeping Yurei
cards.text:
Aloof. Elusive. Hunter.
Prey - Kōhaku Narukami only.
Forced - After an investigator reveals a BLESS token or CURSE token during a skill test at Weeping Yurei's location, if it is ready: Weeping Yurei attacks that investigator. (Limit once per test).

cards.name: Well-Dressed
cards.text: While Well-Dressed is committed to a skill test during a parley action, it gains WILD WILD WILD.
cards.flavor: The fine clothes do all the talking.

cards.name: Well-Funded
cards.text: While you control a [[Science]] or [[Tool]] asset, Well-Funded gains WILD (while you control 3 or more [[Science]] and/or [[Tool]] assets, Well-Funded gains WILD WILD, instead).
cards.flavor: Every cent of that research grant counts.

cards.name: Wicked Athame
cards.text: ACTION Add 1-3 CURSE tokens to the chaos bag: Fight. You get +2 COMBAT for this attack for each CURSE token added as part of this action's cost. If this attack defeats an enemy, replenish 1 charge or offering on an asset you control.

cards.name: Wilson Richards
cards.text:
Reduce the resource cost of the first [[Tool]] asset you play each round by 1.
You get +1 skill value during skill tests on [[Tool]] assets.
ELDER SIGN effect: +0. You may swap a [[Tool]] asset in your play area with a [[Tool]] asset in your hand with equal or lower printed cost.

[Back]
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: [[Tool]] cards level 0-5, Guardian cards (GUARDIAN) level 0-4, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 5 other [[Improvised]] and/or [[Upgrade]] cards level 0-1.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Ad Hoc, Hasty Repairs, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.stats: WIL 3 INT 3 COM 3 AGI 3 / Health 8 / Sanity 6

cards.name: Wolf Mask
cards.text:
Limit 1 [[Mask]] per investigator.
Uses (2 offerings). Replenish 1 of these offerings after you engage an enemy.
FAST Spend 1 offering: You get +2 COMBAT or +2 AGILITY for this skill test. (Limit once per test.)

cards.name: Wrong Place, Right Time
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play Wrong Place, Right Time, spend an action.
Move up to 5 damage and/or horror from your investigator to assets controlled by investigators at your location. For each asset defeated by this effect, draw 1 card. Remove Wrong Place, Right Time from the game.

cards.name: Zamacona
cards.text:
Elusive.
Spawn - Nearest empty location, if able.
Alessandra Zorzi cannot parley with Zamacona.
Forced - The first time Alessandra Zorzi parleys each round: Place 1 doom on Zamacona.

cards.name: "I've got a plan!"
cards.text: Fight. This attack uses INTELLECT instead of COMBAT. You get +2 INTELLECT for this test. You deal +1 damage for this attack for each clue you have (max +3 damage).
cards.flavor: "That's the worst plan I've ever heard. Well, what are we waiting for?"

cards.name: Arcane Enlightenment
cards.text:
Your maximum hand size is increased by 1.
You have 1 additional hand slot, which can only be used to hold a [[Tome]] asset.
cards.flavor: An augmented mind can memorize entire volumes of books.

cards.name: Burning the Midnight Oil
cards.text: Investigate. When this action begins, gain 2 resources.
cards.flavor: You'll sleep when you're dead.

cards.name: Celaeno Fragments
cards.text:
While you have...
- ...5 or more cards in hand, you get +1 INTELLECT.
- ...10 or more cards in hand, you get +1 WILLPOWER.
- ...15 or more cards in hand, you get +1 INTELLECT.

cards.name: Cryptic Writings
cards.text:
Gain 3 resources (4 resources instead if you have 10 or more other cards in hand).
REACTION After you draw Cryptic Writings during your turn: Play it.
cards.flavor: "...these are few as compared with those in the languages I cannot understand." - H. P. Lovecraft, "The Statement of Randolph Carter"

cards.name: Cryptic Writings
cards.text:
Gain 2 resources.
REACTION After you draw Cryptic Writings during your turn: Play it.
cards.flavor: "...these are few as compared with those in languages I cannot understand." - H. P. Lovecraft, "The Statement of Randolph Carter"

cards.name: Disc of Itzamna
cards.text: REACTION When a non-[[Elite]] enemy spawns at your location, discard Disc of Itzamna: Automatically evade that enemy or deal it 2 damage.
cards.flavor: Do they fear it because of what it will do to them? Or, do they fear it because of what it will do to you?

cards.name: Encyclopedia
cards.text:
Uses (5 secrets).
ACTION Exhaust Encyclopedia and spend 1 secret: Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator gets +2 to a skill of your choice until the end of the phase.

cards.name: Esoteric Atlas
cards.text:
Uses (4 secrets).
ACTION Spend 1 secret: Choose a revealed location up to 3 connections away from your location. Move to that location.

cards.name: Farsight
cards.text: FAST During your turn, if you have 8 or more cards in your hand, exhaust Farsight: Play an event from your hand (paying its cost).
cards.flavor: Beyond all points in time. Beyond all angles of space. Beyond the curves of reality.

cards.name: Feed the Mind
cards.text:
Uses (3 secrets).
ACTION Exhaust Feed the Mind and spend 1 secret: Test INTELLECT (1). For each point you succeed by (to a maximum of 3), draw 1 card.

cards.name: Forbidden Tome
cards.text:
Uses (5 secrets).
ACTION Exhaust Forbidden Tome and spend 1 secret: Draw 1 card. Then, if you have 10 or more cards in your hand and there are no secrets on Forbidden Tome, you may discard it to record in your Campaign Log that "you have translated the tome."

cards.name: Forbidden Tome
cards.text:
Researched.
ACTIONACTIONACTIONACTION Exhaust Forbidden Tome: Move 1 damage from a player card at your location to an enemy at your location. Reduce this ability's cost by 1 action for every 4 cards in your hand (to a minimum of ACTION).

cards.name: Forbidden Tome
cards.text:
Researched.
ACTIONACTIONACTIONACTION Exhaust Forbidden Tome: You may move to a connecting location. Discover 1 clue at your location. Reduce this ability's cost by 1 action for every 4 cards in your hand (to a minimum of ACTION).

cards.name: Glimpse the Unthinkable
cards.text: Draw 1 card. Shuffle any number of non-weakness cards from your hand into your deck. Then, draw that many cards.
cards.flavor: Ignorance is a bliss you cannot afford.

cards.name: Harvey Walters
cards.text:
REACTION After an investigator at your location draws 1 or more cards from their deck during the investigation phase: That investigator draws 1 card. (Limit once per round.)
ELDER SIGN effect: +1. Draw 1 card.

[Back]
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards (SEEKER) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Vault of Knowledge, Thrice-Damned Curiosity, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.stats: WIL 4 INT 5 COM 1 AGI 2 / Health 7 / Sanity 8
cards.flavor: "I have experience dealing with these sorts of horrors."

cards.name: Higher Education
cards.text:
While you have 5 or more cards in your hand, Higher Education gains:
"FAST Spend 1 resource: You get +1 WILLPOWER for this skill test.
FAST Spend 1 resource: You get +1 INTELLECT for this skill test."

cards.name: Library Docent
cards.text: REACTION After Library Docent enters play, return a [[Tome]] asset you control to its owner's hand: Play a different [[Tome]] asset (by title) from your hand, reducing its cost by 2.

cards.name: Mind over Matter
cards.text:
Fast. Play during your turn.
Until the end of the round, add your INTELLECT to your COMBAT and AGILITY. Draw 1 card.

cards.name: Miskatonic Archaeology Funding
cards.text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per deck.
You have 2 additional ally slots, which can only be used to hold [[Miskatonic]] assets.
Forced - When you take damage or horror: No more than 1 of that damage/horror can be assigned to a [[Miskatonic]] asset.

cards.name: Obsessive
cards.text:
Revelation - Put Obsessive into play in your threat area.
Forced - When your turn begins: Discard 1 non-weakness card at random from your hand.
ACTIONACTION: Discard Obsessive.

cards.name: Occult Invocation
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play Occult Invocation, discard up to 2 cards from your hand.
Fight. This attack uses INTELLECT instead of COMBAT. You get +1 INTELLECT and deal +1 damage for this attack for each card discarded as part of this card's cost.

cards.name: Perception
cards.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, draw 1 card (2 cards instead if it succeeds by 2 or more).
cards.flavor: At last, I've found it!

cards.name: Seeking Answers
cards.text: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering a clue at your location, discover 2 total clues from among your location and connecting locations.
cards.flavor: Some people need to know the truth at any cost. Some truths can cut like knives.

cards.name: The Necronomicon
cards.text:
Uses (6 secrets). Limit 1 per deck.
FAST Spend 1 secret: You get +2 skill value for this skill test.
FAST Spend 2 secrets: Draw 2 cards.
FAST Spend 3 secrets: Discover 1 clue at any location.
FAST Spend 4 secrets: Deal 3 damage to an enemy engaged with you.

cards.name: Thrice-Damned Curiosity
cards.text: Revelation - For every 3 cards in your hand: Take 1 damage.
cards.flavor:
"... I can only hope that my account will not arouse a curiosity greater than sane caution on the part of those who believe me at all."
- H. P. Lovecraft, "At the Mountains of Madness"

cards.name: Vault of Knowledge
cards.text:
Harvey Walters deck only.
Your maximum hand size is increased by 2.
REACTION After you successfully investigate, exhaust Vault of Knowledge and choose an investigator at your location: That investigator draws 1 card.

cards.name: Whitton Greene
cards.text:
While you control a [[Tome]] or [[Relic]] asset, you get +1 INTELLECT.
REACTION After you reveal a location or put a new location into play, exhaust Whitton Greene: Search the top 6 cards of your deck for a [[Tome]] or [[Relic]] asset and draw it. Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Whitton Greene
cards.text:
While you control a [[Tome]] or [[Relic]] asset, you get +1 WILLPOWER and +1 INTELLECT.
REACTION After you reveal a location or put a new location into play, exhaust Whitton Greene: Search the top 9 cards of your deck for a [[Tome]] or [[Relic]] asset and draw it. Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Rex Murphy
cards.text:
REACTION When you would either place 1 of your clues on your location, or add 2 CURSE tokens to the chaos bag: Do the other instead. (This can still satisfy the cost of an ability.)
ELDER SIGN effect: +2 for each CURSE token revealed during this test. Draw 1 card for each CURSE token revealed during this test.

[Back]
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards (SEEKER) level 0-3, [[Cursed]] and [[Gambit]] cards level 0-4, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to five other Rogue cards (ROGUE) level 0.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Search for the Truth, Rex's Curse, 1 random basic weakness.
Deckbuilding Restrictions: No [[Fortune]] or [[Blessed]] cards (unless they are also [[Cursed]]).
cards.stats: WIL 3 INT 4 COM 2 AGI 3 / Health 6 / Sanity 9
cards.flavor: "Oh, come on, not again!"

cards.name: Rex's Curse
cards.text:
Advanced.
Revelation - Put Rex's Curse into play in your threat area.
Forced - When you would succeed at a skill test: Reveal an additional chaos token. If this effect causes you to fail the test, shuffle Rex's Curse into your deck. (Limit once per test.)

cards.name: Search for the Truth
cards.text:
Rex Murphy deck only. Advanced.
For each clue on Rex Murphy (to a maximum of 5) you may either:
- Draw 1 card.
- Place that clue on your location and return any card from your discard pile to your hand.

cards.name: Blessing of Isis
cards.text: REACTION When a second BLESS token is revealed during a single skill test at your location, exhaust Blessing of Isis: Cancel that token and treat it as if it were a ELDER SIGN token instead. Return both of those tokens to the chaos bag after this test ends.

cards.name: Cryptic Grimoire
cards.text:
Researched.
REACTION After you resolve 1 or more CURSE tokens during a skill test: Place that many secrets on Cryptic Grimoire.
REACTION When you play an [[Insight]] event during your turn, spend 2 secrets: That event gains fast. Reduce its cost by 1.

cards.name: Cryptic Grimoire
cards.text:
Researched.
REACTION After you resolve 1 or more CURSE tokens during a skill test: Place that many secrets on Cryptic Grimoire.
REACTION When you would draw the top card of the encounter deck, spend 5 secrets: Draw a card from your deck instead.

cards.name: Curse of Aeons
cards.text: REACTION When a second CURSE token is revealed during a single skill test at your location, exhaust Curse of Aeons: Cancel that token and treat it as if it were a SKULL token instead. You may choose to remove both of those tokens from the chaos bag after the test ends.

cards.name: Enchanted Armor
cards.text:
Play Enchanted Armor under the control of any investigator at your location.
Forced - After damage and/or horror is placed on Enchanted Armor: The owner of Enchanted Armor tests WILLPOWER (X), where X is the total amount of damage and horror on it. If the test fails, discard Enchanted Armor and assign the damage and/or horror just placed on it elsewhere.

cards.name: Ríastrad
cards.text: Fight. When you initiate this attack, add up to 3 CURSE tokens to the chaos bag. For each CURSE token added to the chaos bag in this way, you get +1 COMBAT and deal +1 damage for this attack.

cards.name: Signum Crucis
cards.text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing, and only if the difficulty of that test is higher than your base skill value.
After you commit Signum Crucis to a skill test, add X BLESS tokens to the chaos bag. X is the difference between the test's difficulty and your base skill value.

cards.name: Tristan Botley
cards.text:
REACTION After your turn begins: Choose two skills. Until the start of your next turn, you get +1 to each of those skills.
REACTION After any skill test ends in which a total of 3 or more CURSE or BLESS tokens were revealed: Play Tristan Botley from your hand, at no cost.
cards.flavor: "Nothin's ever gonna be the same, Vito."

cards.name: Unrelenting
cards.text:
Max 1 committed per test.
After you commit Unrelenting to a skill test, search the chaos bag for up to 3 non-AUTO FAIL chaos tokens of your choice, and seal them on Unrelenting. If all 3 tokens sealed on Unrelenting are "+1,", "0," BLESS, and/or ELDER SIGN tokens, draw 2 cards. Release all tokens sealed here after this test ends.

cards.name: Against All Odds
cards.text:
Fast. Play when you perform a skill test with a difficulty higher than your base skill value.
Reveal X additional chaos tokens for this skill test. Choose one to resolve and ignore the rest. X is the difference between the test's difficulty and your base skill value.

cards.name: Custom Ammunition
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Attach to a [[Firearm]] asset controlled by an investigator at your location. Place 2 ammo on that asset. Limit 1 per asset.
Attacks performed by attached asset deal +1 damage against [[Monster]] enemies.
cards.flavor: "You want me to bless - what?"

cards.name: Defiance
cards.text: Ignore the effects of all SKULL, CULTIST, TABLET, and ELDER THING symbols during this test (including their modifiers).
cards.flavor: "No."

cards.name: Expose Weakness
cards.text:
Fast. Play during any FAST player window.
Choose an enemy at your location. Test INTELLECT (X), where X is that enemy's fight value. If you succeed, treat that enemy's fight value as if it were 0 for the next attack performed against it this phase. Draw 1 card.

cards.name: Intrepid
cards.text:
If this skill test is successful, add Intrepid to your play area as an asset with the text:
"You get +1 INTELLECT, +1 COMBAT, and +1 AGILITY.
Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Intrepid."

cards.name: Live and Learn
cards.text:
Fast. Play after a skill test you failed ends (after resolving all effects from the failed test).
Attempt that test again. You get +2 skill value for this test.

cards.name: Lola Santiago
cards.text:
You get +1 INTELLECT and +1 AGILITY.
FAST Exhaust Lola Santiago and spend X resources: Discover 1 clue at your location. X is the shroud value of your location.
cards.flavor:
"My line of work encounters a lot of so-called 'curses.'
It is a topic I would rather not discuss."

cards.name: Olive McBride
cards.text: REACTION When you would reveal a chaos token, exhaust Olive McBride: Reveal 3 chaos tokens instead of 1. Choose 2 of those tokens to resolve, and ignore the other.
cards.flavor: You must invest yourself in every spell. Sometimes literally.

cards.name: Ornate Bow
cards.text:
Uses (1 ammo). Limit 1 ammo on Ornate Bow.
ACTION Spend 1 ammo: Fight. This attack uses AGILITY instead of COMBAT. You get +2 AGILITY and deal +2 damage for this attack.
ACTION: You nock another arrow. Place 1 ammo on Ornate Bow.

cards.name: Otherworldly Compass
cards.text: ACTION Exhaust Otherworldly Compass: Investigate. Your location gets -X shroud for this investigation. X is the number of revealed locations connected to your location.
cards.flavor: It always points where you don't want to go.

cards.name: Take Heart
cards.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
You may commit Take Heart to any type of test.
If this test fails, the performing investigator draws 2 cards and gains 2 resources.

cards.name: Trench Coat
cards.text: You get +1 AGILITY during evasion attempts.
cards.flavor:
Roland loosened his tie, tilted his hat, and turned up his coat collar, and when he was sure he looked respectably disreputable, he approached the door.
- Graeme Davis, The Dirge of Reason

cards.name: Green Man Medallion
cards.text:
Jenny Barnes deck only. Replacement.
FAST Spend up to 3 resources and exhaust Green Man Medallion: Place those resources on it, as offerings.
REACTION When you resign or the game ends: For every 6 offerings on Green Man Medallion, reduce the experience cost of the next card you purchase before the next scenario by 1.

cards.name: Sacrificial Beast
cards.text:
Jenny Barnes deck only. Replacement.
Spawn - Location farthest from you.
Jenny Barnes cannot gain resources via card effects.
cards.flavor: Thick limbs like wet branches yearned skyward, high above the platform. They swayed, whether in agony or exaltation Jenny could not tell. - Dave Gross, Hour of the Huntress

cards.name: Agency Backup
cards.text:
Agency Backup may be assigned damage and/or horror dealt to other investigators at your location.
FAST Exhaust Agency Backup and deal 1 damage to it: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.
FAST Exhaust Agency Backup and deal 1 horror to it: Discover 1 clue at your location.
cards.stats: Cost 7 / WIL 1 INT 1 COM 1 / Health 4 / Sanity 4

cards.name: Anna Kaslow
cards.text:
You have 2 additional tarot slots.
REACTION When the game begins, if Anna Kaslow is in your opening hand: Put her into play.
REACTION After Anna Kaslow enters play: Search your deck for a [[Tarot]] asset and put it into play.

cards.name: Bait and Switch
cards.text:
Either (choose one):
- Evade. If you succeed and the enemy is non-[[Elite]], evade the enemy and move it to a connecting location.
- Evade. Use only on a non-[[Elite]] enemy at a connecting location. If you succeed, evade that enemy and switch locations with it.

cards.name: Dayana Esperence
cards.text:
Uses (3 secrets).
FAST: Attach a non-weakness [[Spell]] event from your hand to Dayana Esperence. Limit 1 event attached to her.
The attached event may be played as if it were in your hand. It is not placed in your discard pile after it is played (it remains attached). As an additional cost to play the attached event, exhaust Dayana Esperence and spend 1 secret.

cards.name: Deny Existence
cards.text:
Fast. Play when an encounter card or enemy attack would cause you to do one of the following (choose one): Discard cards from hand, lose resources, lose actions, take damage, or take horror.
You ignore that aspect of the effect. Then, perform the opposite of that aspect (draw cards, gain resources, gain additional actions, heal damage, or heal horror, respectively).

cards.name: Ghastly Revelation
cards.text: Discover 3 clues at your location. Give any number of your clues to another investigator, or place any number of your clues on any location. You are defeated and suffer 1 mental trauma. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

cards.name: Mk 1 Grenades
cards.text:
Uses (3 supplies). If Mk 1 Grenades has no supplies, discard it.
ACTION Spend 1 supply: Fight. You get +2 COMBAT for this attack. If this attack is successful, instead of its standard damage, this attack deals 2 damage to each enemy and each other investigator at the attacked enemy's location (any additional damage is dealt to the attacked enemy).

cards.name: Small Favor
cards.text:
Deal 1 damage to a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location.
REACTION When you play Small Favor, increase its cost by 2: Change "Deal 1 damage" to "Deal 2 damage."
REACTION When you play Small Favor, increase its cost by 2: Change "at your location" to "at a location up to 2 connections away."

cards.name: Trial by Fire
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Choose one of your skills. Until the end of your turn, set the base value of that skill to 5.
cards.flavor: You never really know what you are capable of until something is trying to eat you.

cards.name: Split the Angle
cards.text:
Norman Withers deck only. Replacement.
ACTION: Reveal the top card of the encounter deck.
FAST Exhaust Split the Angle and discard the top card of your deck: Discard the top card of the encounter deck.
cards.flavor: ...another spell, likewise rendered phonetically, for "splitting the angle" and walking through time in the flesh.

cards.name: Vengeful Hound
cards.text:
Norman Withers deck only. Replacement.
Prey - Norman Withers.
While Vengeful Hounds is engaged with you, you cannot draw or reveal cards via player card effects.
cards.flavor: "On those rare occasions when a man escapes the Hounds, he doesn't always stay escaped. Sooner or later, they're apt to come after him." - Richard Lee Byers, Ire of the Void

cards.name: Ancient Covenant
cards.text:
Permanent. Limit 1 [[Covenant]] per deck.
REACTION When an investigator at your location resolves a BLESS token during a skill test, exhaust Ancient Covenant: Do not reveal another token as part of this BLESS token's effect.

cards.name: Armageddon
cards.text:
Uses (3 charges).
ACTION Spend 1 charge: Fight. This attack uses WILLPOWER instead of COMBAT and deals +1 damage. If a CURSE token is revealed during this attack, you may deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location or place 1 charge on Armageddon.

cards.name: Blasphemous Covenant
cards.text:
Permanent. Limit 1 [[Covenant]] per deck.
REACTION When an investigator at your location reveals a CURSE token during a skill test, exhaust Blasphemous Covenant: Treat that token's modifier as +1 instead of its normal modifier. After this test ends, return that token to the chaos bag.

cards.name: Eldritch Sophist
cards.text:
Uses (3 secrets).
FAST Exhaust Eldritch Sophist: Move 1 secret or charge from an asset you control to another asset controlled by an investigator at your location.
cards.flavor: Once you let go of your assumptions, anything is possible.

cards.name: Eye of Chaos
cards.text:
Uses (3 charges).
ACTION Spend 1 charge: Investigate. Investigate using WILLPOWER instead of INTELLECT. If you succeed, discover 1 additional clue at this location. If a CURSE token is revealed during this investigation, you may discover 1 clue at a connecting location or place 1 charge on Eye of Chaos.

cards.name: False Covenant
cards.text:
Permanent. Limit 1 [[Covenant]] per deck.
REACTION When an investigator at your location reveals a CURSE token during a skill test, exhaust False Covenant: Cancel that chaos token, return it to the token pool, and reveal another token.

cards.name: Mariner's Compass
cards.text:
ACTION Exhaust Mariner's Compass: Investigate. If you succeed and have no resources in your resource pool, discover 1 additional clue at your location.
FAST During an investigation using Mariner's Compass, spend 1 resource: You get +1 INTELLECT for this skill test. (Limit three times per investigation.)

cards.name: Paradoxical Covenant
cards.text:
Permanent. Limit 1 [[Covenant]] per deck.
REACTION After an investigator at your location performs the "reveal the chaos token" step of a skill test, if both a BLESS token and a CURSE token were revealed during that test, exhaust Paradoxical Covenant: This test automatically succeeds. (Remove each BLESS and CURSE token revealed from the chaos bag after this test ends.)

cards.name: Righteous Hunt
cards.text: Engage. Choose an enemy up to 2 locations away. Move (one location at a time) to that enemy's location, engage it, and add BLESS tokens to the chaos bag equal to that enemy's horror value.
cards.flavor: Lita narrowed her eyes and tightened her grip. They wouldn't get away. Not this time. Not ever again.

cards.name: Riot Whistle
cards.text: You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used to engage.
cards.flavor: "If you blow that thing one more time, I'm gonna make you eat it."

cards.name: Sacred Covenant
cards.text:
Permanent. Limit 1 [[Covenant]] per deck.
REACTION After an investigator at any location performs the "reveal chaos token" step of a skill test, exhaust Sacred Covenant: Return any number of BLESS tokens revealed during this test to the chaos bag, ignoring their modifiers for this test.

cards.name: Shroud of Shadows
cards.text:
Uses (3 charges).
ACTION Spend 1 charge: Evade. This evasion attempt uses WILLPOWER instead of AGILITY. If you succeed and the evaded enemy is non-[[Elite]], you may move that enemy to a connecting location. If a CURSE token is revealed during this evasion attempt, you may move to a connecting location or place 1 charge on Shroud of Shadows.

cards.name: Skeptic
cards.text: During this skill test, treat the modifier of each BLESS and each CURSE token as +1 instead of its normal modifier.
cards.flavor: "Oh, hooey. What's the worst that could happen?"

cards.name: Stirring Up Trouble
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play Stirring Up Trouble, add CURSE tokens to the chaos bag equal to your location's shroud value.
Discover 2 clues at your location.
cards.flavor: When you start following a thread, it's hard to say what you'll find at the other end.

cards.name: .25 Automatic
cards.text:
Fast. Uses (4 ammo).
ACTION Spend 1 ammo: Fight. If the attacked enemy is exhausted, you get +2 COMBAT and deal +1 damage for this attack.
REACTION After you evade an enemy at your location: Perform the above Fight ability without spending an action.

cards.name: Ancestral Knowledge
cards.text:
Permanent. Exceptional.
Your deck must include at least 10 skills. Your deck size is increased by 5.
REACTION Before drawing your opening hand: Attach 5 random non-weakness skills from your deck facedown to this card.
FAST Exhaust Ancestral Knowledge: Draw 1 attached skill.

cards.name: Ariadne's Twine
cards.text:
Uses (0 secrets).
Secrets on Ariadne's Twine can be spent as if they were on any asset controlled by an investigator at your location.
FAST Exhaust Ariadne's Twine: Move 1 secret from an asset you control to your resource pool, as a resource, or vice versa.

cards.name: Hallow
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play Hallow, return a total of 10 BLESS tokens to the token pool from the chaos bag or sealed on cards in play.
Remove 1 doom from any card in play.
cards.flavor: Even in the deepest darkness, light can still bloom.

cards.name: Holy Spear
cards.text:
ACTION: Fight. You get +2 COMBAT and deal +1 damage for this attack. When you initiate this ability, you may release a BLESS token sealed on Holy Spear.
ACTION Search the chaos bag for 2 BLESS tokens and seal them on Holy Spear: Fight. You get +4 COMBAT and deal +2 damage for this attack.

cards.name: Jacob Morrison
cards.text:
Jacob Morrison does not ready during the upkeep phase.
REACTION When you would fail a skill test, exhaust Jacob Morrison: You get +2 skill value for that test.
REACTION After a BLESS token is revealed from the chaos bag during a skill test you are performing: Ready Jacob Morrison.

cards.name: Justify the Means
cards.text:
You may commit Justify the Means to any type of test.
As an additional cost to commit Justify the Means to a skill test, add CURSE tokens to the chaos bag equal to this test's difficulty.
This test automatically succeeds.

cards.name: Lucky Dice
cards.text:
Exceptional.
REACTION When you reveal a non-CURSE, non-AUTO FAIL chaos token, add 1 CURSE token to the chaos bag: Ignore the just revealed chaos token and reveal another one to resolve. If that token has a CURSE or AUTO FAIL symbol, return Lucky Dice to your hand (cannot be ignored/canceled).

cards.name: Rite of Equilibrium
cards.text:
Either (choose one):
- Add X CURSE tokens to the chaos bag to add X BLESS tokens to the chaos bag.
- Remove X CURSE and X BLESS tokens from the chaos bag to heal X total horror from among cards at your location.

cards.name: Shrine of the Moirai
cards.text:
Attach to your location. Uses (3 offerings).
Attached location gains: "FAST Draw the top card of the encounter deck, exhaust Shrine of the Moirai, and spend 1 offering: Return up to 2 cards with a total combined level of 5 or less from your discard pile to your hand. Any investigator at this location may trigger this ability."
Card design by the Moirai at Arkham Nights 2019.

cards.name: Arbiter of Fates
cards.text:
Jacqueline Fine deck only.
REACTION When you use Jacqueline Fine's REACTION ability, exhaust Arbiter of Fates: This use of her ability does not count towards its limit.
cards.flavor: I can see the threads. I know when they will snap.

cards.name: Arcane Studies
cards.text:
Uses (2 resources). Replenish these resources at the start of each round.
FAST Spend 1 resource from your resource pool or from Arcane Studies: You get +1 WILLPOWER or +1 INTELLECT for this skill test.

cards.name: Astral Travel
cards.text: Move. Move to any revealed location and reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If you reveal a SKULL, CULTIST, TABLET, ELDER THING, or AUTO FAIL symbol, you must discard an [[Item]] or [[Ally]] asset you control (if you cannot, take 1 damage).
cards.flavor: Extradimensional travel had its risks, he knew. But who could resist the frontiers beyond time and space?

cards.name: Azure Flame
cards.text:
Uses (4 charges).
ACTION Spend 1 charge: Fight. This attack uses WILLPOWER instead of COMBAT and deals +1 damage. If an ELDER SIGN, "+1," or "0" token is revealed during this attack, take 1 damage.

cards.name: Azure Flame
cards.text:
Uses (4 charges).
ACTION Spend 1 charge: Fight. This attack uses WILLPOWER instead of COMBAT. You get +2 WILLPOWER and deal +1 damage for this attack. If an ELDER SIGN, "+1," or "0" token is revealed during this attack, take 1 damage.

cards.name: Azure Flame
cards.text:
Uses (4 charges).
ACTION Spend 1 charge: Fight. This attack uses WILLPOWER instead of COMBAT. You get +3 WILLPOWER and deal +2 damage for this attack. If an ELDER SIGN, "+1," or "0" token is revealed during this attack, take 2 damage.

cards.name: Clairvoyance
cards.text:
Uses (3 charges).
ACTION Spend 1 charge: Investigate. Investigate using WILLPOWER instead of INTELLECT. If you succeed, discover 1 additional clue at this location. If an ELDER SIGN, "+1," or "0" token is revealed during this investigation, take 1 horror.

cards.name: Clairvoyance
cards.text:
Uses (3 charges).
ACTION Spend 1 charge: Investigate. Investigate using WILLPOWER instead of INTELLECT. You get +2 WILLPOWER for this investigation. If you succeed, discover 1 additional clue at this location. If an ELDER SIGN, "+1," or "0" token is revealed during this investigation, take 1 horror.

cards.name: Clairvoyance
cards.text:
Uses (3 charges).
ACTION Spend 1 charge: Investigate. Investigate using WILLPOWER instead of INTELLECT. You get +3 WILLPOWER for this investigation. If you succeed, discover 2 additional clues at this location. If an ELDER SIGN, "+1," or "0" token is revealed during this investigation, take 2 horror.

cards.name: Crystal Pendulum
cards.text:
You get +1 WILLPOWER.
REACTION After a skill test at your location begins, exhaust Crystal Pendulum: Name a number. If this test succeeds by that number or fails by that number, draw 1 card.

cards.name: Dark Future
cards.text:
Revelation - Put Dark Future into play in your threat area.
You cannot cancel or ignore ELDER SIGN, SKULL, CULTIST, TABLET, ELDER THING, and AUTO FAIL tokens.
Forced - At the end of your turn: Reveal 5 random tokens from the chaos bag. If an ELDER SIGN symbol is revealed, discard Dark Future.

cards.name: Dark Prophecy
cards.text:
Fast. Play when you would reveal a chaos token.
Reveal 5 chaos tokens instead of 1. Choose one of those tokens with a SKULL, CULTIST, TABLET, ELDER THING, or AUTO FAIL symbol to resolve, and ignore the rest. (If no such token is revealed, choose any one of those tokens to resolve, and ignore the rest.)
cards.flavor: The secrets were written in the stars.

cards.name: Eldritch Inspiration
cards.text:
Fast. Play when you would resolve an effect on a MYSTIC card that triggers "when," "if," or "after" a chaos token is revealed.
Either cancel that effect, or resolve it an additional time.

cards.name: Familiar Spirit
cards.text: You have 1 additional arcane slot, which can only be used to hold a [[Spell]] asset.
cards.flavor: "Thou art wholly unworthy. But I shall serve thee for now."

cards.name: Grotesque Statue
cards.text:
Uses (3 charges). If Grotesque Statue has no charges, discard it.
REACTION When you would reveal a chaos token, spend 1 charge: Reveal 2 chaos tokens instead of 1. Choose one of those tokens to resolve, and ignore the other.

cards.name: Guts
cards.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, draw 1 card (2 cards instead if it succeeds by 2 or more).
cards.flavor: Stay back! I'll handle this.

cards.name: Hypnotic Gaze
cards.text:
Fast. Play when an enemy attacks an investigator at your location.
Cancel that attack. Then, reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If it has a SKULL, CULTIST, TABLET, ELDER THING, or AUTO FAIL symbol, deal damage to the attacking enemy equal to its damage or horror.

cards.name: Hypnotic Gaze
cards.text:
Fast. Play when an enemy attacks an investigator at your location.
Cancel that attack. Then, reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If it has a SKULL, CULTIST, TABLET, ELDER THING, or AUTO FAIL symbol, deal the attacking enemy's damage to itself.

cards.name: Ineffable Truth
cards.text:
Uses (3 charges).
ACTION Spend 1 charge: Evade. This evasion attempt uses WILLPOWER instead of AGILITY. You get +2 WILLPOWER for this evasion attempt. If you succeed, deal 1 damage to the evaded enemy. If an ELDER SIGN, "+1," or "0" token is revealed during this evasion attempt, lose 1 resource.

cards.name: Ineffable Truth
cards.text:
Uses (3 charges).
ACTION Spend 1 charge: Evade. This evasion attempt uses WILLPOWER instead of AGILITY. If you succeed, deal 1 damage to the evaded enemy. If an ELDER SIGN, "+1," or "0" token is revealed during this evasion attempt, lose 1 resource.

cards.name: Ineffable Truth
cards.text:
Uses (3 charges).
ACTION Spend 1 charge: Evade. This evasion attempt uses WILLPOWER instead of AGILITY. You get +3 WILLPOWER for this evasion attempt. If you succeed, deal 2 damage to the evaded enemy. If an ELDER SIGN, "+1," or "0" token is revealed during this evasion attempt, lose 2 resources.

cards.name: Jacqueline Fine
cards.text:
REACTION When an investigator at your location would reveal any number of chaos tokens: Reveal 2 additional tokens. Of the revealed tokens, choose and cancel 2 non-AUTO FAIL tokens, or 1 AUTO FAIL token. (Limit once per round.)
ELDER SIGN effect: +1. If this effect is canceled or ignored, draw 1 card.

[Back]
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards (MYSTIC) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Arbiter of Fates, Dark Future, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.stats: WIL 5 INT 3 COM 2 AGI 2 / Health 6 / Sanity 9
cards.flavor: "The future can be rewritten."

cards.name: Nihilism
cards.text:
Revelation - Put Nihilism into play in your threat area.
Forced - After you reveal, cancel, or ignore an AUTO FAIL token: Take 1 damage and 1 horror.
ACTIONACTION: Discard Nihilism.

cards.name: Parallel Fates
cards.text: Look at the top 4 cards of the encounter deck. Reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If it has a SKULL, CULTIST, TABLET, ELDER THING, or AUTO FAIL symbol, shuffle those cards into the encounter deck. Otherwise, return them to the top of the encounter deck in any order.
cards.flavor: "If I said that I could tell you when you were going to die, would you want to know?"

cards.name: Prescient
cards.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
After you commit Prescient to a skill test, name "even," "odd," or "symbol." After this test ends, if a chaos token of the named type was revealed during this test, you may return a [[Spell]] card from your discard pile to your hand.

cards.name: Recharge
cards.text: Choose a [[Spell]] or [[Relic]] asset controlled by an investigator at your location and reveal a random chaos token from the chaos bag. If you reveal a SKULL, CULTIST, TABLET, ELDER THING, or AUTO FAIL symbol, add 1 charge to the chosen asset. Otherwise, add 4 charges to the chosen asset.

cards.name: Robes of Endless Night
cards.text: REACTION When you play a [[Spell]] card, exhaust Robes of Endless Night: Reduce the cost of that card by 1. Playing that card does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
cards.flavor: Dark is the abyss without. Bright is the abyss within.

cards.name: Robes of Endless Night
cards.text: REACTION When you play a [[Spell]] card, exhaust Robes of Endless Night: Reduce the cost of that card by 1.
cards.flavor: Dark is the abyss without. Bright is the abyss within.

cards.name: Scrying Mirror
cards.text:
Uses (4 secrets).
REACTION After a skill test at your location begins, exhaust Scrying Mirror and spend 1 secret: Perform the "reveal chaos token" step of the test now (before committing cards), instead of after committing cards.

cards.name: Voice of Ra
cards.text: Gain 1 resource. Reveal 3 random tokens from the chaos bag. For each SKULL, CULTIST, TABLET, ELDER THING, or AUTO FAIL symbol revealed, gain an additional 2 resources.

cards.name: "Lucky" Penny
cards.text:
Exceptional.
Forced - When you reveal a BLESS or CURSE token during a skill test you are performing: Flip a coin. On a heads, treat that token as a BLESS token. On a tails, treat that token as a CURSE token. If you treat a BLESS token as a CURSE token as a result of this effect, draw 1 card.

cards.name: Armageddon
cards.text:
Uses (3 charges).
ACTION Spend 1 charge: Fight. This attack uses WILLPOWER instead of COMBAT. You get +2 WILLPOWER and deal +1 damage for this attack. For each CURSE token revealed during this attack, you may deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location or place 1 charge on Armageddon.

cards.name: Eye of Chaos
cards.text:
Uses (3 charges).
ACTION Spend 1 charge: Investigate. Investigate using WILLPOWER instead of INTELLECT. You get +2 WILLPOWER for this test. If you succeed, discover 1 additional clue at this location. For each CURSE token revealed during this investigation, you may discover 1 clue at a connecting location or place 1 charge on Eye of Chaos.

cards.name: Eye of the Djinn
cards.text:
Exceptional.
REACTION When you initiate a skill test during your turn, exhaust Eye of the Djinn: Set your base skill value to 5 for this test. If a BLESS token is revealed during this test, ready Eye of the Djinn. If a CURSE token is revealed during this test, you may take an additional action this turn.

cards.name: Fey
cards.text: If a CURSE token is revealed during this skill test, you may return Fey to your hand when this test ends.
cards.flavor:
"Those that Hobgoblin call you and sweet Puck,
You do their work, and they shall have good luck...
"- William Shakespeare, A Midsummer Night's Dream

cards.name: Guided by the Unseen
cards.text:
Uses (4 secrets).
FAST During a skill test at your location: The performing investigator may search the top 3 cards of their deck for a card that can be committed to this test. You may spend 1 secret to commit that card. Shuffle the performing investigator's deck. (Limit once per test.)

cards.name: Harmony Restored
cards.text: Search the chaos bag for X CURSE tokens and return them to the token pool. X is the number of BLESS tokens in the chaos bag. Gain 1 resource for each CURSE token removed in this way.
cards.flavor: Even the skeins of fate can be untangled, for a time.

cards.name: Holy Rosary
cards.text:
You get +1 WILLPOWER.
REACTION After you succeed at a WILLPOWER test on a treachery, exhaust Holy Rosary: Add 2 BLESS tokens to the chaos bag.

cards.name: Shield of Faith
cards.text:
Seal (up to 5 BLESS). If Shield of Faith has no tokens sealed on it, discard it.
REACTION When an enemy attacks an investigator at your location, exhaust Shield of Faith and release a chaos token sealed here: Cancel that attack.

cards.name: Shroud of Shadows
cards.text:
Uses (3 charges).
ACTION Spend 1 charge: Evade. This evasion attempt uses WILLPOWER instead of AGILITY. You get +2 WILLPOWER for this test. If you succeed and the evaded enemy is non-[[Elite]], you may move that enemy to a connecting location. For each CURSE token revealed during this evasion attempt, you may move to a connecting location or place 1 charge on Shroud of Shadows.

cards.name: Spirit of Humanity
cards.text:
FAST Exhaust Spirit of Humanity and take 1 damage and 1 horror: Add 2 BLESS tokens to the chaos bag.
FAST Exhaust Spirit of Humanity and add 2 CURSE tokens to the chaos bag: Heal 1 damage and 1 horror.

cards.name: Aquinnah
cards.text: REACTION When an enemy attacks you, exhaust Aquinnah and deal 1 horror to her: Deal that enemy's damage to any enemy at your location, instead. (You still take horror dealt by the attack.)
cards.flavor:
"Do not be frightened by what you see.
Be frightened by what you cannot see."

cards.name: Chicago Typewriter
cards.text:
Uses (4 ammo).
ACTION Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You may spend any number of additional actions when you perform this attack. You get +2 COMBAT for this attack for each action being spent (including this ability's ACTION cost). This attack deals +2 damage.

cards.name: Deciphered Reality
cards.text: Investigate. The difficulty of this skill test is equal to the highest shroud value among revealed locations in play. If you succeed, discover 1 clue from each revealed location in play.

cards.name: Dr. William T. Maleson
cards.text: REACTION When you draw an encounter card from the encounter deck, exhaust Dr. William T. Maleson and place 1 of your clues on your location: Cancel the drawing of that card and shuffle it back into the encounter deck. Then, draw a new card from the top of the encounter deck.

cards.name: Lightning Gun
cards.text:
Uses (3 ammo).
ACTION Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +5 COMBAT for this attack. This attack deals +2 damage.

cards.name: Monster Slayer
cards.text: Fight. If this attack succeeds against a non-[[Elite]] enemy, defeat that enemy.

cards.name: Shrivelling
cards.text:
Uses (4 charges).
ACTION Spend 1 charge: Fight. This attack uses WILLPOWER instead of COMBAT. You get +3 WILLPOWER and deal +2 damage for this attack. If a SKULL, CULTIST, TABLET, ELDER THING, or AUTO FAIL symbol is revealed during this attack, take 2 horror.

cards.name: The Gold Pocket Watch
cards.text:
Exceptional.
REACTION When a phase begins, remove The Gold Pocket Watch from the game: Skip this phase.
REACTION After a phase ends, remove The Gold Pocket Watch from the game: Repeat that phase.

cards.name: The Red-Gloved Man
cards.text:
Fast.
REACTION After The Red-Gloved Man enters play: Choose two of your skills. While The Red-Gloved Man is in play, raise the base value of each of those skills to 6.
Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Discard The Red-Gloved Man.

cards.name: Try and Try Again
cards.text: REACTION After a skill test is failed, if a skill card you own is committed to that test, exhaust Try and Try Again: Return that skill card to your hand.

cards.name: Vicious Blow
cards.text: If this skill test is successful during an attack, that attack deals +1 damage (+2 damage instead if it succeeds by 2 or more).
cards.flavor: With a sickening smack, he struck the abomination over and over…until at last, it stopped moving.

cards.name: Ward of Protection
cards.text:
Fast. Play when you draw a non-weakness encounter card. 
Cancel all of that card's effects and discard it. Then, take 1 horror.

cards.name: A Watchful Peace
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play A Watchful Peace, search the chaos bag and/or cards in play for a total of 5 BLESS tokens and return them to the token pool.
Fast. Play when the "draw encounter cards" step of the mythos phase would begin.
Skip this step of the mythos phase.

cards.name: Dig Deep
cards.text:
Uses (2 resources). Replenish these resources at the start of each round.
FAST Spend 1 resource from your resource pool or from Dig Deep: You get +1 WILLPOWER or +1 AGILITY for this skill test.

cards.name: Enchant Weapon
cards.text:
Attach to a [[Weapon]] asset controlled by an investigator at your location. Limit 1 per asset.
Attached asset gains the [[Relic]] trait and takes up an arcane slot in addition to its other slots.
REACTION When you perform a Fight action using attached asset, exhaust this card: Add the owner of this card's WILLPOWER to your COMBAT for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage.

cards.name: Favor of the Moon
cards.text:
Fast. Seal (up to 3 CURSE). If there are no tokens sealed on Favor of the Moon, discard it.
REACTION When you would reveal a chaos token from the chaos bag, exhaust Favor of the Moon: Resolve a token sealed here instead, as if it were just revealed from the chaos bag. Then, gain 1 resource.

cards.name: Favor of the Sun
cards.text:
Fast. Seal (up to 3 BLESS). If there are no tokens sealed on Favor of the Sun, discard it.
REACTION When you would reveal a chaos token from the chaos bag, exhaust Favor of the Sun: Resolve a token sealed here instead, as if it were just revealed from the chaos bag.

cards.name: Flute of the Outer Gods
cards.text:
Exceptional. Seal (up to X CURSE).
ACTION Exhaust Flute of the Outer Gods and release 1 CURSE token sealed on it: Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location. Either move the chosen enemy to a connecting location, or deal its damage to any enemy at its location. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

cards.name: Geas
cards.text:
Exceptional.
You get +1 WILLPOWER, +1 INTELLECT, +1 COMBAT, and +1 AGILITY.
Forced - After Geas enters play: Make a promise using the following formula - "I shall not (draw/play/commit) any cards during each of my turns." If you break this promise while Geas is in play, discard it and add 10 CURSE tokens to the chaos bag.

cards.name: Hard Knocks
cards.text:
Uses (2 resources). Replenish these resources at the start of each round.
FAST Spend 1 resource from your resource pool or from Hard Knocks: You get +1 COMBAT or +1 AGILITY for this skill test.

cards.name: Hyperawareness
cards.text:
Uses (2 resources). Replenish these resources at the start of each round.
FAST Spend 1 resource from your resource pool or from Hyperawareness: You get +1 INTELLECT or +1 AGILITY for this skill test.

cards.name: Ikiaq
cards.text:
You get +1 WILLPOWER and +1 INTELLECT. You get -1 WILLPOWER and -1 INTELLECT for each weakness beneath Ikiaq.
REACTION When an investigator at your location draws a basic weakness, exhaust Ikiaq: Cancel that weakness's effects and place it facedown beneath Ikiaq. Its owner must draw it if Ikiaq leaves play.

cards.name: Nephthys
cards.text:
You get +1 WILLPOWER.
REACTION When 1 or more BLESS tokens would be removed from the chaos bag during a skill test: Seal them on Nephthys, instead.
FAST Exhaust Nephthys: Either release 3 BLESS tokens sealed on her, or return 3 BLESS tokens sealed on her to the token pool to deal 2 damage to an enemy at your location.

cards.name: Purifying Corruption
cards.text:
REACTION When you draw a non-weakness treachery, take 1 damage and 1 horror: Cancel that card's revelation effect and place 1 resource on this card, as corruption. If this card has 3 or more corruption, remove it from the game.
FAST Draw the top card of the encounter deck: Either heal 1 damage and 1 horror, or remove 1 corruption from this card.
Card design by the Impure at Arkham Nights 2019.

cards.name: The Stygian Eye
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Reduce the cost to play The Stygian Eye by 1 for each CURSE token in the chaos bag.
Until the end of the round, you get +3 to each of your skills.

cards.name: Final Rhapsody
cards.text:
Advanced.
Revelation - Reveal 5 chaos tokens from the chaos bag. For each non-ELDER SIGN, non-BLESS symbol token revealed, take 1 damage and 1 horror.
cards.flavor: When the dead start talking about what scares them, that's when it's time to listen.

cards.name: Jim Culver
cards.text:
REACTION After you reveal 1 or more SKULL or CURSE tokens during a skill test you are performing: Replenish 1 charge on an asset you control. (Limit once per round.)
ELDER SIGN effect: +2. You may treat this token as if it were a SKULL or CURSE token instead.

[Back]
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards (MYSTIC) level 0-3, [[Spell]] and [[Cursed]] cards level 0-4, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to five other Survivor cards (SURVIVOR) level 0.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Jim's Trumpet, Final Rhapsody, The Beyond, 1 random basic weakness.
Spirit Deck Size: 10.
Spirit Deckbuilding Options: 9 different [[Ally]] assets from any class level 0–2, Vengeful Shade.
Spirit Deck Instructions: Shuffle the “spirit deck” separately from your deck and place it next to The Beyond asset, facedown. This deck may be upgraded separately using your unspent experience.
cards.stats: WIL 4 INT 3 COM 3 AGI 2 / Health 7 / Sanity 8
cards.flavor: “I know I can make the dead dance.”

cards.name: Jim's Trumpet
cards.text:
Jim Culver deck only. Advanced.
REACTION When a SKULL or CURSE token is revealed during a skill test you are performing, exhaust Jim's Trumpet: Heal 1 horror from each investigator and [[Ally]] asset at your location or a connecting location.

cards.name: The Beyond
cards.text:
Jim Culver deck only. Permanent.
Each attached spirit loses all printed traits and gains the [[Geist]] trait. When damage/horror would be placed on an attached spirit, it must be placed on Jim Culver, instead.
Forced – When your turn begins: Attach the top card of the spirit deck to The Beyond, as a spirit. If 4 or more spirits are attached, flip this card and resolve its text.

cards.name: The Beyond
cards.text:
Forced – One at a time, choose each non-weakness spirit attached to The Beyond and reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If it is...
- ... an ELDER SIGN token: You may either heal 1 horror, or attach the top card of the spirit deck to The Beyond, as a spirit. (Do not reveal tokens for the spirit you attach after resolving this effect.)
- ... an AUTO FAIL token: Discard this spirit. Take 1 direct damage/horror.
- ...a SKULL token: Discard this spirit. Heal 1 horror.
- ...a CULTIST, ELDER THING, TABLET, or CURSE token: You must either discard this spirit or take 1 direct damage.
- ...any other token: Discard this spirit.
Flip this card back to its asset side.
Reminder: Spirits attached to The Beyond are in play but only retain their names and text boxes. Spirits do not take up slots and do not have health or sanity values. When a unique spirit is attached to The Beyond, any other asset that shares its name and is already in play is discarded. Spirits are always discarded to the bottom of the spirit deck.

cards.name: Vengeful Shade
cards.text:
Hunter. Prey – Jim Culver only.
You may fight or evade this enemy while it is attached to The Beyond (as if it were engaged with you). If you succeed, discard it. If you fail, spawn it engaged with you.
Forced – When you attach a spirit to The Beyond via its forced effect: Vengeful Shade attacks you (even if it is not at your location).

cards.name: Arcane Experience
cards.text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per deck.
You have 1 additional arcane slot.
cards.flavor:
"The hidden cults to which these witches belonged often guarded and handed down surprising secrets from elder, forgotten aeons."
-H. P. Lovecraft, "Dreams in the Witch House"

cards.name: Bend Blood
cards.text: Fight (WILLPOWER). You get +3 WILLPOWER and deal +1 damage for this attack. If you succeed, deal 1 damage to each other enemy at your location. Each enemy dealt damage by Bend Blood cannot attack you for the remainder of the round.

cards.name: Blood Curse
cards.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this skill test is successful, take 1 direct damage.
cards.flavor: What wouldn't you give for a taste of true power?

cards.name: Blood Curse
cards.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, deal 1 damage to a card with health at your location.
cards.flavor: What wouldn't you give for a taste of true power?

cards.name: Blood Ward
cards.text:
Fast. Play when a non-[[Elite]] enemy attacks an investigator at your location.
Cancel that attack and heal 2 damage from the targeted investigator.

cards.name: Bloodstone
cards.text: You get +1 WILLPOWER.
cards.flavor: A symbol for vitality and courage in ancient times, wearing the heliotrope has you wondering if there wasn't some measure of truth to the old stories.

cards.name: Called to Guinée
cards.text:
Revelation - Put Called to Guinée into play in your threat area.
You cannot heal damage.
ACTION Choose and discard 3 cards from your hand: Discard Called to Guinée.

cards.name: Ceremonial Robes
cards.text: Reduce the cost of the first [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] card you play each round by 1.
cards.flavor:
"They worshipped, so they said, the Great Old Ones who lived ages before there were any men, and who came to the young world out of the sky."
-H. P. Lovecraft, The Call of Cthulhu

cards.name: Consume Life
cards.text: Fight (WILLPOWER). This attack deals +1 damage. If this attack defeats an enemy, heal 1 damage from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location.
cards.flavor: True power is in the blood.

cards.name: Cosmic Guidance

cards.name: Deny Existence

cards.text:
Joe Diamond deck only. Uses (4 ammo).

[Back]

cards.stats: WIL 1 INT 3 COM 3 AGI 3 / Health 7 / Sanity 7

cards.text:
Fast. Play when you would resolve an effect on a MYSTIC card that triggers "when," "if," or "after" a SKULL, CULTIST, TABLET, ELDER THING, or AUTO FAIL symbol is revealed.

cards.name: Family Inheritance
cards.text:
Permanent. Preston Fairmont deck only.

cards.name: Joe Diamond
cards.text:
