Uses (3 charges).
ACTION Spend 1 charge: Heal 1 damage from an investigator at your location.
cards.flavor: You don't necessarily trust the occult words, but you have no other choice.

cards.name: Otherworld Codex
cards.text:
Uses (3 secrets).
ACTION Exhaust Otherworld Codex and spend 1 secret: Search the top 9 cards of the encounter deck and choose a non-[[Elite]] card among them. Discard a copy of the chosen card from play. Shuffle all of the searched cards back into the encounter deck.

cards.name: Scrounge for Supplies
cards.text: Choose a level 0 card in your discard pile. Add the chosen card to your hand.
cards.flavor:
You pry it out of the corpse's hand.
It's not like he's going to complain.

cards.name: Self-Sacrifice
cards.text:
Commit only to a skill test (of any type) being performed by another investigator at your location.
If this test fails, you must resolve all effects from the failed test, instead of the performing investigator. Then, either you draw 2 cards, or the performing investigator draws 2 cards.

cards.name: Swift Reload
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Choose a [[Firearm]] asset you control with fewer ammo tokens than its uses (X) value. Place ammo on that asset until it has ammo equal to its uses (X) value.

cards.name: Tetsuo Mori
cards.text:
Tetsuo Mori may be assigned damage and/or horror dealt to other investigators at your location.
REACTION When Tetsuo Mori is defeated: Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator searches either their discard pile or the top 9 cards of their deck for an [[Item]] asset and adds it to their hand. Shuffle their deck if it is searched.

extra.Subtitle: Too Noble for His Own Good

cards.name: Versatile
cards.text:
Permanent.
You get +5 Deck Size.
Your investigator's Deckbuilding Options gain: "one other level 0 card from any class (GUARDIAN, SEEKER, ROGUE, MYSTIC, or SURVIVOR)."
cards.flavor: "Unassuming" doesn't mean you're unprepared.

cards.name: "As you wish"
cards.text:
Carson Sinclair deck only.
Commit only to a skill test being performed by another investigator.
If this test succeeds, the performing investigator draws 1 card. If this test fails, you draw 1 card.

cards.name: "I'll take that!"
cards.text:
Fast. Play when you successfully evade a [[Humanoid]] enemy or successfully investigate.
Play an [[Item]] asset from your hand, reducing its cost by X, where X is the amount you succeeded by. Attach "I'll take that!" to that asset. Attached asset gains [[Illicit]].

cards.name: Agent Fletcher
cards.text:
Alert. Hunter.
Prey - Kymani Jones only.
While Kymani Jones is evading Agent Fletcher, reduce their INTELLECT value to 0.
cards.flavor: "I know who you really are, Jones."

cards.name: Alchemical Distillation
cards.text:
Customizable. Uses (3 supplies).
ACTION Spend 1 supply: Choose an investigator at your location and test INTELLECT (1). If you succeed, that investigator performs one of the following options -
- Draw 2 cards.
- Gain 2 resources.

cards.name: Amina Zidane
cards.text:
REACTION When you play an asset: Reduce its resource cost by 3. It enters play with 1 doom on it. (Limit once per round.)
ELDER SIGN effect: +2. You may move all doom from a card at your location to another card at your location.

[Back]
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards (MYSTIC) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, [[Charm]] cards level 0-4.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Word of Woe, Word of Weal, Deafening Silence, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.stats: WIL 3 INT 3 COM 3 AGI 3 / Health 5 / Sanity 9
cards.flavor: "What is it trying to tell me?"

cards.name: Analysis
cards.text: After revealing a chaos token for this skill test, you may place 1 of your clues on your location to cancel that chaos token, return it to the chaos bag, and reveal a new one. (You may do this any number of times.)

cards.name: Astral Mirror
cards.text:
For each of your arcane slots that are empty, you have one additional hand slot.
You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used to play an asset into one of your hand slots.

cards.name: At a Crossroads
cards.text:
Max 2 [[Dilemma]] per round.
Revelation - Choose an investigator and decide (choose one):
- The chosen investigator must immediately take an action as if it were their turn, then discards 1 card at random from their hand.
- The chosen investigator loses 1 action during their next turn, then draws 3 cards.

cards.name: Baseball Bat
cards.text:
ACTION: Fight. You get +2 COMBAT for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. If a SKULL or AUTO FAIL symbol is revealed during this attack, either (choose one):
- Return Baseball Bat to your hand after this attack.
- This attack deals an additional +1 damage. Discard Baseball Bat after this attack.

cards.name: Bestow Resolve
cards.text:
Uses (4 charges).
FAST During a skill test performed by an investigator at your location or a connecting location, spend 1 charge: Commit a non-weakness card from your hand to that skill test, treating all of its skill icons as WILD.

cards.name: Binder's Jar
cards.text:
You get +1 arcane slot for each enemy beneath Binder's Jar.
REACTION After a non-[[Elite]] enemy is defeated at your location: Place that enemy facedown beneath Binder's Jar (limit 2 enemies beneath it).
REACTION When an enemy attacks you, discard an enemy beneath Binder's Jar that shares a [[Trait]] with the attacking enemy: Cancel that attack.

cards.name: Bizarre Diagnosis
cards.text: Place 1 of your clues on your location. Then, heal 3 damage from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location.
cards.flavor: Unconventional ailments require unconventional treatments.

cards.name: Bolas
cards.text:
Evade. Attempt to evade using COMBAT instead of AGILITY. If you succeed and the enemy is non-[[Elite]], attach Bolas to it.
Attached enemy gets -1 evade value.
Forced - After attached enemy moves: Exhaust it.

cards.name: Bonesaw
cards.text:
Vincent Lee deck only.
ACTION: Fight. You get +2 COMBAT for this attack. If this attack is successful, you may take 1 damage to deal +1 damage for this attack.
ACTION: Heal 5 damage from an investigator at your location. Test INTELLECT (4). If you fail, that investigator suffers 1 physical trauma. (Max once per game.)

cards.name: Bonnie Walsh
cards.text:
Charlie Kane deck only.
REACTION After you exhaust Bonnie Walsh: Ready another [[Ally]] asset you control. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "Don't forget you have a 9 p.m. appointment with Mr. Sanford. Shall I book your usual table at La Bella Luna? Also, you bought me a wristwatch for my birthday. Thank you very much."

cards.name: Breach the Door
cards.text:
Test COMBAT (1). If you succeed, attach Breach the Door to your location with 1 resource on it for each point you succeeded by, as leads.
Reduce attached location's shroud by 1 for each lead on Breach the Door.
cards.flavor: "Let's see those hands!"

cards.name: Breaking and Entering
cards.text: Investigate. Add your AGILITY value to your skill value for this investigation. If you succeed by 1 or more, you may automatically evade an enemy at this location. If you succeed by 3 or more, return Breaking and Entering to your hand at the end of your turn. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
cards.flavor: If you're careful, it's just "entering."

cards.name: Burden of Leadership
cards.text: Revelation - If you control no [[Ally]] assets, shuffle Burden of Leadership back into your deck. Otherwise, for each [[Ally]] asset you control, you must either exhaust it or deal it 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror.
cards.flavor: "I tell myself it was for the greater good. Was it, Bonnie?"

cards.name: Calculated Risk
cards.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
Commit only to a test you are performing of any type, and only if it is your turn.
Calculated Risk gains WILD for each action you performed this turn (including this one).
After this test ends, end your turn.

cards.name: Captivating Discovery
cards.text: Search the top 6 cards of your deck. You may place up to 3 of your clues on your location. For each clue placed in this way, choose and add 2 of the searched cards to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor:
"Don't you realize what this means?"
"Why don't you calm down and tell me very slowly?"

cards.name: Carson Sinclair
cards.text:
You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used on the below ACTION ability.
ACTION: Choose another investigator at your location. They immediately take an action as if it were their turn. (Limit once per round for each investigator.)
ELDER SIGN effect: +0. Draw 1 card. You may resolve this effect anytime another investigator at your location resolves their ELDER SIGN effect.

[Back]
Deck Size: 30.
Secondary Class Choice: At deck creation, choose Seeker (SEEKER), Mystic (MYSTIC), or Survivor (SURVIVOR).
Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards (GUARDIAN) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 10 level 0-1 events and/or skills of your chosen secondary class.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): 2 copies of "As you wish", Selfless to a Fault, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.stats: WIL 2 INT 2 COM 2 AGI 2 / Health 6 / Sanity 6

cards.name: Ceremonial Sickle
cards.text:
ACTION: Fight. Either use your WILLPOWER or get +1 COMBAT for this attack. When you initiate this ability, choose one -
- Exhaust Ceremonial Sickle and place 1 doom on it to get +1 skill value and deal +1 damage for this attack.
- If this attack defeats an enemy, remove 1 doom from Ceremonial Sickle.

cards.name: Ceremonial Sickle
cards.text:
ACTION: Fight. Either use your WILLPOWER or get +1 COMBAT for this attack. When you initiate this ability, choose one -
- Exhaust Ceremonial Sickle and place 1 doom on it to get +3 skill value and deal +1 damage for this attack.
- If this attack defeats an enemy, ready Ceremonial Sickle and remove all doom from it.

cards.name: Charlie Kane
cards.text:
You have 3 additional ally slots.
FAST During a skill test you are performing, exhaust an [[Ally]] asset you control: For this test, you get +1 skill value, plus an additional +1 for each skill icon that [[Ally]] asset has that matches this test's type.
ELDER SIGN effect: +3. Ready an [[Ally]] asset at your location.

[Back]
Deck Size: 30.
Class Choices: At deck creation, choose 2 classes (GUARDIAN, SEEKER, ROGUE, MYSTIC, or SURVIVOR).
Deckbuilding Options: [[Ally]] cards level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, cards from your chosen classes level 0-2.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Bonnie Walsh, Burden of Leadership, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.stats: WIL 1 INT 1 COM 1 AGI 1 / Health 6 / Sanity 6
cards.flavor: "It can be arranged. It's just a matter of acceptable terms."

cards.name: Chuck Fergus
cards.text:
REACTION When you play a [[Tactic]] or [[Trick]] event, exhaust Chuck Fergus: Choose one -
- That event gains fast.
- That event costs 2 fewer resources to play.
- You get +2 skill value while performing a skill test during the resolution of that event.

cards.name: Clean Sneak
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
For each exhausted non-swarm enemy at your location, choose a different option:
- Gain 2 resources.
- Deal 2 damage to that enemy.
- Discover 1 clue at your location.
- Draw 1 card.

cards.name: Custom Modifications
cards.text:
Customizable.
Attach to a [[Firearm]] asset you control. Limit 1 per asset.
REACTION When you reveal a non-AUTO FAIL chaos token attacking with attached asset, exhaust Custom Modifications: Cancel that chaos token, return it to the chaos bag, and reveal a new one.
cards.flavor: It's like an old friend in your grip.

cards.name: Damning Testimony
cards.text:
Customizable. Uses (3 evidence).
ACTION Exhaust Damning Testimony and choose an enemy at any location: Investigate (your location). If you succeed, you may spend 1 evidence to discover 1 additional clue at the chosen enemy's location.

cards.name: Darrell Simmons
cards.text:
You begin the game with Darrell's Kodak in play.
FAST During a skill test at your location, spend 1 evidence from an asset you control: Reduce the difficulty of this test by 2. (Limit once per test.)
ELDER SIGN effect: +1. Place 1 evidence on an asset you control.

[Back]
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards (SURVIVOR) level 0-5, Seeker cards (SEEKER) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Darrell's Kodak, Ruined Film, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.stats: WIL 2 INT 5 COM 2 AGI 3 / Health 6 / Sanity 8
cards.flavor: "The truth is darker than any of us know."

cards.name: Darrell's Kodak
cards.text:
Darrell Simmons deck only.
REACTION After an enemy or treachery enters play, exhaust Darrell's Kodak: Place 1 resource (from the token pool) on that enemy or treachery, as evidence.
REACTION After you discover any number of clues: Move that many evidence on enemies or treacheries at that location (or not at any location) to Darrell's Kodak.

cards.name: Deafening Silence
cards.text: Revelation - Move 1 doom from an asset you control to the current agenda. This may cause the current agenda to advance. If no doom is moved in this way, shuffle Deafening Silence back into your deck.
cards.flavor: I can hear you too, Amina.

cards.name: Dirty Fighting
cards.text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
While attacking, parleying, or attempting to evade an exhausted enemy, you get +2 skill value.
REACTION After you evade an enemy, exhaust Dirty Fighting: Take a fight action against that enemy. Ignore the aloof keyword for this attack.

cards.name: Disguise
cards.text:
Uses (4 supplies).
ACTION Spend 1 supply: Evade. You get +2 AGILITY for this evasion attempt. If you succeed and the evaded enemy is non-[[Elite]], it does not ready during the next upkeep phase.

cards.name: Dissection Tools
cards.text:
REACTION After an enemy at your location is defeated: Place 1 resource (from the token pool) on this card, as evidence.
While Dissection Tools has...
- ... 1 or more evidence, you get +1 AGILITY.
- ... 2 or more evidence, you get +1 COMBAT.
- ... 3 or more evidence, you get +1 sanity.

cards.name: Dowsing Rod
cards.text:
ACTION: Investigate. Either use your WILLPOWER or get +1 INTELLECT for this investigation. When you initiate this ability, choose one -
- Exhaust Dowsing Rod and place 1 doom on it to move to a connecting location.
- If this investigation discovers the last clue at a location, remove 1 doom from Dowsing Rod.

cards.name: Dowsing Rod
cards.text:
ACTION: Investigate. Either use your WILLPOWER or get +1 INTELLECT for this investigation. When you initiate this ability, choose one -
- Exhaust Dowsing Rod and place 1 doom on it to move to a connecting location and get +2 skill value for this investigation.
- If this investigation discovers the last clue at a location, ready Dowsing Rod and remove all doom from it.

cards.name: Dr. William T. Maleson
cards.text: REACTION When any investigator draws an encounter card from the encounter deck, exhaust Dr. William T. Maleson and place 1 of your clues on your location: That investigator draws another card from the top of the encounter deck, chooses one of those 2 cards to resolve, and cancels and discards the other.

cards.name: Ectoplasmic Horror
cards.text:
MYSTIC investigator only.
Hunter.
The first time you reveal a chaos token while attacking or attempting to evade Ectoplasmic Horror, reveal an additional token for each empty arcane slot you have.

cards.name: Eldritch Initiation
cards.text: For each arcane slot you have, draw 1 card (max 5). For each filled arcane slot you have, choose and discard 1 card from your hand.
cards.flavor:
By both light and shadow /
may dusk beget dawn;
May the turning of the world /
lead to power everlasting.

cards.name: Elle Rubash
cards.text:
You get +1 skill value while resolving a skill test on an attached asset.
1 doom on each attached asset does not count towards the agenda's doom threshold.
FAST Exhaust Elle Rubash: Choose an asset in your play area with 1 or more doom on it. Attach it to Elle Rubash, or switch it with an attached asset. (Limit 2 attached assets).

cards.name: Embezzled Treasure
cards.text:
FAST Exhaust Embezzled Treasure: Move up to 2 resources from your resource pool to Embezzled Treasure (to a maximum of 10 resources on it).
Forced - When you resign or the game ends: For every 2 resources on Embezzled Treasure, an investigator of your choice begins the next scenario of the campaign with 1 additional resource in their resource pool.

cards.name: Empirical Hypothesis
cards.text:
Customizable. Limit 1 per investigator.
Forced - At the start of the round: Choose one of the following criteria for this round
- You fail a test by 2 or more.
- You succeed at a test by 3 or more.
When the chosen criteria is met, you may exhaust Empirical Hypothesis to add 1 evidence to it.
FAST Spend 1 evidence: Draw 1 card.

cards.name: End of the Road
cards.text:
Fast. Play during your turn only if the final agenda is in play.
Draw 1 card, gain 1 resource, and gain 1 additional action. Remove End of the Road from the game.
cards.flavor: "So... should we turn around?"

cards.name: Ever Vigilant
cards.text: One at a time, investigators at your location, as a group, may play up to 4 assets in total from their hands, reducing the resource cost of each by 1.
cards.flavor:
He had to give Logan credit:
the man knew how to gear up for Armageddon.

cards.name: Existential Riddle
cards.text:
Parley. Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location and test WILLPOWER or INTELLECT (8). This test gets -1 difficulty for each other card in your hand. If you succeed, automatically evade the chosen enemy and attach Existential Riddle to it.
Attached enemy gains aloof.

cards.name: Exploit Weakness
cards.text:
Fast. Play before revealing a chaos token during an attack or evasion attempt you are performing, and only if the difficulty of this test is currently 0.
This test automatically succeeds. Instead of this test's normal effects, discard the attacked or evaded enemy (if it is [[Elite]], automatically evade it and deal it 3 damage instead).

cards.name: Explosive Ward
cards.text:
Before you play Explosive Ward, you may discard any number of cards from your arcane slots.
Deal X damage to a non-[[Elite]] enemy engaged with you. X cannot be greater than the number of empty arcane slots you have. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

cards.name: Fickle Fortune
cards.text:
Max 2 [[Dilemma]] per round.
Revelation - You must decide (choose one):
- Place 1 doom on the current agenda. Each investigator heals 3 damage and 3 horror.
- Remove 1 doom from the current agenda. Each investigator takes 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror. Remove Fickle Fortune from the game.

cards.name: Field Agent
cards.text:
You get +1 INTELLECT.
FAST Exhaust Field Agent and deal 1 horror to it: Discover 1 clue at your location.
cards.flavor: Day 15. The entities appear to be feeding. On what, I cannot imagine. I dare not approach further.

cards.name: Fighting Lessons
cards.text:
Commit only to a skill test during an attack or evasion attempt.
You can commit this skill to an investigator's test at any location.
cards.flavor: "Aim and pull the damned trigger. It ain't hard, kid."

cards.name: Fingerprint Kit
cards.text:
Uses (3 supplies).
ACTION Exhaust Fingerprint Kit and spend 1 supply: Investigate. You get +2 INTELLECT for this investigation. If you succeed, you discover 2 additional clues at your location.

cards.name: Flashlight
cards.text:
Uses (4 supplies).
REACTION When you perform a skill test while investigating or attempting to evade, spend 1 supply: This test gets -2 difficulty.
Card design by the Council-in-Exile at Arkham Nights 2020.

cards.name: Friends in Low Places
cards.text:
Customizable. When you purchase Friends in Low Places, choose and record a [[Trait]] on its upgrade sheet.
Look at the top 6 cards of your deck. For each looked-at card with the chosen [[Trait]](s), you may spend 1 resource to add that card to your hand. Shuffle the remaining cards into your deck.
cards.flavor: "Pleasure doing business with you, Ms. O'Bannion."

cards.name: Ghastly Possession
cards.text:
After you commit Ghastly Possession to a skill test on an asset, choose one:
- Place 1 doom on that asset. Ghastly Possession gains WILDWILD.
- If this test is successful, either remove 1 doom from this asset, or replenish half of its uses (rounded down).

cards.name: Girish Kadakia
cards.text:
Girish Kadakia may be assigned damage and/or horror dealt to other investigators at your location.
FAST During a skill test being performed by an investigator at your location, exhaust Girish Kadakia: That investigator gets +2 skill value for this test. If this test is successful, heal 1 damage or horror from Girish Kadakia.

cards.name: Grappling Hook
cards.text:
Kymani Jones deck only.
Actions performed using Grappling Hook do not provoke attacks of opportunity.
ACTIONACTION Exhaust Grappling Hook: Take up to 3 different basic actions from the following list, in any order (engage, evade, investigate, or move). If you investigate, use your AGILITY instead of your INTELLECT.

cards.name: Gray's Anatomy
cards.text:
ACTION: Choose a card at your location and test INTELLECT (1). For each point you succeed by, choose one -
- The next time that card would be healed this round, heal +1 damage/horror (to a maximum of +3).
- The next time that card would be dealt damage this round, deal +1 damage (to a maximum of +3).

cards.name: Grievous Wound
cards.text:
Fast. Play after you successfully attack a non-[[Elite]] enemy using a [[Melee]] asset.
Attach Grievous Wound to the attacked enemy.
Forced - At the end of the round: Deal 1 damage to attached enemy.
cards.flavor: This is gonna hurt.

cards.name: Grim Memoir
cards.text:
Uses (4 secrets).
ACTION Spend 1 secret: Investigate. You get +2 INTELLECT for this investigation. If you succeed by 2 or more, you may draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: What follows is a true account. Would that it were not so.

cards.name: Grizzled
cards.text:
Customizable. When you purchase Grizzled, choose and record two [[Traits]] on its upgrade sheet.
If this is a skill test on or against an encounter card (including fighting, evading, or parleying), Grizzled gains WILDWILD for each of the chosen traits that encounter card possesses.

cards.name: Guard Dog
cards.text:
FAST Exhaust Guard Dog: Engage an enemy at your location. That enemy attacks you.
REACTION When an enemy attack deals damage and/or horror to Guard Dog: Deal 1 damage to the attacking enemy.
Card design by the Council-in-Exile at Arkham Nights 2020.

cards.name: Guidance
cards.text: Choose another investigator at your location who has yet to take their turn this round. During their turn this round, the chosen investigator gets +1 to each of their skills, and may take an additional action. Playing Guidance does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

cards.name: Gumption
cards.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
You may commit Gumption to any type of skill test.
While Gumption is committed to a skill test, that test gets -2 difficulty.
cards.flavor: "Now you listen here, mister!"

cards.name: Hallowed Chalice
cards.text:
ACTION: Choose an investigator at your location and either (choose one) -
- Exhaust Hallowed Chalice and place 1 doom on it to heal 2 damage or 2 horror from that investigator.
- Heal 1 damage or 1 horror from that investigator. If you heal the last damage or horror from that investigator, remove 1 doom from Hallowed Chalice.

cards.name: Handcuffs
cards.text:
Fast.
ACTION If Handcuffs is not attached to an enemy: Evade. Use only on a [[Humanoid]] enemy. This evasion attempt uses COMBAT instead of AGILITY. If you succeed, remove all doom from the just-evaded enemy and attach Handcuffs to it.
If the attached enemy is non-[[Elite]], it cannot ready and doom cannot be placed on it.

cards.name: Heed the Dream
cards.text:
Max 2 [[Dilemma]] per round.
Revelation - Reveal the top card from each investigator's deck and place them in a pile. Repeat this two more times. Choose one of the three piles. Each investigator draws each of their cards from that pile. Shuffle each weakness in each other pile into its owner's deck. Remove each other revealed card from the game.

cards.name: Helping Hand
cards.text:
You may commit Helping Hand to any type of test. Max 1 committed per test.
While Helping Hand is committed to a skill test, double the skill icons of each other card committed to that test.

cards.name: Hidden Pocket
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Attach to a [[Clothing]] or [[Armor]] asset you control.
Attached asset gains: "You have 1 additional hand or accessory slot (your choice), which can only be used to hold an [[Illicit]] asset."
cards.flavor: "Thanks! It has pockets!"

cards.name: Hit and Run
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Put an [[Ally]] asset from your hand into play. At the end of your turn, if that asset is still in play, return it to your hand.
cards.flavor: "Impeccable timing, Mr. Fergus."

cards.name: Honed Instinct
cards.text:
Customizable. Fast. Play this card only after one of the following conditions is met:
- The agenda or act advances.
- You succeed at a skill test by 3 or more.
Immediately take an action as if it were your turn. (Max once per round.)

cards.name: Hunter's Armor
cards.text: Customizable.
cards.flavor: You cobbled this suit together yourself from the remnants of ancient armor, mixed with more modern "bulletproof" plating used in the Great War. It's not much, yet. But with some improvements, maybe it'll be enough.

cards.name: Hyperphysical Shotcaster
cards.text:
Customizable. Uses (4 aether). If Hyperphysical Shotcaster has no aether, discard it.
ACTION Spend 1 aether: Resolve the Manifest ability of the Hyperphysical Shotcaster's current form.
FAST Exhaust Hyperphysical Shotcaster: Change its form (to one you have unlocked on its upgrade sheet).

cards.name: Idol of Xanatos
cards.text: REACTION When you are dealt damage and/or horror, exhaust Idol of Xanatos and discard up to 3 cards from your hand: Cancel that much damage/horror.
cards.flavor: The weight of it was reassuring, the metal warm against her skin.

cards.name: Improvised Shield
cards.text:
Improvised Shield can only be played from your discard pile.
Forced - When Improvised Shield is defeated: Shuffle it into your deck instead of discarding it.

cards.name: Katja Eastbank
cards.text:
REACTION When you draw a non-weakness card from the top of your deck, before resolving any of its effects, exhaust Katja Eastbank: Place that card facedown beneath her (limit 5 cards beneath her). Draw a new card to replace it.
ACTION: Draw any card beneath Katja Eastbank.
cards.flavor: "Let's bookmark that for later."

cards.name: Kicking the Hornet's Nest
cards.text: Search the top 9 cards of the encounter deck for a non-[[Elite]] enemy and spawn it engaged with you (instead of its normal spawn location). Then, discover 1 clue at your location and gain X resources, where X is that enemy's health value. Shuffle the encounter deck.

cards.name: Kymani Jones
cards.text:
FAST: Engage an exhausted enemy at your location.
REACTION When you attempt to evade an exhausted non-[[Elite]] enemy: Add your INTELLECT to your skill value for this attempt. If you succeed by at least X, discard that enemy. X is that enemy's remaining health.
ELDER SIGN effect: +1. If there is an exhausted enemy at your location, you automatically succeed instead.

[Back]
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards (ROGUE) level 0-5, [[Tool]] cards level 0-4, Neutral cards level 0-5.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Grappling Hook, Agent Fletcher, 1 random basic weakness.
Bonus Experience: You begin the campaign with 5 additional experience (does not affect the number of weaknesses you must take in Standalone Mode).
cards.stats: WIL 3 INT 2 COM 2 AGI 5 / Health 8 / Sanity 6
cards.flavor: "This doesn't belong to you."

cards.name: Lab Coat
cards.text: REACTION When you would fail a skill test on a SEEKER card by 1 or less, exhaust Lab Coat: You succeed by 0, instead.
cards.flavor: It makes you feel like you know what you're doing, even when you're in way over your head.

cards.name: Lifeline
cards.text:
Max 1 per turn.
Fast. Play when an investigator's turn would end.
That investigator may take X additional actions during their turn. X is the number of skill tests they failed during their turn. Exile Lifeline.

cards.name: Living Ink
cards.text:
Customizable. When you purchase Living Ink, choose a skill and circle it on its upgrade sheet.
Uses (3 charges).
Remove 1 charge from Living Ink at the start of each of your turns. If Living Ink has no charges, discard it.
You get +1 to the chosen skill(s).

cards.name: Lurker in the Dark
cards.text:
GUARDIAN investigator only.
Hunter.
Spawn - Any connecting location.
Lurker in the Dark can only be attacked or damaged using [[Weapon]] assets or [[Tactic]] events, and takes 1 fewer damage from each source.

cards.name: Makeshift Trap
cards.text:
Customizable. Uses (2 time). If Makeshift Trap has no time, discard it.
Attach to your location.
Each non-[[Elite]] enemy at attached location get -1 fight and -1 evade.
Forced - At the end of the round: Remove 1 time from Makeshift Trap.

cards.name: Making Preparations
cards.text:
Max 2 [[Dilemma]] per round.
Revelation - Choose two skills (WILLPOWER, INTELLECT, COMBAT, or AGILITY). Until the end of the investigation phase, each investigator gets +1 to each of the chosen skills, and -1 to each other skill.
cards.flavor: There is a certain clarity in the grim mathematics of survival.

cards.name: Map the Area
cards.text:
Investigate. Add your WILLPOWER or AGILITY to your skill value for this investigation. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues at this location, attach Map the Area to it. Limit 1 per location.
Reduce the difficulty of all skill tests at attached location by 1.

cards.name: Martyr's Vambrace
cards.text:
You get +1 skill value while resolving revelation abilities on encounter cards.
REACTION After another investigator at your location draws a non-peril encounter card, before resolving that card's effects, exhaust Martyr's Vambrace: You are considered to have drawn that encounter card, instead.

cards.name: Moonlight Ritual
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Remove all doom from a non-[[Elite]] card at your location.
cards.flavor: "In the name of the moon..."

cards.name: Motivational Speech
cards.text: Parley. Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator may play an [[Ally]] asset from their hand, reducing its cost by 3.
cards.flavor:
"Think they bought it?"
"They certainly do not suspect the world is ending, Mr. Kane."

cards.name: Nature of the Beast
cards.text:
Max 2 [[Dilemma]] per round.
Revelation - Reveal the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Choose an investigator to draw 1 of the revealed cards and discard the rest. Then, choose an investigator to discover 1 clue at any revealed location.

cards.name: Obsidian Bracelet
cards.text:
Obsidian Bracelet may only be assigned damage and/or horror dealt by treachery effects.
Obsidian Bracelet may be assigned damage and/or horror dealt to other investigators at your location.
cards.flavor: You're not about to question why it works. All you know is that you're never taking it off again.

cards.name: Old Keyring
cards.text:
Uses (3 keys). If there are no keys on Old Keyring, discard it.
ACTION: Investigate. Your location gets -2 shroud for this investigation. If you succeed, remove 1 key from Old Keyring, and if this test's difficulty is 0, you discover 1 additional clue.

cards.name: On the Mend
cards.text:
Limit 1 On the Mend in your hand.
Commit only to a test you are performing.
Forced - When On the Mend would be discarded from anywhere: Set it aside, out of play, instead.

cards.name: One in the Chamber
cards.text:
Fast. Play at the end of an attack or effect that spends the last ammo from a [[Firearm]] asset you control.
Add 1 ammo to that asset. You get +3 skill value for your next attack with that asset this round.

cards.name: Onyx Pentacle
cards.text:
ACTION: Evade. Either use your WILLPOWER or get +1 AGILITY for this evasion attempt. When you initiate this ability, choose one -
- Exhaust Onyx Pentacle and place 1 doom on it to target any enemy at your location or a connecting location, and get +1 skill value for this evasion attempt.
- If you succeed by 2 or more, remove 1 doom from Onyx Pentacle.

cards.name: Onyx Pentacle
cards.text:
ACTION: Evade. Either use your WILLPOWER or get +1 AGILITY for this evasion attempt. When you initiate this ability, choose one -
- Exhaust Onyx Pentacle and place 1 doom on it to target any enemy at your location or a connecting location, and get +3 skill value for this evasion attempt.
- If you succeed by 2 or more, ready Onyx Pentacle and remove all doom from it.

cards.name: Orphic Theory
cards.text:
Uses (4 secrets).
FAST Spend 1 secret: Choose any non-weakness treachery not attached to an [[Elite]] enemy. Until the end of the round, treat that card's printed text box as if it were blank (except for [[Traits]]).

cards.name: Pay Your Due
cards.text:
ROGUE investigator only.
As an additional cost to play Pay Your Due, you may spend any number of additional actions. Reduce its cost by 5 for each additional action spent.
Forced - If Pay Your Due is in your hand at the end of your turn: Reveal it and take 1 damage.

cards.name: Pocket Multi Tool
cards.text:
Customizable. Limit 1 per investigator.
FAST During a skill test you are performing, exhaust Pocket Multi Tool: You get +1 skill value for this test.
cards.flavor: But wait - there's more!

cards.name: Power Word
cards.text:
Customizable. Fast. Play only during your turn.
Attach to a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location.
ACTION If attached enemy is at your location: Parley. Give it a command (limit once per round per command) -
- "Go." This enemy moves once in a direction of your choice.
- "Cower." This enemy exhausts.

cards.name: Predator or Prey
cards.text:
Max 2 [[Dilemma]] per round.
Revelation - If there are no enemies in play, draw 1 card. Otherwise, you must decide (choose one):
- Each unengaged non-[[Elite]] enemy moves once toward the nearest investigator.
- Each investigator disengages from each enemy engaged with them and moves once away from the nearest enemy.

cards.name: Prepared for the Worst
cards.text: Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator search the top 9 cards of their deck for a [[Weapon]] asset, adds it to their hand or plays it (paying its resource cost), and shuffles their deck.

cards.name: Press Pass
cards.text: REACTION After you spend 1 or more clues or place 1 or more clues on your location, exhaust Press Pass: You may take an additional action during this turn (or your next turn if it is not currently your turn).
cards.flavor: It's amazing how differently everyone treats you while you're wearing one.

cards.name: Quantum Paradox
cards.text:
SEEKER investigator only.
As an additional cost to play Quantum Paradox, you must choose and discard 4 other cards from your hand.
Forced - If Quantum Paradox is in your hand at the end of your turn: Reveal it and take 1 horror.

cards.name: Quick Getaway
cards.text:
Fast. Play when an enemy attacks you.
Evade. Attempt to evade the attacking enemy. If you succeed, cancel that enemy's attack.
cards.flavor: It's out of sight, but never out of mind.

cards.name: Refine
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play Refine, spend an action.
Immediately mark a checkbox on an upgrade sheet for a customizable card you own, even if it is not in play.
Max once per game for each investigator.

cards.name: Research Notes
cards.text:
REACTION After a player card ability places 1 or more of your clues on your location: Place that many resources on Research Notes, as evidence.
ACTION: Test INTELLECT (0). For each point you succeed by, you may spend 1 evidence to discover 1 clue at your location.

cards.name: Ruined Film
cards.text: Revelation - Remove 4 evidence from cards you control. For each evidence you cannot remove in this way, take 1 horror.
cards.flavor: Irrefutable proof, reduced to nothing by the light of day.

cards.name: Runic Axe
cards.text:
Customizable. Uses (4 charges). Replenish 1 of these charges at the start of each round.
ACTION: Fight. You get +1 COMBAT for this attack. Before this attack, you may spend any number of charges to imbue the axe with that many different inscriptions -
- Accuracy - You get an additional +2 COMBAT for this attack.
- Power - This attack deals +1 damage.

cards.name: Salvage
cards.text:
Choose an [[Item]] asset in your discard pile. Either (choose one):
- Remove that asset from the game and gain resources equal to its cost.
- Play that asset (paying its cost).
cards.flavor: You feel a bit discarded, too.

cards.name: Selfless to a Fault
cards.text:
Revelation - Put Selfless to a Fault into play in your threat area.
Forced - At the end of your turn, if you did not commit at least 1 card to a skill test performed by another investigator this turn: Take 1 horror and shuffle Selfless to a Fault into your deck.

cards.name: Shed a Light
cards.text:
Fast. Play before revealing a chaos token during an investigation you are performing, and only if the difficulty of this test is currently 0.
This test automatically succeeds. You discover 1 additional clue at this location and 1 additional clue at any location.

cards.name: Sin-Eater
cards.text:
Permanent. Exceptional.
FAST Exhaust Sin-Eater: Move 1 doom from an asset you control to Sin-Eater. Then, either ready that asset or place 1 charge on it.
ACTION: Remove all doom from Sin-Eater.

cards.name: Soul Sanctification
cards.text:
Permanent. Exceptional.
For every point of damage and/or horror you heal in excess of an investigator's current damage/horror, place 1 resource on Soul Sanctification, as an offering. This still counts as healing.
FAST Spend 1 offering: You get +2 skill value for this test. (Limit twice per test.)

cards.name: String of Curses
cards.text:
Parley. Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location and either (choose one):
- Automatically evade that enemy and place 1 doom on it. It cannot take damage for the remainder of the round. Discover 1 clue at your location.
- If that enemy has 1 or more doom on it, defeat it. Gain 1 resource for each doom that was on it.

cards.name: Stylish Coat
cards.text: REACTION When you gain 1 or more resources during your turn via another player card effect, exhaust Stylish Coat: Gain 1 additional resource.
cards.flavor: "Dress for the job you want, you say. What if the job I want is yours?"

cards.name: Summoned Servitor
cards.text:
Customizable. As an additional cost to play Summoned Servitor, you must discard another asset you control.
Summoned Servitor enters play at your location. It can take 1 action during each of your turns, which can only be used to take the following action:
- Move Summoned Servitor to a connecting revealed location.

cards.name: Surgical Kit
cards.text:
Uses (4 supplies).
REACTION When one of your card effects heals damage from an investigator, spend 1 supply: Either that effect heals 1 additional damage, or you draw 1 card and heal 1 horror.
ACTIONACTION: Heal 3 damage from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location.

cards.name: The Raven Quill
cards.text:
Customizable. When you purchase The Raven Quill, name a [[Tome]] or [[Spell]] asset and record that name on its upgrade sheet.
Attach to a named asset you control.
REACTION When you resign or the game ends: Either mark a checkbox on The Raven Quill's upgrade sheet, or reduce the experience cost to upgrade the attached asset before the next scenario by 1.

cards.name: Thieves' Kit
cards.text:
Uses (6 supplies).
ACTION Spend 1 supply: Investigate. For this investigation, you may use AGILITY instead of INTELLECT, and you get +1 skill value. If you succeed, gain 1 resource (2 resources instead if you succeed by 2 or more).
cards.flavor: "...okay, fine, they're mine."

cards.name: Tool Belt
cards.text:
Each attached asset takes up no slots and its text box is treated as if it were blank (except for [[Traits]]).
FAST Exhaust Tool Belt: Choose one - attach a [[Tool]] asset in your play area to Tool Belt, switch a [[Tool]] asset in your play area with an attached asset, or detach an attached asset.

cards.name: Trigger Man
cards.text:
REACTION After Trigger Man enters play: Attach an [[Illicit]] asset from your hand to Trigger Man (it is considered to be in play and under your control).
FAST Exhaust Trigger Man and spend 1 resource: Resolve an ACTION ability on attached asset, without paying its ACTION cost. Resolve that ability with a base skill value of 4.

cards.name: Uncage the Soul
cards.text: You may discard a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] asset you control. Play a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] card from your hand or discard pile, reducing its resource cost by 3.
cards.flavor:
The power seized her, made her shudder and spasm.
Its energy united with hers, and then,
she opened her eyes…

cards.name: Underprepared
cards.text:
SURVIVOR investigator only.
Play only if Underprepared is the only card in your hand and you have exactly 1 resource in your resource pool.
While Underprepared is in your hand, each card you commit to skill tests is considered to have 1 fewer matching skill icon.

cards.name: Underworld Market
cards.text:
Permanent. Exceptional. You get +10 deck size.
REACTION Before drawing your opening hand, choose 10 [[Illicit]] cards from your deck: Shuffle them together and place them next to Underworld Market, as your market deck.
REACTION At the start of your turn: Reveal the top 2 cards of your market deck. You may spend 1 resource to draw 1 of them. Place the rest on the bottom, in any order.

cards.name: Vincent Lee
cards.text:
REACTION After one of your card effects heals damage from an investigator or an investigator's [[Ally]] asset: Add one of your set-aside On the Mend skills to that investigator's hand.
ELDER SIGN effect: +1. You may heal 1 damage from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location.

[Back]
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards (SEEKER) level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5, cards that "heal damage" level 0-5, up to 15 other Guardian and/or Survivor cards level 0-1 (GUARDIAN and/or SURVIVOR).
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Bonesaw, 1 PER INVESTIGATOR copies of On the Mend, Wounded Bystander, 1 random basic weakness.
Additional Setup: You begin each game with 1 PER INVESTIGATOR copies of On the Mend set aside, out of play.
cards.stats: WIL 3 INT 4 COM 3 AGI 1 / Health 9 / Sanity 6
cards.flavor: "I will find the answers, even if it kills me."

cards.name: Word of Weal
cards.text:
Amina Zidane deck only.
Fast. Play when you perform a skill test on an asset with 1 or more doom on it.
Add your WILLPOWER to your skill value for this test. Then, if Word of Woe is in your discard pile, you may shuffle it into your deck.

cards.name: Word of Woe
cards.text:
Amina Zidane deck only.
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Place 1 doom on an asset you control to resolve an ACTION ability on it, ignoring all costs (including its ACTION cost). Then, if Word of Weal is in your discard pile, you may shuffle it into your deck.

cards.name: Wounded Bystander
cards.text:
Revelation - Put Wounded Bystander into play in your play area with 3 damage on it. It cannot leave play while it has damage (unless it is defeated). If it has no damage, discard it.
Forced - When you take non-direct damage: At least 1 of it must be assigned to Wounded Bystander, if able.
Forced - If Wounded Bystander is defeated: You suffer 1 mental trauma.

cards.name: .45 Thompson
cards.text:
Uses (5 ammo).
ACTION Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 COMBAT and deal +1 damage for this attack.
cards.flavor: Used by both gangsters and police officers, the fully automatic Thompson submachine gun was favored due to its accuracy and high volume of fire.

cards.name: Banish
cards.text: Evade. Use only on a non-[[Elite]] enemy. This evasion attempt uses WILLPOWER instead of AGILITY. If you succeed, move the enemy just evaded to any location in play. If you succeed and a SKULL, CULTIST, TABLET, or ELDER THING symbol was revealed during this evasion attempt, that enemy does not ready during the next upkeep phase.

cards.name: Crack the Case
cards.text:
Fast. Play after an investigator discovers the last remaining clue at your location.
Investigators at that location gain a total of X resources, distributed as you wish. X is that location's shroud value.
cards.flavor: "…when you have eliminated all which is impossible, then whatever remains, however improbable, must be the truth." Arthur Conan Doyle, "The Adventure of the Blanched Soldier"

cards.name: Enchanted Blade
cards.text:
Uses (3 charges).
ACTION: Fight. You get +1 COMBAT for this attack. As an additional cost to initiate this ability, you may spend 1 charge to empower the blade. If you do, you get +1 COMBAT and deal +1 damage for this attack.

cards.name: Grisly Totem
cards.text: REACTION After you commit a card to a skill test, exhaust Grisly Totem: That card gains another instance of one of its skill icons of your choice.
cards.flavor:
We should have thrown it back immediately.
But how could we have known?

cards.name: Intel Report
cards.text:
Discover 1 clue at your location.
REACTION When you play Intel Report, increase its cost by 2: Change "Discover 1 clue" to "Discover 2 clues."
REACTION When you play Intel Report, increase its cost by 2: Change "at your location" to "at a location up to 2 connections away."

cards.name: Scroll of Secrets
cards.text:
Uses (3 secrets).
ACTION Exhaust Scroll of Secrets and spend 1 secret: Look at the bottom card of any investigator's deck or the encounter deck. Then, either discard that card, add it to its owner's hand, place it on the bottom of its deck, or place it on the top of its deck.

cards.name: Sign Magick
cards.text:
Fast.
You have 1 additional arcane slot, which can only be used to hold a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] asset.
cards.flavor: The body is but an extension of the mind.

cards.name: Something Worth Fighting For
cards.text: Something Worth Fighting For may be assigned horror dealt to other investigators at your location.
cards.flavor: I can't die here. Not now. Not yet.

cards.name: Tennessee Sour Mash
cards.text:
Uses (2 supplies).
FAST Exhaust Tennessee Sour Mash and spend 1 supply: You get +2 WILLPOWER for a skill test on a treachery card.
ACTION Discard Tennessee Sour Mash: Fight. You get +3 COMBAT for this attack.

cards.name: A Test of Will
cards.text:
Fast. Play when an investigator at your location draws a non-weakness treachery card.
Cancel that card's revelation effect. Exile A Test of Will.
cards.flavor: With or without hope, all you can do is resist.

cards.name: Ambush
cards.text:
Attach to your location.
If there are no investigators at attached location, discard Ambush.
Forced - After an enemy spawns at attached location: Deal 2 damage to that enemy and discard Ambush.

cards.name: Book of Shadows
cards.text: ACTION Exhaust Book of Shadows and spend 1 resource: Add 1 charge to a [[Spell]] asset you control.

cards.name: Calling in Favors
cards.text: Choose an [[Ally]] asset you control and return it to your hand. Then, search the top 9 cards of your deck for an [[Ally]] asset and play it, reducing its cost by X. X is the cost of the [[Ally]] asset returned to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: "Operator, I’m gonna need you to hang up."

cards.name: Charles Ross, Esq.
cards.text:
You may spend resources to pay for [[Item]] assets played by other investigators at your location.
FAST Exhaust Charles Ross, Esq.: Reduce the cost of the next [[Item]] asset played by an investigator at your location by 1.

cards.name: Dario El-Amin
cards.text:
While you have 10 or more resources, you get +1 WILLPOWER and +1 INTELLECT.
ACTION If there are no enemies at your location, exhaust Dario El-Amin: Gain 2 resources.

cards.name: Devil's Luck
cards.text:
Fast. Play when you are dealt damage and/or horror.
Cancel up to 10 damage and/or horror just dealt to you. Exile Devil's Luck.
cards.flavor: "That was my favorite hat!"

cards.name: Fight or Flight
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Until the end of the round, you get +X COMBAT and +X AGILITY, where X is the amount of horror on you.

cards.name: Forewarned
cards.text:
Fast. Play when you draw a non-weakness treachery card.
Place 1 of your clues on your location. Then, cancel that card's revelation effect.
cards.flavor: Knowing is half the battle.

cards.name: Sneak Attack
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to an enemy not engaged with you at your location.

cards.name: Storm of Spirits
cards.text: Fight. This attack uses WILLPOWER instead of COMBAT. If you succeed, instead of its standard damage, this attack deals 2 damage to each enemy at the attacked enemy's location (any additional damage is dealt to the attacked enemy). If a SKULL, CULTIST, TABLET, ELDER THING, or AUTO FAIL token is revealed during this attack, deal 1 damage to each investigator at the attacked enemy's location.

cards.name: Trench Knife
cards.text:
Engage actions you perform do not provoke attacks of opportunity.
ACTION: Fight. You get +X COMBAT for this attack. X is the number of enemies engaged with you.
cards.flavor: It’s seen more violence than most people see in a lifetime.

cards.name: De Vermis Mysteriis
cards.text: ACTION Exhaust De Vermis Mysteriis and place 1 doom on it: Play a [[Spell]] or [[Insight]] event from your discard pile, reducing its resource cost by 1. After that event resolves, remove it from the game.
cards.flavor: Ludwig Prinn was its author; he who had perished in the inquisitorial stake in Brussels when the witchcraft trials were at their height. - Robert Bloch, "The Shambler from the Stars"

cards.name: Decoy
cards.text:
Evade. Automatically evade a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location.
REACTION When you play Decoy, increase its cost by 2: Change "a non-[[Elite]] enemy" to "up to 2 non-[[Elite]] enemies."
REACTION When you play Decoy, increase its cost by 2: Change "at your location" to "at a location up to 2 connections away."

cards.name: Esoteric Atlas
cards.text:
Uses (4 secrets).
ACTION Spend 1 secret and exhaust Esoteric Atlas: Choose a revealed location that is exactly 2 connections away from your location. Move to that location.

cards.name: Fortune or Fate
cards.text:
Fast. Play when doom would be placed on any scenario card.
Max 1 per game.
Cancel 1 doom just placed on that card. Exile Fortune or Fate.

cards.name: Guiding Spirit
cards.text:
You get +1 INTELLECT.
Non-direct horror must be assigned to Guiding Spirit before it can be assigned to your investigator card.
Forced - When Guiding Spirit is defeated by horror: Exile it.

cards.name: Investments
cards.text:
Uses (0 supplies). Limit 10 supplies on Investments.
FAST Exhaust Investments: Place 1 supply on it.
ACTION Exhaust and discard Investments: Move all supplies from it to your resource pool, as resources.

cards.name: Knowledge is Power
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Choose a [[Tome]] or [[Spell]] asset you control, or reveal a [[Tome]] or [[Spell]] asset from your hand. Resolve an ACTION or FAST ability on that asset, ignoring all costs (including its ACTION cost, if any). Then, if that asset was in your hand, you may discard it to draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: ... and power corrupts.

cards.name: Telescopic Sight
cards.text:
Fast. Attach to a [[Firearm]] asset you control that takes up two hand slots. Attached asset cannot be used to attack enemies engaged with you.
REACTION When you perform a Fight action using attached asset, if you are engaged with no enemies, exhaust Telecopic Sight: This attack can target a non-[[Elite]] enemy at a connecting location. Ignore the aloof and retaliate keywords for this attack.

cards.name: Warning Shot
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play Warning Shot, spend 1 ammo from a [[Firearm]] asset you control.
Move all non-[[Elite]] enemies at your location to a connecting location. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
cards.flavor: "Stay back!"

cards.name: "If it bleeds..."
cards.text:
Fast. Play after you defeat a [[Monster]] enemy.
Each investigator at your location heals horror equal to that enemy's horror value.
cards.flavor: It's a small comfort, but you'll take it.

cards.name: Alyssa Graham
cards.text:
You get +1 INTELLECT.
FAST Exhaust Alyssa Graham: Look at the top card of either the encounter deck or any player deck. You may then add 1 doom to Alyssa Graham to place the looked-at card on the bottom of its deck.

cards.name: Dark Horse
cards.text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
During the upkeep phase, you may choose to not gain resources.
While you have no resources in your resource pool, you get +1 WILLPOWER, +1 INTELLECT, +1 COMBAT, and +1 AGILITY.

cards.name: Expose Weakness
cards.text:
Fast. Play during any FAST player window.
Choose an enemy at your location. Test INTELLECT (X), where X is that enemy's fight value. For each point you succeed by, reduce that enemy's fight value by 1 for the next attack performed against it this phase.

cards.name: Inquiring Mind
cards.text: Commit to a skill test only if there is a clue at your location.
cards.flavor: If we wish to learn, we must first question everything we know.

cards.name: Lucky Dice
cards.text:
Exceptional.
REACTION When you reveal a non-AUTO FAIL chaos token, spend 2 resources: Ignore that chaos token and reveal another one to resolve. If that token has a AUTO FAIL symbol, remove Lucky Dice from the game (cannot be ignored/canceled).

cards.name: Opportunist
cards.text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing.
If you succeed by 2 or more, return Opportunist to your hand after this test instead of discarding it.

cards.name: Quick Thinking
cards.text: If this skill test is successful by 2 or more, after it resolves, you may immediately take an action as if it were your turn (this action does not count toward the number of actions you can take each turn).

cards.name: Rite of Seeking
cards.text:
Uses (3 charges).
ACTION Spend 1 charge: Investigate. Investigate using WILLPOWER instead of INTELLECT. You get +2 WILLPOWER for this test. If successful, you discover 2 additional clues at this location. If a SKULL, CULTIST, TABLET, ELDER THING, or AUTO FAIL symbol is revealed during this test, after this test resolves lose all remaining actions and immediately end your turn.

cards.name: Springfield M1903
cards.text:
Uses (3 ammo).
ACTION Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +3 COMBAT and deal +2 damage for this attack. Cannot be used to attack enemies engaged with you.

cards.name: Survival Instinct
cards.text: If this test is successful during an evasion attempt, the evading investigator may immediately evade each other enemy engaged with him or her, and may move to a connecting location.

cards.name: A Chance Encounter
cards.text: Choose an [[Ally]] asset in any player's discard pile. Put that asset into play under your control. At the end of the round, if that asset is still in play, discard it.

cards.name: Ace in the Hole
cards.text:
Exceptional. Fast. Play only during your turn.
You may take an additional 3 actions this turn.

cards.name: Fine Clothes
cards.text: Reduce the difficulty of skill tests you perform during 'parley' actions by 2.
cards.flavor: There's nothing quite like the feel of silk against your skin.

cards.name: Jewel of Aureolus
cards.text: REACTION After a SKULL, CULTIST, TABLET, ELDER THING, or AUTO FAIL symbol is revealed during a skill test at your location, exhaust Jewel of Aureolus: Draw 1 card or gain 2 resources.

cards.name: Joey "The Rat" Vigil
cards.text: FAST Spend 1 resource: Choose an [[Item]] asset from your hand and play it (paying its cost).
cards.flavor:
"Murph, you know full well that The Rat would snitch on anyone, at any time, for anything, truth be damned if the price was right."
-Jason Marker, The Worlds of Arkham

cards.name: Leadership
cards.text: While Leadership is committed to a skill test being performed by another investigator, Leadership gains WILLPOWER WILD.

cards.name: Moment of Respite
cards.text:
Play only if there are no enemies at your location.
Heal 3 horror and draw 1 card.

cards.name: Moonlight Ritual
cards.text: Remove all doom from 1 card you control.

cards.name: Strange Solution
cards.text:
Researched. Uses (4 supplies).
ACTION Spend 1 supply: Heal 2 damage from an investigator at your location.

cards.name: Strange Solution
cards.text:
Researched. Uses (3 supplies).
ACTION Spend 1 supply: Fight. Attack with a base COMBAT skill of 6. This attack deals +2 damage.

cards.name: Strange Solution
cards.text:
Researched. Uses (4 supplies).
ACTION Spend 1 supply: Evade. Evade with a base AGILITY skill of 6.

cards.name: Stroke of Luck
cards.text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing.
After revealing chaos tokens for this test, you may choose to exile Stroke of Luck. If you do, this test is automatically successful (unless a AUTO FAIL token was revealed).

cards.name: Delilah O'Rourke
cards.text:
You get +1 COMBAT and +1 AGILITY.
FAST Exhaust Delilah O'Rourke and spend X resources: Choose an enemy at your location. Deal 1 damage to the chosen enemy (2 damage instead if that enemy is exhausted). X is the chosen enemy's evade value.
cards.flavor: "Sheldon? O'Bannion? Don't care. Just as long as I get paid."

cards.name: Empty Vessel
cards.text:
Limit 1 per deck. Uses (0 charges).
REACTION After you defeat an enemy: Place 1 charge on Empty Vessel.
FAST If there are at least 3 charges on Empty Vessel: Search your bonded cards for Wish Eater and swap it with Empty Vessel, moving all charges from Empty Vessel to Wish Eater.

cards.name: Garrote Wire
cards.text: FAST During your turn, exhaust Garrote Wire: Fight. You get +2 COMBAT for this attack. Use only on an enemy with exactly 1 remaining health.

cards.name: Nothing Left to Lose
cards.text:
If you have fewer than 5 resources, gain resources until you have 5 resources.
If you have fewer than 5 cards in your hand, draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand.
Remove Nothing Left to Lose from the game.

cards.name: Summoned Hound
cards.text:
As an additional cost to play Summoned Hound, you must search your bonded cards for 1 copy of Unbound Beast and shuffle it into your deck.
FAST During your turn, except during an action, exhaust Summoned Hound: Fight/Investigate. Either attack with a base COMBAT skill of 5, or investigate with a base INTELLECT skill of 5.

cards.name: Surprising Find
cards.text:
Myriad.
REACTION When you search your deck and Surprising Find is among the searched cards: Put it into play in your play area. You must commit it to the next eligible skill test you perform. If that test is successful, draw 1 card. (Max one [[Research]] ability per search.)

cards.name: The Black Cat
cards.text:
Anytime you reveal a TABLET, ELDER THING, or ELDER SIGN symbol during a skill test, you may choose to use the following effects instead of that symbol's normal effects:
TABLET: -1. The Black Cat takes 1 direct damage.
ELDER THING: -1. The Black Cat takes 1 direct horror.
ELDER SIGN: +5. Heal all damage and horror from The Black Cat.

extra.Subtitle: A Liar, or a Prophet, or Both

cards.name: Unbound Beast
cards.text:
Bonded (Summoned Hound).
Prey - Bearer.
Hunter. Retaliate.
Revelation - If there is no copy of Summoned Hound in play, set Unbound Beast aside, out of play. Otherwise, set an investigator's Summoned Hound aside, out of play, and spawn Unbound Beast engaged with the same investigator.

cards.name: Wish Eater
cards.text:
Bonded (Empty Vessel).
REACTION When you reveal a SKULL, CULTIST, TABLET, or ELDER THING chaos token during a skill test, spend 1 charge: Cancel that token. Heal 1 damage and 1 horror.
Forced - If Wish Eater has no charges: Search your bonded cards for Empty Vessel and swap it with Wish Eater.

cards.name: Anything You Can Do, Better
cards.text:
Winifred Habbamock deck only.
Commit only to a skill test you are performing.
cards.flavor: "Told you."

cards.name: Arrogance
cards.text:
You must commit Arrogance to each eligible skill test you perform.
This skill's icons subtract from your skill value instead of adding to it.
If this test succeeds, return this skill to your hand.

cards.name: Backstab
cards.text: Fight. This attack uses AGILITY instead of COMBAT. This attack deals +2 damage. If you succeed by 2 or more, return Backstab to your hand at the end of your turn.

cards.name: Beretta M1918
cards.text:
Uses (4 ammo).
ACTION Exhaust Beretta M1918 and spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +4 COMBAT and deal +1 damage for this attack. If you succeed by 2 or more, either ready Beretta M1918, or this attack deals an additional +1 damage (if you succeed by 4 or more, do both).

cards.name: Cheap Shot
cards.text: Fight. Add your AGILITY value to your skill value for this attack. If you succeed by 1 or more, automatically evade the attacked enemy. If you succeed by 3 or more, return Cheap Shot to your hand at the end of your turn.
cards.flavor: "Aim for the eyes," they told me.

cards.name: Chuck Fergus
cards.text:
REACTION When you play a [[Tactic]] or [[Trick]] event, exhaust Chuck Fergus: Choose two -
- That event gains fast.
- That event costs 2 fewer resources to play.
- You get +2 skill value while performing a skill test during the resolution of that event.

cards.name: Copycat
cards.text: After you commit Copycat to a skill test, search the discard pile of another investigator for a skill you can commit to this test, and commit it. After this test ends, place that card on the bottom of its owner's deck.

cards.name: Daredevil
cards.text: After you commit Daredevil to a skill test, discard cards from the top of your deck until you discard a ROGUE skill you can commit to this test. Commit it. Shuffle each weakness that was discarded by this effect back into your deck.
cards.flavor:
"You're a maniac, Wini!"
"I know! Isn't it wonderful?"

cards.name: Daring Maneuver
cards.text:
Fast. Play when you would succeed at a skill test.
You get +3 skill value for this test. Draw 1 card.
cards.flavor:
"McGlen, are you tryin' to get us both killed?"
"Not this time, pal. Not this time."

cards.name: Leather Jacket
cards.text: Fast.
cards.flavor:
"You think wearing that makes you look like the cat's meow?"
"Nah, I already know I'm the cat's meow. This just lets everyone else know."

cards.name: Liquid Courage
cards.text:
Uses (4 supplies).
ACTION Spend 1 supply: Choose an investigator at your location to heal 1 horror. Then, that investigator tests WILLPOWER (2). If the test succeeds, they draw 1 card. If the test fails, they heal 1 additional horror and discard 1 card at random from their hand.

cards.name: Lonnie Ritter
cards.text:
You get +1 COMBAT.
FAST Exhaust Lonnie Ritter and spend 1 resource: Choose an [[Item]] asset controlled by an investigator at your location. Heal 1 damage from that asset and 1 horror from Lonnie Ritter.

cards.name: Lucky Cigarette Case
cards.text: REACTION After you succeed at a skill test by 1 or more, exhaust Lucky Cigarette Case: Search the top X cards of your deck for a card, draw it, and shuffle the remaining cards into your deck. X is the amount you succeeded by.

cards.name: Manual Dexterity
cards.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, draw 1 card (2 cards instead if it succeeds by 2 or more).
cards.flavor: Too easy.

cards.name: Mauser C96
cards.text:
Uses (5 ammo).
ACTION Exhaust Mauser C96 and spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +1 COMBAT and deal +1 damage for this attack. If you succeed by 2 or more, either ready Mauser C96 or gain 1 resource.

cards.name: Mauser C96
cards.text:
Uses (5 ammo).
ACTION Exhaust Mauser C96 and spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 COMBAT and deal +1 damage for this attack. If you succeed by 2 or more, either ready Mauser C96 or gain 1 resource (if you succeed by 4 or more, do both).

cards.name: Nimble
cards.text: For each point this skill test succeeds by, after it resolves, you may immediately move to a connecting location (to a maximum of 3 times).

cards.name: Pilfer
cards.text: Investigate. This investigation uses AGILITY instead of INTELLECT. If you succeed, discover 2 additional clues at your location.

cards.name: Pilfer
cards.text: Investigate. This investigation uses AGILITY instead of INTELLECT. If you succeed, discover 2 additional clues at your location. If you succeed by 2 or more, return Pilfer to your hand at the end of your turn.

cards.name: Reckless
cards.text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing (of any type) that has no other cards committed to it. Other cards cannot be committed to this skill test.
If this test fails, return this skill to your hand.
Forced - If Reckless is in your hand at the end of your turn: Reveal it and lose 2 resources.

cards.name: Sharpshooter
cards.text:
REACTION When you use a fight ability on a [[Firearm]] asset, exhaust Sharpshooter: Choose one, or both - 
- This attack uses AGILITY instead of COMBAT. All modifiers to your COMBAT for this attack modify your AGILITY instead.
- Use the attacked enemy's evade value for this attack, instead of their fight value.

cards.name: Slip Away
cards.text: Evade. Add your INTELLECT to your skill value for this evasion attempt. If you succeed by 1 or more and the evaded enemy is non-[[Elite]], it does not ready during the next upkeep phase. If you succeed by 3 or more, return Slip Away to your hand at the end of your turn.

cards.name: Sneak By
cards.text: Evade. When this action begins, gain 2 resources.
cards.flavor: Being told not to do something was generally Winifred's cue to proceed as planned.

cards.name: Streetwise
cards.text:
FAST Spend 2 resources: You get +2 INTELLECT for this skill test.
FAST Spend 2 resources: You get +2 AGILITY for this skill test.

cards.name: Winifred Habbamock
cards.text:
FAST If 2 different non-weakness cards you control are committed to this skill test: Draw 1 card. (Limit once per test.)
ELDER SIGN effect: +1. After this test ends, for every 2 points you succeeded by, return a card you committed to this test to your hand.

[Back]
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards (ROGUE) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Anything You Can Do, Better; Arrogance; 1 random basic weakness.
cards.stats: WIL 1 INT 3 COM 3 AGI 5 / Health 8 / Sanity 7
cards.flavor: "I can top that."

cards.name: Abigail Foreman
cards.text:
FAST: Attach a [[Tome]] asset in your play area to Abigail Foreman, or switch a [[Tome]] asset in your play area with an attached asset. The asset attached to her takes up no hand slots. (Limit 1 attached asset.)
REACTION After you resolve an ACTION ability on the attached [[Tome]] asset, exhaust Abigail Foreman: Resolve its effects again.

cards.name: Dream Parasite
cards.text:
Bonded (Nightmare Bauble).
While Dream Parasite is in your hand, you must commit it to the next skill test you perform, if able.
This skill's icons subtract from your skill value instead of adding to it.
If this skill test fails, take 1 damage and 1 horror.

cards.name: Joey "The Rat" Vigil
cards.text:
FAST Spend 1 resource: Choose an [[Item]] asset from your hand and play it (paying its cost).
FAST Discard an [[Item]] asset from play: Gain 2 resources.

cards.name: Mind's Eye
cards.text:
Myriad. Uses (3 secrets).
REACTION When you would test your INTELLECT, COMBAT, or AGILITY, spend 1 secret: Test your WILLPOWER instead.
FAST Discard a copy of Mind's Eye from your hand: Place 2 secrets on this copy of Mind's Eye.

cards.name: Nightmare Bauble
cards.text:
Limit 1 per deck.
Forced - After Nightmare Bauble enters play: Search your bonded cards for 3 copies of Dream Parasite and attach them to Nightmare Bauble. When Nightmare Bauble leaves play, set each attached Dream Parasite aside, out of play.
REACTION When you reveal an AUTO FAIL chaos token, shuffle an attached Dream Parasite into your deck: Cancel that token.

cards.name: Sawed-Off Shotgun
cards.text:
Uses (2 ammo).
ACTION Spend 1 ammo: Fight. Instead of its standard damage, this attack deals 1 damage for each point you succeed by (to a minimum of 1, to a maximum of 6). If you fail and would damage another investigator, this attack deals 1 damage for each point you fail by (to a minimum of 1, to a maximum of 6).

cards.name: Scavenging
cards.text: REACTION After you successfully investigate by 2 or more, exhaust Scavenging: Choose an [[Item]] card in your discard pile and either add it to your hand or play it (paying its cost).

cards.name: Shining Trapezohedron
cards.text: REACTION When you would pay the cost of a [[Spell]] card, exhaust Shining Trapezohedron: Instead, test WILLPOWER (X), where X is the card's resource cost. If you succeed, its resource cost is considered paid. If you fail, cancel the playing of that card without paying any of its costs (including its action cost). For the remainder of the round, you cannot play copies of that card.

cards.name: Spiritual Resolve
cards.text:
Myriad.
FAST Discard a copy of Spiritual Resolve from your hand: Heal all damage and horror from this copy of Spiritual Resolve.

cards.name: The Eye of Truth
cards.text:
If this skill test is on a treachery and the test is successful, add that treachery to the victory display and attach The Eye of Truth to it.
While attached, The Eye of Truth contributes its skill icons to all tests on copies of the attached treachery.
cards.flavor: It's always watching you.

cards.name: Alice Luxley
cards.text:
You get +1 INTELLECT.
REACTION After you discover a clue, exhaust Alice Luxley: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.
cards.flavor: "Please leave this to the professionals. If I find you poking around again, I will bring you in."

cards.name: Belly of the Beast
cards.text:
Fast. Play after you successfully evade an enemy by 2 or more.
Discover 1 clue at that enemy's location.

cards.name: Drawing Thin
cards.text: REACTION When you initiate a skill test, exhaust Drawing Thin: Increase the difficulty of this skill test by 2. Gain 2 resources or draw 1 card.

cards.name: Hawk-Eye Folding Camera
cards.text:
REACTION After the last clue is discovered from your location: Place 1 resource (from the token pool) on this card, as evidence. (Limit once per game at each location.)
While Hawk-Eye Folding Camera has ...
- ... 1 or more evidence, you get +1 WILLPOWER.
- ... 2 or more evidence, you get +1 INTELLECT.
- ... 3 or more evidence, you get +1 sanity.

cards.name: Henry Wan
cards.text:
ACTION Exhaust Henry Wan: One at a time, reveal random tokens from the chaos bag until you choose to stop, or until you reveal a SKULL, CULTIST, TABLET, ELDER THING, or AUTO FAIL symbol.
- If you chose to stop, for each token revealed via this effect, you may either draw 1 card or gain 1 resource.
- If you revealed a SKULL, CULTIST, TABLET, ELDER THING, or AUTO FAIL symbol, do nothing.

cards.name: Mr. "Rook"
cards.text:
Uses (3 secrets).
FAST Exhaust Mr. "Rook" and spend 1 secret: Search the top 3, 6, or 9 cards of your deck for any card and draw it. If at least 1 weakness is among the searched cards, draw 1 of them, as well. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: "Are you sure you want to know? There is no going back."

cards.name: Sixth Sense
cards.text: ACTION: Investigate. Investigate using WILLPOWER instead of INTELLECT. If a SKULL, CULTIST, TABLET, or ELDER THING symbol is revealed during this test, you may choose a revealed location connected to your location; you are now investigating as if you were at the chosen location instead of your location (you may use either shroud value).

cards.name: Swift Reflexes
cards.text:
Fast. Play during any investigator's turn, except during an action.
Immediately take an action as if it were your turn. This action does not count toward the number of actions you can take each turn.

cards.name: Well-Maintained
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Attach to an [[Item]] asset you control. Limit 1 per asset.
REACTION After attached asset is discarded: Return it to its owner's hand, along with each other [[Upgrade]] attachment that was attached to it.

cards.name: Wither
cards.text: ACTION: Fight. This attack uses WILLPOWER instead of COMBAT. If a SKULL, CULTIST, TABLET, or ELDER THING symbol is revealed during this attack, the attacked enemy gets -1 fight and -1 evade for the remainder of the turn (to a minimum of 1).
